<?php
declare(strict_types=1);

use Symfony\Component\Routing\Loader\Configurator\RoutingConfigurator;
use Tjl\CatalogueWorkspace\Controller\AdminController;

return static function (RoutingConfigurator $routes): void {
    $routes->add('tjl_catalogue_workspace_index', '/')->controller([AdminController::class, 'index'])->methods(['GET']);
    $routes->add('tjl_catalogue_workspace_action', '/action')->controller([AdminController::class, 'action'])->methods(['POST']);
    $routes->add('tjl_catalogue_workspace_upload', '/receive')->controller([AdminController::class, 'upload'])->methods(['POST']);
    $routes->add('tjl_catalogue_workspace_download', '/files/{project}/{sha}')->controller([AdminController::class, 'download'])
        ->requirements(['project' => '[A-Za-z0-9._:-]+', 'sha' => '[a-f0-9]{64}'])->methods(['GET']);
    $routes->add('tjl_catalogue_workspace_asset', '/assets/{name}')->controller([AdminController::class, 'asset'])
        ->requirements(['name' => 'workspace\.(js|css)'])->methods(['GET']);
};

<?php
declare(strict_types=1);

namespace Symfony\Component\DependencyInjection\Loader\Configurator;

use Symfony\Component\DependencyInjection\Argument\ServiceLocatorArgument;
use Symfony\Component\DependencyInjection\Reference;
use Tjl\CatalogueWorkspace\Store;
use Tjl\CatalogueWorkspace\Engine;
use Tjl\CatalogueWorkspace\NativeCatalogue;
use Tjl\CatalogueWorkspace\ProjectArchive;
use Tjl\CatalogueWorkspace\Workspace;
use Tjl\CatalogueWorkspace\Import\Handler;
use Tjl\CatalogueWorkspace\Import\Middleware;
use Tjl\CatalogueWorkspace\Import\Runtime;
use Tjl\CatalogueWorkspace\Import\OwnershipListener;
use Tjl\CatalogueWorkspace\Import\ResultObserver;
use Tjl\CatalogueWorkspace\Source\SourceGateway;
use Tjl\CatalogueWorkspace\Controller\AdminController;
use Tjl\CatalogueWorkspace\Command\WorkspaceCommand;
use Tjl\CatalogueWorkspace\Menu\AdminMenuListener;

return static function (ContainerConfigurator $container): void {
    $s = $container->services();
    $s->set(Store::class)->args([service('doctrine.dbal.default_connection'), param('tjl_catalogue_workspace.directory')]);
    $s->set(Engine::class)->args([[]]);
    $repositories = [];
    foreach (['variant' => 'product_variant', 'product' => 'product', 'attribute' => 'product_attribute',
        'channel' => 'channel', 'locale' => 'locale', 'taxon' => 'taxon'] as $key => $name) {
        $repositories[$key] = new Reference('sylius.repository.' . $name);
    }
    $factories = [];
    foreach (['product_translation' => 'product_translation', 'variant_translation' => 'product_variant_translation',
        'attribute_value' => 'product_attribute_value', 'channel_pricing' => 'channel_pricing', 'product_taxon' => 'product_taxon'] as $key => $name) {
        $factories[$key] = new Reference('sylius.factory.' . $name);
    }
    $s->set(NativeCatalogue::class)->args([service('doctrine.orm.entity_manager'), new ServiceLocatorArgument($repositories),
        new ServiceLocatorArgument($factories), service('event_dispatcher')]);
    $s->set(Runtime::class);
    $s->set(Handler::class)->decorate('webgriffe_sylius_akeneo.message_handler.item_import')
        ->args([service(Handler::class . '.inner'), service(Runtime::class), service(Store::class), service(NativeCatalogue::class), service(Engine::class)])
        ->tag('messenger.message_handler', ['handles' => \Webgriffe\SyliusAkeneoPlugin\Message\ItemImport::class]);
    $s->set(Middleware::class)->decorate('webgriffe_sylius_akeneo.middleware.item_import_result_persister')
        ->args([service(Middleware::class . '.inner'), service(Runtime::class), service(Store::class), service(SourceGateway::class)]);
    $s->set(OwnershipListener::class)->args([service(Runtime::class), service(NativeCatalogue::class)])
        ->tag('kernel.event_listener', ['event' => \Webgriffe\SyliusAkeneoPlugin\Event\ProductVariantPreValidateEvent::class, 'method' => '__invoke', 'priority' => -10000]);
    $s->set(ResultObserver::class)->args([service(Runtime::class), service(Store::class)])
        ->tag('doctrine.event_listener', ['event' => 'postPersist']);
    $s->set(ProjectArchive::class)->args([service(Store::class), service(SourceGateway::class), param('tjl_catalogue_workspace.max_export_bytes')]);
    $s->set(Workspace::class)->args([service(Store::class), service(Engine::class), service(NativeCatalogue::class),
        service(SourceGateway::class), service('webgriffe_sylius_akeneo.command_bus'), service(ProjectArchive::class)]);
    $s->set(AdminController::class)->public()
        ->args([service(Workspace::class), service(Store::class), service(ProjectArchive::class), service('twig'),
            service('security.authorization_checker'), service('security.token_storage'), service('security.csrf.token_manager'),
            param('tjl_catalogue_workspace.operator_role')])
        ->tag('controller.service_arguments');
    $s->set(WorkspaceCommand::class)->args([service(Workspace::class), service('sylius.repository.admin_user'),
        param('tjl_catalogue_workspace.operator_role'), service('security.role_hierarchy'), service(ProjectArchive::class), service(Store::class)])->tag('console.command');
    $s->set(AdminMenuListener::class)->tag('kernel.event_listener', ['event' => 'sylius.menu.admin.main', 'method' => '__invoke']);
};

# Original Akeneo source and native media publication

This component extends the selected installed Webgriffe SyliusAkeneoPlugin.
It does not replace its Messenger transport, product importer, result middleware,
Doctrine transaction, value handlers or Sylius image path generator.

## Native authority

The implementation was read against:

- Webgriffe SyliusAkeneoPlugin v3.1.0,
  f5a38abc9537356dde16ad75f046f324a22ed6ec (MIT):
  https://github.com/webgriffe/SyliusAkeneoPlugin/tree/f5a38abc9537356dde16ad75f046f324a22ed6ec
- Akeneo api-php-client v11.0.0,
  b7f9448943b775fcec8f54ad7a29543899baae4b (OSL-3.0):
  https://github.com/akeneo/api-php-client/tree/b7f9448943b775fcec8f54ad7a29543899baae4b
- Sylius v2.1.2 native ImageUploader and FilesystemAdapterInterface (MIT):
  https://github.com/Sylius/Sylius/tree/v2.1.2/src/Sylius/Component/Core

These remain installed dependencies under their original licenses. This source
contains new adapter implementation, not a copied PIM client or importer.
The installed Composer lock, actual API builder and original storage selection
must be inspected during installation; a compatible declared range alone is not
an observation that a particular host has run successfully.

## Bundle integration

The owning bundle extension calls:

    SourceServices::register($container);

after defining Store::class, tjl_catalogue_workspace.directory and
tjl_catalogue_workspace.max_export_bytes. Its compiler pass calls:

    SourceServices::compile($container);

after the original Webgriffe definitions are loaded. This installs the retained
PSR-18 client via the native builder's setHttpClient and disables its optional
resource cache. An explicitly configured existing client is preserved as the
inner transport; otherwise native PSR-18 discovery chooses the installed client.
Original password/token configuration remains in the original factory. No
credentials, token requests, token responses or cookie headers are journalled.

The pass substitutes only the original configured FileAttributeValueHandler
filesystem and the original image uploader's filesystem argument. Its native
image adapter remains the backend; sylius.storage supplies actual complete
preimage readback through Flysystem FilesystemOperator. A custom uploader or
storage installation must retain this exact matching backend/readback binding.
The compiler does not guess a remote storage implementation. Private workspace
and locks must be shared by all original operator and Messenger processes.

## Public source API

Namespace: Tjl\CatalogueWorkspace\Source.

- SourceGateway::capture(projectId, captureId, selection): array
- SourceGateway::inspect(captureId): array
- SourceGateway::withApproved(projectId, operationId, snapshot, callable): mixed
- SourceGateway::operation(operationId): ?array
- SourceGateway::exportProject(projectId): array
- SourceGateway::importProject(projectId, files): void

Selection contains identifiers, an ordered unique list of native product
identifiers. Optional additional_requests contains explicit native read
descriptors:

    {"api":"attribute_option","method":"get","arguments":["attribute-code","option-code"]}

Allowed APIs are product, product_model, family, family_variant, attribute,
attribute_option, category, channel, locale, media, measurement_family and
association_type. Methods are get, all and media download only, subject to the
actual installed API's methods. No arbitrary URL, token parameter or write
request is admitted.

The complete source snapshot schema is tjl.catalogue.source-snapshot.v1.
It retains id, project_id, state, exact selection, authority, products keyed
by native identifier, graph, calls, exact requests, complete sources and sha256.
Each product has PRESENT/MISSING, original decoded data and source_ids.
Every source retains its exact nonsecret request, actual response status,
headers, protocol, complete body descriptor, byte hash and observation times.
Original bytes are authoritative; the decoded PHP values are a native client
projection. A capture is a collection of original responses, not a claimed
atomic upstream database snapshot.

Capture traverses the full selected product/model/family/family-variant/attribute
graph, native category ancestors, actual locale/channel references, every page
of select options and each referenced product image/file metadata and binary
download. The option collection uses the original importer's default page size.
Unknown custom dependencies remain explicit: a following capture adds the
actual descriptor and receives a new review; an approved snapshot is immutable.

Source and media bytes use the existing Store's private content-addressed blobs.
Independent private journals are durable outside Doctrine rollback. Source IDs
and exact complete responses survive same-operation continuation. Completed
capture requests are reused, while interrupted/failed attempts remain retained.
A native Retry-After on 429/503 creates an absolute authority deadline. No
hidden application retry or paid transport is introduced.

## Approved import boundary

The owning middleware wraps the ENTIRE native result/Doctrine/handler chain,
outside the outermost Doctrine transaction. An outgoing asynchronous dispatch
may finish without APPLIED and without media effects; it remains
AWAITING_NATIVE_IMPORT. Its later actual Received execution checks source anew.

Before an uncommitted import, all original native API calls are refetched through
the installed authenticated client. Every original request/status/body hash must
match the approved snapshot and the request set must be complete and identical.
The importer then reads only the already-checked retained responses. Each read
gets a fresh complete PSR stream. An unknown dependency is journalled and rejected
before its network GET; select and review that dependency explicitly.

The original handler writes its APPLIED marker inside the original Doctrine
transaction. The original result observer supplies the actual generated result
ID and COMPLETE state. The gateway requires the native transaction to have
finished before publishing media. A DB state it cannot read safely is
COMMIT_UNCERTAIN, not a fabricated rollback or commit.

## Media consistency and recovery

The native FileAttributeValueHandler moves attachments before SQL commit, and
the native Sylius uploader deletes/writes images during native events. Therefore
SQL rollback alone cannot recover those bytes.

During the approved call, MediaJournal records complete destination preimages
and stages each original write/delete/chmod. JournaledImageStorage.has observes
the overlay, so the original path generator and remove/write sequence remain
native. JournaledFilesystem preserves the original selected attachment
destination. Source downloads and native temporary files remain intact.

No destination publication occurs until APPLIED or COMPLETE survives the
database commit. After commit, the same operation compares the original
preimage, writes its retained after-image through the selected native backend,
reads the result back and records its actual outcome. A process loss after the
write can be reconciled by matching the original after-image. A conflicting
later destination is retained as an explicit conflict; it is not overwritten.

A post-commit media failure is MEDIA_PENDING. Retry reconciles the same journal
before the unchanged result-only recovery callback; it does not repeat the
native importer. A failure without the surviving commit marker leaves only
staged private bytes and NOT_COMMITTED. Earlier attempts remain in the journal.
Once a member is published, subsequent legitimate edits on the receiving host
are not reset by a repeated completed operation.

This is durable eventual publication after the native SQL commit, not an
atomic filesystem/database transaction. The operator must display native
APPLIED/COMPLETE and the separate gateway/media state. External writers must
not modify selected destinations during an explicitly commissioned import.
The journal detects differing preimages/readbacks but cannot make unrelated
remote storage clients participate in one cross-service transaction.

## Complete project export

exportProject returns [{path,blob}] with the exact Store descriptor
{sha256,bytes,path:"blobs/<sha256>"}. It includes all original source, check,
capture, apply, missing-dependency and media journals and every referenced
response/media/preimage blob. Host token/cache values and provider rate-limit
state are excluded.

The owner installs all declared blob bytes first, then calls importProject.
Every descriptor is verified before journal installation. Receiving is
create-only; exact replay reuses originals, and later same-binding receiving
attempts are preserved. Conflicting completed capture identities fail.
Source journal paths are portable under the receiving Store root; attachment
destinations are bound to stable handler IDs, then resolved through the target's
actual installed configuration.

The separate native full-project handover carries installed code, Composer
lock/vendor, the original database/queue and actual public/private storage.
It must also carry the entire private Store root so pending source/media
publication can resume on the explicitly bound target.

# Catalogue workspace: native source and operation contract

This MIT bundle extends an installed Sylius application using the original Webgriffe SyliusAkeneoPlugin **3.1.0**, source commit **f5a38abc9537356dde16ad75f046f324a22ed6ec**. It preserves that plugin's ItemImport message, native importer, Messenger command bus and transport, Doctrine transaction, ProductVariantPreValidateEvent and ItemImportResult records. Installed Composer versions, original class bytes and configured handler/resolver definitions are part of every review.

Primary sources: [released connector](https://github.com/webgriffe/SyliusAkeneoPlugin/tree/f5a38abc9537356dde16ad75f046f324a22ed6ec), [native importer](https://github.com/webgriffe/SyliusAkeneoPlugin/blob/f5a38abc9537356dde16ad75f046f324a22ed6ec/src/Product/Importer.php), [bus middleware](https://github.com/webgriffe/SyliusAkeneoPlugin/blob/f5a38abc9537356dde16ad75f046f324a22ed6ec/config/packages/framework.php), [Akeneo PHP client v11](https://github.com/akeneo/api-php-client/tree/v11.0.0). The actual receiving site's Composer lock and configured services govern installation. Different connector versions require a source/integration review.

## Installation in an existing native project

Use the adjacent reviewed source installer in ../receiving. It stages this complete path package, resolves a candidate Composer lock without scripts or installation, and presents exact source/configuration postimages. The application requires ext-zip for the catalogue archive. Never run the connector's development test-app-init, database drop or fixture commands on an existing project.

Register Tjl\CatalogueWorkspace\TjlCatalogueWorkspaceBundle for all environments in the existing bundles.php. Import @TjlCatalogueWorkspaceBundle/config/routes.php under /%sylius_admin.path_name%/catalogue-workspace inside the existing admin firewall. The extension automatically registers its services; no replacement native bus or client is installed.

Configuration alias tjl_catalogue_workspace accepts directory, operator_role and max_export_bytes. directory must be an ordinary absolute private path shared by all original workers and operator processes, default %kernel.project_dir%/var/catalogue-workspace. operator_role defaults ROLE_ADMINISTRATION_ACCESS. max_export_bytes defaults 4 GiB and bounds expanded complete catalogue archives as well as their outer bytes. Native PHP memory limits and web upload limits remain actual host constraints; large files can use the streaming native command instead of browser upload.

The SourceServices compiler preserves the actual selected PSR HTTP client, original authenticated Akeneo builder/getters and native Sylius image uploader. It wraps only the file handler's filesystem and the uploader's storage adapter. Custom adapters must satisfy the original source/readback interfaces. Resource caching is disabled for the reviewed source scope.

Run the explicit install action to create only tjl_catalogue_record. It never alters native catalogue tables. Read engine next, and retain that actual response. The active source tree is authored and independently reviewed; native installed, browser and visual acceptance are completed by the actual receiving course, not by source inspection alone.

## Native command and actor

Run through the selected existing PHP and bin/console:

    /actual/php /actual/project/bin/console catalogue:workspace ACTION --input /private/input.json --operation-id original-command-id --actor existing-admin-username --output /private/result.json

Every action has a complete JSON object input, including {} for install, engine and projects. The actor must be an existing enabled Sylius administrator whose native role hierarchy includes the configured role. The retained actor identity is sylius-admin:ID:username. Browser actions derive the same identity from the existing authenticated native session and validate its CSRF token.

The result schema is tjl.catalogue.workspace-result.v1 with state, action, operation_id, project_id and result or error. A returned COMPLETE or WAITING_NATIVE envelope exits **0**. A thrown action returns ATTENTION and exits **1**. CLI input/parse/authorization errors also return the same error envelope when output can be written. A zero process exit with WAITING_NATIVE is an observed response, not a completed import.

The original command ID binds the exact action, input, project and actor. Repeating a completed command returns its retained result; repeating an incomplete capture drives the same source capture. dispatch and retry acknowledgements are retained independently from actual current operation status. The output file is atomically replaced with the current complete envelope; complete command and source history remain within the original project.

### Actions and exact input fields

All project actions require project_id.

| Action | Additional input | Result |
| --- | --- | --- |
| install | none | Own table installation status |
| engine | none | Actual packages, class hashes, mapping and engine sha256 |
| projects | offset, limit optional | Original project records, bounded page |
| project-create | label, identifiers[], locales[], channels[] | Original project and explicit active identifier claims |
| project | none | Project, complete cohort/import summaries and live-pending records |
| capture | capture_id optional, additional_requests[] optional | Complete selected capture/cohort page; same ID continues incomplete source |
| cohort | capture_id, offset, limit | rows, total, next_offset, original source descriptors |
| review | capture_id, identifier | Frozen source/native/mapping comparison with sha256 |
| missing-review | capture_id, identifier | Same explicit review for an observed missing source |
| approve | review_id, review_sha256, approve_native_mapping:true, rules[] | Exact immutable approval |
| dispatch | approval_id, import_operation_id optional | Original import operation and its observed state |
| retry | import_operation_id, preserve_original_approval:true | Same stamped import; current source/native checks remain authoritative |
| operation | import_operation_id | Actual current native/source/media state and original result IDs |
| retain-unapplied | import_operation_id, confirm_no_native_commit:true, reason | Explicit retained unapplied disposition; old stamp cannot mutate |
| missing-apply | review_id, review_sha256, confirm_selected_disable:true, acknowledge_access_boundary:true, disable_parent_if_no_enabled_variants optional | Actual bounded native disable effect |
| release-claim | identifier, resume_original_live_imports:true | Claim history retained, normal native import behavior restored |
| record | kind, id | One original review, approval, command, missing-effect, export, received, live-pending or result |
| files | none | All original project/source/journal blob descriptors |
| download | sha256, and CLI --destination /absolute/file | Complete SHA/size checked original file and its destination |
| export | none | Frozen catalogue ZIP descriptor and manifest identity |
| receive | archive_path | Same original project identity and accepted archive receipt |

The download action is a CLI/controller file operation; the browser uses its authenticated original download route. No caller-supplied filesystem path is accepted by the browser JSON dispatcher. Browser receiving uses a selected uploaded archive and retains its complete original bytes before entering the receiving transaction.

A field rule is {field_id, owner:"source"|"local", before_sha256, value?}. field_id and before_sha256 come from review.native.fields. Source ownership forbids replacement. Local ownership without value retains the exact reviewed native value; explicit value is validated by its native selector. Translation strings/null, enabled booleans, selected channel prices in integer minor units, attribute native values, taxons/positions, selected channels and dimension properties are supported. New native entities need an explicit local value when choosing local ownership.

Existing fields outside selected locales and channel prices, and onHand/onHold/tracked, remain local automatically. The complete original mapping runs inside the native transaction before ownership is applied at ProductVariantPreValidateEvent. The full source product and native mapping are shown together; the application does not invent a synthetic source-to-field projection.

## Original import continuity

A project claims only its explicitly selected product identifiers. A received ordinary unstamped ItemImport for an active claim is recorded as REVIEW_REQUIRED and sent through the installed failure transport as an unrecoverable message. It is never silently imported. Unselected traffic retains the original behavior.

An approved stamped import performs a fresh native GET traversal at actual handling. Complete method/URI/representation/body identities must match the frozen capture; an unknown dependency suspends before an unreviewed GET. Native getters then receive newly opened original response streams. Authentication remains with the original client and is never exported.

The handler locks and compares the actual reviewed native entities inside the original Doctrine transaction. Native importer and events run unchanged. The APPLIED row and native catalogue mutation commit together. A Doctrine observer records the actual generated ItemImportResult ID during its original flush. A duplicate of the same stamped operation never reapplies a surviving native commit.

A synchronous transport re-enters the same bus inside the original outer transaction. The active source context remains around the outermost call; media publication waits until that outer transaction is finished. Asynchronous admission may return QUEUED before the worker imports anything. Read operation to observe the actual result; never use queue acceptance, cursor advancement or process exit alone as completion.

If the database commit survives but a result is lost, APPLIED permits result-only recovery. If file publication is incomplete, MEDIA_PENDING, COMMIT_UNCERTAIN or NATIVE_RECEIPT_PENDING remains visibly waiting. The same operation reconciles original staged file intents; it does not reapply the catalogue mutation.

If source or native values changed, an unapplied operation can be explicitly retained with retain-unapplied. It cannot be reactivated by retry or an old queued stamp. A following capture/review/approval has new IDs and preserves all old evidence. This disposition does not delete transport messages or call an all-variant reconciler. A committed or uncertain publication cannot be disposed as unapplied.

A MISSING observation is the selected account's actual 404/access result. The explicit missing action obtains a following original capture and requires the item still missing and native state still equal. Only the selected variant is disabled. The optional parent action additionally requires no enabled variants. The original broad connector reconcile command is never invoked.

## Original files, export and receiving

Every complete source body, binary media response, media preimage/after-image, native command journal and review record retains its byte hash. Source and native import journals remain outside SQL rollback in the same selected private directory.

Export freezes its manifest and member descriptors before writing the ZIP. A resumed original export uses that same frozen cohort even when later project work exists. The archive is reopened and every member's name, size and SHA checked before its receipt is returned. No auth/token cache is exported.

Receive validates every member before original records are installed atomically. Exact same-archive continuation returns the accepted receipt without overwriting later local work. A different incoming archive cannot overwrite an already populated same-named project. Referenced native products/users/results still require the separately received original Sylius SQL/files/configuration graph.

Use the adjacent full native project tools for that installed application graph. Core catalogue export intentionally does not claim to reconstruct an unrelated shop database from review JSON. Receiving into the same original full native project preserves original IDs, claims and stamp/result continuity.

## Browser and required actual acceptance

The admin menu opens this bundle under the existing native firewall. The operator can create/open projects, capture and page the whole cohort, choose exact field ownership, approve/import, inspect real native result IDs, explicitly retain unapplied operations, review selected missing records, download originals and export/receive projects.

Browser pending actions are scoped to origin, native route, actor and project. Mutations retain complete input before dispatch. A lost response offers the same action; retained history/download permits a separate following action without cancelling original native work. Editable controls are held during a native request to prevent an awaited refresh from overwriting unsaved input. Current field drafts preserve malformed text until explicit validation.

The actual producing operator must open the exact installed pages and outgoing files, visually inspect real wide/narrow states, operate the important controls, verify downloaded original bytes, and reopen the same original project after interruption and on the selected second native site. Source parsing and DOM counts do not substitute for viewing. Keep native and visual acceptance honestly pending until those actual artifacts/results exist.

<?php
declare(strict_types=1);
namespace Tjl\CatalogueWorkspace\Command;

use Doctrine\Persistence\ObjectRepository;
use Symfony\Component\Console\Attribute\AsCommand;
use Symfony\Component\Console\Command\Command;
use Symfony\Component\Console\Input\InputArgument;
use Symfony\Component\Console\Input\InputInterface;
use Symfony\Component\Console\Input\InputOption;
use Symfony\Component\Console\Output\OutputInterface;
use Symfony\Component\Security\Core\Role\RoleHierarchyInterface;
use Tjl\CatalogueWorkspace\{Workspace,Store,ProjectArchive,Support};

#[AsCommand(name: 'catalogue:workspace', description: 'Operate the original selected catalogue project and native Akeneo import.')]
final class WorkspaceCommand extends Command
{
    public function __construct(
        private Workspace $workspace,
        private ObjectRepository $admins,
        private string $operatorRole,
        private RoleHierarchyInterface $roles,
        private ProjectArchive $archive,
        private Store $store,
    ) { parent::__construct(); }

    protected function configure(): void
    {
        $this->addArgument('action', InputArgument::REQUIRED, 'install, engine, projects, project-create, project, capture, cohort, review, missing-review, approve, dispatch, retry, operation, record, missing-apply, release-claim, retain-unapplied, files, download, export, receive')
            ->addOption('input', null, InputOption::VALUE_REQUIRED, 'Complete original JSON input file.')
            ->addOption('operation-id', null, InputOption::VALUE_REQUIRED, 'Retained original command identity.')
            ->addOption('actor', null, InputOption::VALUE_REQUIRED, 'Existing enabled Sylius administrator username.')
            ->addOption('output', null, InputOption::VALUE_REQUIRED, 'Private complete JSON result file.')
            ->addOption('destination', null, InputOption::VALUE_REQUIRED, 'For download only: exact selected original output file.');
    }

    protected function execute(InputInterface $input, OutputInterface $output): int
    {
        $action = (string) $input->getArgument('action');
        $operation = (string) $input->getOption('operation-id');
        $project = null;
        try {
            Support::id($operation);
            $username = (string) $input->getOption('actor');
            $admin = $username === '' ? null : $this->admins->findOneBy(['username' => $username]);
            if ($admin === null || !method_exists($admin, 'isEnabled') || !$admin->isEnabled() ||
                !in_array($this->operatorRole, $this->roles->getReachableRoleNames($admin->getRoles()), true)) {
                throw new \RuntimeException('Select the existing enabled native administrator with the configured operator role.');
            }
            $actor = 'sylius-admin:' . (string) $admin->getId() . ':' . $admin->getUserIdentifier();
            $path = (string) $input->getOption('input');
            if ($path === '' || is_link($path) || !is_file($path) || filesize($path) > 16777216) {
                throw new \InvalidArgumentException('Select a complete ordinary original JSON input file, bounded to 16 MiB.');
            }
            $raw = file_get_contents($path);
            if ($raw === false) { throw new \RuntimeException('Cannot read the complete original command input.'); }
            $data = json_decode($raw, true, 512, JSON_THROW_ON_ERROR);
            if (!is_array($data) || ($data !== [] && array_is_list($data))) { throw new \InvalidArgumentException('The action input must be a JSON object.'); }
            $project = isset($data['project_id']) ? Support::id($data['project_id']) : null;
            if ($action === 'download') {
                if ($project === null) { throw new \InvalidArgumentException('Select the original project.'); }
                $blob = $this->archive->selectedFile($project, Support::requiredString($data, 'sha256', 64));
                $destination = (string) $input->getOption('destination');
                $this->copyOriginal($this->store->blobPath($blob), $destination, $blob);
                $result = ['schema' => 'tjl.catalogue.workspace-result.v1', 'state' => 'COMPLETE', 'action' => $action,
                    'operation_id' => $operation, 'project_id' => $project, 'result' => ['file' => $blob, 'destination' => $destination]];
            } else { $result = $this->workspace->execute($action, $data, $operation, $actor); }
            $code = Command::SUCCESS; // WAITING_NATIVE is a complete native response, not an observed import success.
        } catch (\Throwable $error) {
            $result = ['schema' => 'tjl.catalogue.workspace-result.v1', 'state' => 'ATTENTION',
                'action' => $action, 'operation_id' => $operation, 'project_id' => $project,
                'error' => Support::error($error)];
            $code = Command::FAILURE;
        }
        $encoded = Support::json($result) . "\n";
        $out = (string) $input->getOption('output');
        try { if ($out !== '') { $this->writeResult($out, $encoded); } }
        catch (\Throwable $error) { ($output instanceof \Symfony\Component\Console\Output\ConsoleOutputInterface ? $output->getErrorOutput() : $output)->writeln($error->getMessage()); return Command::FAILURE; }
        $output->write($encoded);
        return $code;
    }

    private function ordinaryDestination(string $path): void
    {
        if ($path === '' || !str_starts_with($path, '/') || is_link($path) || !is_dir(dirname($path))) {
            throw new \InvalidArgumentException('Select an absolute ordinary destination in an existing private directory.');
        }
        $parent = dirname($path);
        while ($parent !== '/') {
            if (is_link($parent)) { throw new \InvalidArgumentException('A receiving destination parent is linked.'); }
            $parent = dirname($parent);
        }
    }

    private function writeResult(string $path, string $bytes): void
    {
        $this->ordinaryDestination($path);
        $temporary = tempnam(dirname($path), '.catalogue-result-');
        if ($temporary === false) { throw new \RuntimeException('Cannot retain the original command result.'); }
        try {
            chmod($temporary, 0600);
            if (file_put_contents($temporary, $bytes, LOCK_EX) !== strlen($bytes)) { throw new \RuntimeException('Incomplete command result.'); }
            $handle = fopen($temporary, 'r+b');
            if ($handle === false) { throw new \RuntimeException('Cannot sync command result.'); }
            try { if (!fsync($handle)) { throw new \RuntimeException('Cannot sync command result.'); } } finally { fclose($handle); }
            if (!rename($temporary, $path)) { throw new \RuntimeException('Cannot publish complete command result.'); }
        } finally { @unlink($temporary); }
    }

    private function copyOriginal(string $source, string $path, array $blob): void
    {
        $this->ordinaryDestination($path);
        if (file_exists($path)) {
            if (!is_file($path) || filesize($path) !== $blob['bytes'] || hash_file('sha256', $path) !== $blob['sha256']) {
                throw new \RuntimeException('The original download destination contains different bytes; retain it and choose another path.');
            }
            return;
        }
        $temporary = tempnam(dirname($path), '.catalogue-download-');
        if ($temporary === false) { throw new \RuntimeException('Cannot receive the original download.'); }
        try {
            if (!copy($source, $temporary) || filesize($temporary) !== $blob['bytes'] || hash_file('sha256', $temporary) !== $blob['sha256']) {
                throw new \RuntimeException('The complete original download differs.');
            }
            chmod($temporary, 0600);
            $handle = fopen($temporary, 'r+b');
            if ($handle === false) { throw new \RuntimeException('Cannot sync original download.'); }
            try { if (!fsync($handle)) { throw new \RuntimeException('Cannot sync original download.'); } } finally { fclose($handle); }
            if (!link($temporary, $path)) { throw new \RuntimeException('The original download destination changed concurrently.'); }
        } finally { @unlink($temporary); }
    }
}

<?php
declare(strict_types=1);
namespace Tjl\CatalogueWorkspace\Controller;

use Symfony\Component\HttpFoundation\{Request,Response,JsonResponse,BinaryFileResponse};
use Symfony\Component\HttpFoundation\ResponseHeaderBag;
use Symfony\Component\HttpKernel\Exception\AccessDeniedHttpException;
use Symfony\Component\Security\Core\Authorization\AuthorizationCheckerInterface;
use Symfony\Component\Security\Core\Authentication\Token\Storage\TokenStorageInterface;
use Symfony\Component\Security\Csrf\{CsrfToken,CsrfTokenManagerInterface};
use Tjl\CatalogueWorkspace\{Workspace,Store,ProjectArchive,Support};
use Twig\Environment;

final class AdminController
{
    public function __construct(
        private Workspace $workspace, private Store $store, private ProjectArchive $archive, private Environment $twig,
        private AuthorizationCheckerInterface $authorization, private TokenStorageInterface $tokens,
        private CsrfTokenManagerInterface $csrf, private string $operatorRole,
    ) {}

    private function actor(): string
    {
        $user = $this->tokens->getToken()?->getUser();
        if (!$this->authorization->isGranted($this->operatorRole) || !is_object($user) ||
            !method_exists($user, 'getId') || (method_exists($user, 'isEnabled') && !$user->isEnabled())) {
            throw new AccessDeniedHttpException('Use the existing enabled Sylius administrator session.');
        }
        return 'sylius-admin:' . (string) $user->getId() . ':' . $user->getUserIdentifier();
    }

    private function requireCsrf(Request $request): void
    {
        if (!$this->csrf->isTokenValid(new CsrfToken('catalogue-workspace', (string) $request->headers->get('X-CSRF-Token')))) {
            throw new AccessDeniedHttpException('The original administrator session token expired; reopen the workspace.');
        }
    }

    public function index(): Response
    {
        $actor = $this->actor();
        $response = new Response($this->twig->render('@TjlCatalogueWorkspace/workspace.html.twig',
            ['actor' => $actor, 'csrf' => $this->csrf->getToken('catalogue-workspace')->getValue()]));
        $response->headers->set('Cache-Control', 'private, no-store');
        $response->headers->set('Content-Security-Policy', "default-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self'; img-src 'self' data:; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'none'; frame-ancestors 'self'");
        $response->headers->set('Referrer-Policy', 'same-origin');
        return $response;
    }

    public function action(Request $request): JsonResponse
    {
        $actor = $this->actor(); $this->requireCsrf($request);
        $action = ''; $operation = ''; $project = null;
        try {
            if (strlen($request->getContent()) > 16777216) { throw new \InvalidArgumentException('Select an action input smaller than 16 MiB.'); }
            $body = json_decode($request->getContent(), true, 512, JSON_THROW_ON_ERROR);
            if (!is_array($body) || !is_array($body['input'] ?? null)) { throw new \InvalidArgumentException('Send the complete original action envelope.'); }
            $action = Support::requiredString($body, 'action', 64);
            $operation = Support::id(Support::requiredString($body, 'operation_id', 128));
            $project = $body['input']['project_id'] ?? null;
            // Initial schema installation is an explicit existing-host CLI action.
            if (in_array($action, ['install', 'receive'], true)) {
                throw new \InvalidArgumentException('Use the reviewed native host command or selected archive upload for this action.');
            }
            $result = $this->workspace->execute($action, $body['input'], $operation, $actor);
            return $this->json($result);
        } catch (\Throwable $error) {
            return $this->json(['schema' => 'tjl.catalogue.workspace-result.v1', 'state' => 'ATTENTION',
                'action' => $action, 'operation_id' => $operation, 'project_id' => $project, 'error' => Support::error($error)], 409);
        }
    }

    public function upload(Request $request): JsonResponse
    {
        $actor = $this->actor(); $this->requireCsrf($request);
        $project = (string) $request->request->get('project_id');
        $operation = (string) $request->request->get('operation_id');
        try {
            Support::id($project); Support::id($operation);
            $file = $request->files->get('archive');
            if (!$file instanceof \Symfony\Component\HttpFoundation\File\UploadedFile || !$file->isValid()) {
                throw new \InvalidArgumentException('Select the complete original catalogue ZIP.');
            }
            // Custody before the native transaction; the same SHA yields a stable input path on retry.
            $blob = $this->store->blobFile($file->getPathname());
            return $this->json($this->workspace->execute('receive',
                ['project_id' => $project, 'archive_path' => $this->store->blobPath($blob)], $operation, $actor));
        } catch (\Throwable $error) {
            return $this->json(['schema' => 'tjl.catalogue.workspace-result.v1', 'state' => 'ATTENTION',
                'action' => 'receive', 'operation_id' => $operation, 'project_id' => $project, 'error' => Support::error($error)], 409);
        }
    }

    public function download(string $project, string $sha): Response
    {
        $this->actor();
        $blob = $this->archive->selectedFile(Support::id($project), $sha);
        $response = new BinaryFileResponse($this->store->blobPath($blob));
        $response->setContentDisposition(ResponseHeaderBag::DISPOSITION_ATTACHMENT, $blob['name'] ?? $sha . '.bin');
        $response->headers->set('Content-Type', $blob['content_type'] ?? 'application/octet-stream');
        $response->headers->set('Cache-Control', 'private, no-store');
        $response->headers->set('X-Content-SHA256', $sha);
        $response->headers->set('X-Content-Type-Options', 'nosniff');
        return $response;
    }

    public function asset(string $name): Response
    {
        $this->actor();
        $types = ['workspace.js' => 'text/javascript', 'workspace.css' => 'text/css'];
        if (!isset($types[$name])) { throw new \Symfony\Component\HttpKernel\Exception\NotFoundHttpException(); }
        $path = dirname(__DIR__, 2) . '/public/' . $name;
        $body = file_get_contents($path);
        if ($body === false) { throw new \RuntimeException('The complete installed application asset is missing.'); }
        return new Response($body, 200, ['Content-Type' => $types[$name] . '; charset=utf-8',
            'Cache-Control' => 'private, no-cache', 'X-Content-Type-Options' => 'nosniff']);
    }

    private function json(array $value, int $status = 200): JsonResponse
    {
        $response = new JsonResponse(Support::json($value), $status, [], true);
        $response->headers->set('Cache-Control', 'private, no-store');
        $response->headers->set('X-Content-Type-Options', 'nosniff');
        return $response;
    }
}

use Symfony\Component\Config\Definition\Builder\TreeBuilder;

final class Configuration implements ConfigurationInterface
{

    {

<?php
declare(strict_types=1);
namespace Tjl\CatalogueWorkspace\DependencyInjection;

use Symfony\Component\DependencyInjection\Compiler\CompilerPassInterface;
use Symfony\Component\DependencyInjection\ContainerBuilder;
use Symfony\Component\DependencyInjection\Reference;
use Tjl\CatalogueWorkspace\Source\SourceServices;
use Tjl\CatalogueWorkspace\Engine;

final class NativePass implements CompilerPassInterface
{
    public function process(ContainerBuilder $container): void
    {
        foreach (['webgriffe_sylius_akeneo.message_handler.item_import', 'webgriffe_sylius_akeneo.middleware.item_import_result_persister',
            'webgriffe_sylius_akeneo.product.importer', 'webgriffe_sylius_akeneo.api_client.factory'] as $id) {
            if (!$container->hasDefinition($id)) { throw new \LogicException('The reviewed original Webgriffe service is missing: ' . $id); }
        }
        $mapping = [];
        $ids = array_keys($container->findTaggedServiceIds('webgriffe_sylius_akeneo.product.value_handler'));
        foreach (['webgriffe_sylius_akeneo.product.taxons_resolver', 'webgriffe_sylius_akeneo.product.product_options_resolver',
            'webgriffe_sylius_akeneo.product.channels_resolver', 'webgriffe_sylius_akeneo.product.status_resolver',
            'webgriffe_sylius_akeneo.product.variant_status_resolver', 'webgriffe_sylius_akeneo.product.validator'] as $id) { $ids[] = $id; }
        $ids = array_values(array_unique($ids));
        sort($ids, SORT_STRING);
        foreach ($ids as $id) {
            $definition = $container->findDefinition($id);
            $mapping[$id] = [
                'class' => $container->getParameterBag()->resolveValue($definition->getClass()),
                'arguments' => $this->describe($definition->getArguments()),
                'calls' => $this->describe($definition->getMethodCalls()),
                'tags' => $definition->getTags(),
            ];
        }
        $container->getDefinition(Engine::class)->setArgument('$mapping', $mapping);
        // The decorating handler has the one explicit native message tag.
        $container->getDefinition('webgriffe_sylius_akeneo.message_handler.item_import')->clearTag('messenger.message_handler');
        SourceServices::compile($container);
    }

    private function describe(mixed $value): mixed
    {
        if ($value instanceof Reference) { return ['service' => (string) $value]; }
        if (is_array($value)) { return array_map($this->describe(...), $value); }
        if (is_object($value)) {
            if ($value instanceof \Stringable) { return ['configuration_type' => $value::class, 'value' => (string) $value]; }
            throw new \LogicException('A selected native handler has an unsupported opaque configuration argument.');
        }
        return $value;
    }
}

<?php
declare(strict_types=1);
namespace Tjl\CatalogueWorkspace;

use Composer\InstalledVersions;
use Webgriffe\SyliusAkeneoPlugin\Message\ItemImport;
use Webgriffe\SyliusAkeneoPlugin\Product\Importer;
use Webgriffe\SyliusAkeneoPlugin\Middleware\ItemImportResultPersisterMiddleware;

final class Engine
{
    public function __construct(private array $mapping) {}

    public function describe(): array
    {
        $package = 'webgriffe/sylius-akeneo-plugin';
        if (!InstalledVersions::isInstalled($package)) { throw new \RuntimeException('The original Webgriffe Akeneo plugin is not installed.'); }
        $version = InstalledVersions::getPrettyVersion($package);
        if (ltrim((string) $version, 'v') !== '3.1.0') {
            throw new \RuntimeException('This native integration is pinned to the reviewed Webgriffe 3.1.0 contract; review an installed version change before adoption.');
        }
        $files = [];
        $classes = [ItemImport::class, Importer::class, ItemImportResultPersisterMiddleware::class,
            \Webgriffe\SyliusAkeneoPlugin\Event\ProductVariantPreValidateEvent::class];
        foreach ($this->mapping as $definition) {
            if (is_string($definition['class'] ?? null) && $definition['class'] !== '') { $classes[] = $definition['class']; }
        }
        $classes = array_values(array_unique($classes));
        sort($classes, SORT_STRING);
        foreach ($classes as $class) {
            $path = (new \ReflectionClass($class))->getFileName();
            if ($path === false || !is_file($path)) { throw new \RuntimeException('Cannot retain the original native class source identity.'); }
            $files[] = ['class' => $class, 'bytes' => filesize($path), 'sha256' => hash_file('sha256', $path)];
        }
        $packages = [];
        foreach ([$package, 'sylius/sylius', 'sylius/core', 'akeneo/api-php-client', 'symfony/messenger', 'doctrine/orm', 'doctrine/dbal'] as $name) {
            if (InstalledVersions::isInstalled($name)) {
                $packages[$name] = ['version' => InstalledVersions::getPrettyVersion($name), 'reference' => InstalledVersions::getReference($name)];
            }
        }
        $result = ['schema' => 'tjl.catalogue.native-engine.v1', 'packages' => $packages,
            'php_version' => PHP_VERSION, 'native_classes' => $files, 'mapping' => $this->mapping,
            'message' => ItemImport::class, 'bus' => 'webgriffe_sylius_akeneo.command_bus',
            'result_entity' => \Webgriffe\SyliusAkeneoPlugin\Entity\ItemImportResult::class];
        $result['sha256'] = Support::hash($result);
        return $result;
    }

    public function assertSame(string $sha): array
    {
        $current = $this->describe();
        if (!hash_equals($sha, $current['sha256'])) {
            throw new \RuntimeException('The installed native mapping, dependency or class source changed after review.');
        }
        return $current;
    }
}

<?php
declare(strict_types=1);
namespace Tjl\CatalogueWorkspace\Import;

use Tjl\CatalogueWorkspace\Store;
use Tjl\CatalogueWorkspace\Support;
use Tjl\CatalogueWorkspace\NativeCatalogue;
use Tjl\CatalogueWorkspace\Engine;
use Webgriffe\SyliusAkeneoPlugin\Message\ItemImport;
use Webgriffe\SyliusAkeneoPlugin\MessageHandler\ItemImportHandler;

/** Wraps the unchanged handler inside its existing Doctrine transaction. */
final class Handler
{
    public function __construct(
        private ItemImportHandler $inner,
        private Runtime $runtime,
        private Store $store,
        private NativeCatalogue $catalogue,
        private Engine $engine,
    ) {}

    public function __invoke(ItemImport $message): void
    {
        $context = $this->runtime->current();
        if ($context === null || !isset($context['stamp'])) {
            ($this->inner)($message);
            return;
        }
        $stamp = $context['stamp'];
        $operation = $this->store->require('import', $stamp->operationId, $stamp->projectId);
        if ($operation['approval_id'] !== $stamp->approvalId || $operation['identifier'] !== $message->getAkeneoIdentifier() || $message->getAkeneoEntity() !== 'Product') {
            throw new \RuntimeException('The native message differs from its retained original operation.');
        }
        if (in_array($operation['state'], ['APPLIED', 'COMPLETE'], true)) {
            return; // Original commit is authoritative, including an absent native result.
        }
        if (!in_array($operation['state'], ['PREPARED', 'DISPATCHING', 'QUEUED', 'ATTENTION'], true)) {
            throw new \RuntimeException('This native operation cannot be applied in its current retained state.');
        }
        $approval = $this->store->require('approval', $stamp->approvalId, $stamp->projectId);
        $claim = $this->store->require('claim', Support::hash($message->getAkeneoIdentifier()), $stamp->projectId);
        if (($claim['active'] ?? false) !== true || ($claim['approval_id'] ?? null) !== $stamp->approvalId) {
            throw new \RuntimeException('The selected item no longer has this exact active approval.');
        }
        $project = $this->store->require('project', $stamp->projectId, $stamp->projectId);
        $this->engine->assertSame($approval['engine_sha256']);
        if (!$this->store->connection()->isTransactionActive()) {
            throw new \RuntimeException('The original Doctrine transaction middleware must surround the native handler.');
        }
        // This CAS write locks the original native row until the same transaction commits.
        $operation['state'] = 'APPLYING';
        $operation['native_started_at'] = Support::now();
        $operation = $this->store->save($operation);
        $before = $this->catalogue->read($approval['identifier'], $approval['parent'], $project['selection']['locales'], true);
        if (!hash_equals($approval['native_sha256'], $before['sha256'])) {
            throw new \RuntimeException('Native Sylius values changed since approval. Capture a following review before importing.');
        }
        $this->runtime->update(['approval' => $approval, 'project' => $project, 'before' => $before, 'ownership_applied' => false]);
        ($this->inner)($message);
        if (($this->runtime->current()['ownership_applied'] ?? false) !== true) {
            throw new \RuntimeException('The original ProductVariantPreValidateEvent ownership boundary was not observed.');
        }
        $after = $this->catalogue->read($approval['identifier'], $approval['parent'], $project['selection']['locales']);
        $operation = $this->store->require('import', $stamp->operationId, $stamp->projectId);
        $operation['state'] = 'APPLIED';
        $operation['native_before'] = $before['snapshot'];
        $operation['native_after'] = $after['snapshot'];
        $operation['native_after_sha256'] = $after['sha256'];
        $operation['native_applied_at'] = Support::now();
        $operation['source_sha256'] = $approval['source_sha256'];
        $this->store->save($operation);
        // Original Doctrine middleware flushes/commits both native entities and this marker.
    }
}

<?php
declare(strict_types=1);
namespace Tjl\CatalogueWorkspace\Import;

use Symfony\Component\Messenger\Envelope;
use Symfony\Component\Messenger\Exception\UnrecoverableMessageHandlingException;
use Symfony\Component\Messenger\Middleware\MiddlewareInterface;
use Symfony\Component\Messenger\Middleware\StackInterface;
use Symfony\Component\Messenger\Stamp\ReceivedStamp;
use Tjl\CatalogueWorkspace\Store;
use Tjl\CatalogueWorkspace\Support;
use Tjl\CatalogueWorkspace\Source\SourceGateway;
use Webgriffe\SyliusAkeneoPlugin\Message\ItemImport;

/** The original result middleware and transport remain installed underneath. */
final class Middleware implements MiddlewareInterface
{
    public function __construct(
        private MiddlewareInterface $inner,
        private Runtime $runtime,
        private Store $store,
        private SourceGateway $source,
    ) {}

    public function handle(Envelope $envelope, StackInterface $stack): Envelope
    {
        $message = $envelope->getMessage();
        if (!$message instanceof ItemImport || $message->getAkeneoEntity() !== 'Product') {
            return $this->inner->handle($envelope, $stack);
        }
        $stamp = $envelope->last(ImportStamp::class);
        if ($stamp === null) {
            if ($envelope->last(ReceivedStamp::class) === null) { return $this->inner->handle($envelope, $stack); }
            $claim = $this->store->object('claim', Support::hash($message->getAkeneoIdentifier()));
            if (($claim['active'] ?? false) === true) {
                $projectId = $claim['_record']['project_id'];
                $noticeId = Support::hash(['project' => $projectId, 'identifier' => $message->getAkeneoIdentifier()]);
                $notice = $this->store->object('live-pending', $noticeId);
                $value = ['identifier' => $message->getAkeneoIdentifier(), 'state' => 'REVIEW_REQUIRED', 'observed_at' => Support::now(),
                    'reason' => 'An original live ItemImport reached an explicitly claimed review cohort without its approval stamp.'];
                $this->store->put('live-pending', $noticeId, $projectId, $value, $notice['_record']['revision'] ?? null);
                throw new UnrecoverableMessageHandlingException('This selected catalogue item awaits its original workspace review; inspect the existing native failed-message transport and project.');
            }
            return $this->inner->handle($envelope, $stack);
        }
        $nested = $this->runtime->current();
        if (($nested['stamp']->operationId ?? null) === $stamp->operationId && ($nested['stamp']->projectId ?? null) === $stamp->projectId) {
            return $this->inner->handle($envelope, $stack);
        }
        return $this->store->lock('project:' . $stamp->projectId, function () use ($stamp, $message, $envelope, $stack): Envelope {
            $operation = $this->store->require('import', $stamp->operationId, $stamp->projectId);
            if ($operation['approval_id'] !== $stamp->approvalId || $operation['identifier'] !== $message->getAkeneoIdentifier()) {
                throw new UnrecoverableMessageHandlingException('Original catalogue message and operation binding differ.');
            }
            if ($operation['state'] === 'RETAINED_UNAPPLIED') {
                throw new UnrecoverableMessageHandlingException('This exact original operation was explicitly retained unapplied; preserve its native message and follow the new review.');
            }
            $approval = $this->store->require('approval', $stamp->approvalId, $stamp->projectId);
            $snapshot = $this->source->inspect($approval['capture_id']);
            $attemptId = bin2hex(random_bytes(16));
            $start = ['project_id' => $stamp->projectId, 'operation_id' => $stamp->operationId, 'approval_id' => $stamp->approvalId,
                'identifier' => $message->getAkeneoIdentifier(), 'started_at' => Support::now(),
                'native_commit_already_present' => $operation['state'] === 'APPLIED'];
            $this->store->journal('import-' . $attemptId . '-start', $start);
            try {
                $result = $this->runtime->enter(['stamp' => $stamp, 'attempt_id' => $attemptId], function () use ($operation, $stamp, $snapshot, $envelope, $stack): Envelope {
                    return $this->source->withApproved($stamp->projectId, $stamp->operationId, $snapshot,
                        fn (): Envelope => $operation['state'] === 'COMPLETE' ? $envelope : $this->inner->handle($envelope, $stack));
                });
                $this->store->journal('import-' . $attemptId . '-returned', $start + [
                    'returned_at' => Support::now(), 'operation' => $this->store->require('import', $stamp->operationId, $stamp->projectId),
                ]);
                return $result;
            } catch (\Throwable $error) {
                // The file journal survives a rollback or closed native EntityManager.
                $this->store->journal('import-' . $attemptId . '-error', $start + ['error' => Support::error($error)]);
                try {
                    $current = $this->store->require('import', $stamp->operationId, $stamp->projectId);
                    if (!in_array($current['state'], ['APPLIED', 'COMPLETE', 'RETAINED_UNAPPLIED'], true)) {
                        $current['state'] = 'ATTENTION';
                        $current['last_error'] = Support::error($error);
                        $current['last_attempt_id'] = $attemptId;
                        $this->store->save($current);
                    }
                } catch (\Throwable) {
                    // Original worker/failure transport and immutable file journal remain authoritative.
                }
                throw $error;
            }
        });
    }
}

declare(strict_types=1);
namespace Tjl\CatalogueWorkspace\Import;

use Doctrine\ORM\Event\PostPersistEventArgs;
use Tjl\CatalogueWorkspace\Store;
use Tjl\CatalogueWorkspace\Support;
use Webgriffe\SyliusAkeneoPlugin\Entity\ItemImportResultInterface;

/** Stores the actual native generated ID inside its original flush transaction. */
final class ResultObserver
{
    public function __construct(private Runtime $runtime, private Store $store) {}
    public function postPersist(PostPersistEventArgs $event): void
    {
        $result = $event->getObject();
        $context = $this->runtime->current();
        if (!$result instanceof ItemImportResultInterface || $context === null || !isset($context['stamp'])) { return; }
        $stamp = $context['stamp'];
        $operation = $this->store->require('import', $stamp->operationId, $stamp->projectId);
        if ($result->getAkeneoEntity() !== 'Product' || $result->getAkeneoIdentifier() !== $operation['identifier']) {
            throw new \RuntimeException('The native result does not match the original selected item.');
        }
        if ($result->getId() === null) { throw new \RuntimeException('The native result has no actual generated identity.'); }
        $receipt = [
            'operation_id' => $stamp->operationId, 'approval_id' => $stamp->approvalId,
            'native_id' => (string) $result->getId(), 'entity' => $result->getAkeneoEntity(),
            'identifier' => $result->getAkeneoIdentifier(), 'successful' => $result->isSuccessful(),
            'message' => $result->getMessage(), 'created_at' => $result->getCreatedAt()->format(DATE_ATOM),
        ];
        $id = Support::hash(['operation' => $stamp->operationId, 'native_result' => $receipt['native_id']]);
        $this->store->original('result', $id, $stamp->projectId, $receipt);
        $operation['native_result_ids'] = array_values(array_unique(array_merge($operation['native_result_ids'] ?? [], [$receipt['native_id']])));
        $operation['last_native_result'] = $receipt;
        if ($result->isSuccessful() && in_array($operation['state'], ['APPLIED', 'COMPLETE'], true)) {
            $operation['state'] = 'COMPLETE';
        }
        $this->store->save($operation);
    }
}

<?php
declare(strict_types=1);
namespace Tjl\CatalogueWorkspace\Import;

/** One synchronous native Messenger call stack; never a replacement queue. */
final class Runtime
{
    private array $stack = [];
    public function current(): ?array { return $this->stack === [] ? null : $this->stack[array_key_last($this->stack)]; }
    public function enter(array $value, callable $callback): mixed
    {
        $depth = count($this->stack);
        $this->stack[] = $value;
        try { return $callback(); }
        finally { $this->stack = array_slice($this->stack, 0, $depth); }
    }
    public function update(array $value): void
    {
        if ($this->stack === []) { throw new \LogicException('No original native import context.'); }
        $this->stack[array_key_last($this->stack)] = array_replace($this->current(), $value);
    }
}
