<?php
declare(strict_types=1);

namespace Tjl\CatalogueWorkspace;

use Doctrine\ORM\EntityManagerInterface;
use Psr\Container\ContainerInterface;
use Sylius\Component\Core\Model\ProductInterface;
use Sylius\Component\Core\Model\ProductVariantInterface;
use Webgriffe\SyliusAkeneoPlugin\Event\ProductVariantPreValidateEvent;

/** Native entities remain the authority. No source value is coerced into a price. */
final class NativeCatalogue
{
    public function __construct(
        private EntityManagerInterface $em,
        private ContainerInterface $repositories,
        private ContainerInterface $factories,
        private \Symfony\Contracts\EventDispatcher\EventDispatcherInterface $events,
    ) {}

    public function validateScope(array $locales, array $channels): void
    {
        foreach (['locale' => $locales, 'channel' => $channels] as $kind => $codes) {
            foreach ($codes as $code) {
                if ($this->repositories->get($kind)->findOneBy(['code' => $code]) === null) {
                    throw new \InvalidArgumentException('Select an existing native Sylius ' . $kind . ': ' . $code);
                }
            }
        }
    }

    public function read(string $identifier, ?string $parent, array $locales, bool $lock = false): array
    {
        $variant = $this->repositories->get('variant')->findOneBy(['code' => $identifier]);
        $targetCode = $parent ?? $identifier;
        $product = $this->repositories->get('product')->findOneBy(['code' => $targetCode]);
        if ($lock && $variant !== null) {
            if (!$this->em->getConnection()->isTransactionActive()) { throw new \RuntimeException('Native catalogue import requires its original Doctrine transaction.'); }
            $this->em->lock($variant, \Doctrine\DBAL\LockMode::PESSIMISTIC_WRITE);
            $this->em->refresh($variant);
        }
        $previous = $variant?->getProduct();
        $legacy = $this->repositories->get('product')->findOneBy(['code' => $identifier]);
        if ($lock) {
            if (!$this->em->getConnection()->isTransactionActive()) {
                throw new \RuntimeException('Native catalogue import requires its original Doctrine transaction.');
            }
            $entities = [];
            foreach ([$variant, $product, $previous, $legacy] as $entity) {
                if ($entity !== null) { $entities[$entity::class . ':' . (string) $entity->getId()] = $entity; }
            }
            ksort($entities, SORT_STRING);
            foreach ($entities as $entity) {
                $this->em->lock($entity, \Doctrine\DBAL\LockMode::PESSIMISTIC_WRITE);
                $this->em->refresh($entity);
            }
        }
        $fields = [];
        $objects = [];
        $add = static function (array $selector, mixed $value, mixed $object = null) use (&$fields, &$objects): void {
            $id = Support::hash($selector);
            $fields[$id] = ['id' => $id, 'selector' => $selector, 'value' => $value, 'value_sha256' => Support::hash($value)];
            if ($object !== null) { $objects[$id] = $object; }
        };
        foreach (['product' => $product, 'variant' => $variant] as $name => $entity) {
            $add(['entity' => $name, 'kind' => 'enabled'], $entity?->isEnabled());
            $translations = [];
            foreach ($entity?->getTranslations() ?? [] as $translation) {
                $translations[$translation->getLocale()] = $translation;
            }
            $properties = $name === 'product'
                ? ['name', 'description', 'shortDescription', 'slug', 'metaKeywords', 'metaDescription']
                : ['name'];
            $allLocales = array_values(array_unique(array_merge($locales, array_keys($translations))));
            sort($allLocales, SORT_STRING);
            foreach ($allLocales as $locale) {
                foreach ($properties as $property) {
                    $translation = $translations[$locale] ?? null;
                    $getter = 'get' . ucfirst($property);
                    $value = $translation === null ? null : $translation->$getter();
                    $add(['entity' => $name, 'kind' => 'translation', 'locale' => $locale, 'property' => $property], $value, $translation);
                }
            }
        }
        $channels = [];
        foreach ($product?->getChannels() ?? [] as $channel) { $channels[] = $channel->getCode(); }
        sort($channels, SORT_STRING);
        $add(['entity' => 'product', 'kind' => 'channels'], $channels, $product?->getChannels()->toArray() ?? []);
        $taxons = [];
        foreach ($product?->getProductTaxons() ?? [] as $taxon) {
            $taxons[] = ['code' => $taxon->getTaxon()->getCode(), 'position' => $taxon->getPosition()];
        }
        usort($taxons, static fn ($a, $b) => strcmp($a['code'], $b['code']));
        $add(['entity' => 'product', 'kind' => 'taxons'], $taxons, $product?->getProductTaxons()->toArray() ?? []);
        foreach ($product?->getAttributes() ?? [] as $attribute) {
            $add(['entity' => 'product', 'kind' => 'attribute', 'code' => $attribute->getAttribute()->getCode(), 'locale' => $attribute->getLocaleCode()],
                $attribute->getValue(), $attribute);
        }
        foreach ($variant?->getChannelPricings() ?? [] as $price) {
            $add(['entity' => 'variant', 'kind' => 'pricing', 'channel' => $price->getChannelCode()],
                ['price' => $price->getPrice(), 'originalPrice' => $price->getOriginalPrice(), 'minimumPrice' => $price->getMinimumPrice()], $price);
        }
        foreach (['weight', 'width', 'height', 'depth', 'onHand', 'onHold', 'tracked', 'shippingRequired'] as $property) {
            $getter = in_array($property, ['tracked', 'shippingRequired'], true) ? 'is' . ucfirst($property) : 'get' . ucfirst($property);
            $add(['entity' => 'variant', 'kind' => 'scalar', 'property' => $property], $variant === null ? null : $variant->$getter());
        }
        ksort($fields, SORT_STRING);
        $snapshot = [
            'identifier' => $identifier, 'target_product_code' => $targetCode,
            'variant' => $this->entityIdentity($variant),
            'product' => $this->entityIdentity($product),
            'previous_product' => $this->entityIdentity($previous),
            'legacy_product' => $this->entityIdentity($legacy),
            'fields' => $fields,
            'product_options' => $this->codes($product?->getOptions() ?? []),
            'variant_options' => $this->codes($variant?->getOptionValues() ?? []),
            'images' => $this->images($product),
        ];
        return ['snapshot' => $snapshot, 'sha256' => Support::hash($snapshot), 'objects' => $objects];
    }

    public function validateRules(array $snapshot, array $rules, array $scope): array
    {
        if (!array_is_list($rules) || count($rules) > 10000) {
            throw new \InvalidArgumentException('Select explicit bounded field ownership decisions.');
        }
        $seen = [];
        foreach ($rules as $rule) {
            $id = Support::requiredString($rule, 'field_id', 64);
            $field = $snapshot['fields'][$id] ?? throw new \InvalidArgumentException('Select an original reviewed native field.');
            if (isset($seen[$id]) || !in_array($rule['owner'] ?? null, ['local', 'source'], true)) {
                throw new \InvalidArgumentException('Each native field has one explicit local/source owner.');
            }
            $seen[$id] = true;
            $selector = $field['selector'];
            $protected = (isset($selector['locale']) && $selector['locale'] !== null && !in_array($selector['locale'], $scope['locales'], true))
                || ($selector['kind'] === 'pricing' && !in_array($selector['channel'], $scope['channels'], true))
                || ($selector['kind'] === 'scalar' && in_array($selector['property'], ['onHand', 'onHold', 'tracked'], true));
            if ($protected && ($rule['owner'] !== 'local' || (array_key_exists('value', $rule) && Support::hash($rule['value']) !== $field['value_sha256']))) {
                throw new \InvalidArgumentException('This field is outside the selected editorial locale/channel scope or belongs to native stock; preserve its original local value.');
            }
            if (($rule['before_sha256'] ?? null) !== $field['value_sha256']) {
                throw new \RuntimeException('The field ownership decision no longer names its original local value.');
            }
            if ($rule['owner'] === 'source' && array_key_exists('value', $rule)) {
                throw new \InvalidArgumentException('Source-owned fields retain the native connector value without replacement.');
            }
            if (array_key_exists('value', $rule)) { $this->validateValue($field['selector'], $rule['value']); }
            if ($rule['owner'] === 'local' && $snapshot[$field['selector']['entity']] === null && !array_key_exists('value', $rule)) {
                throw new \InvalidArgumentException('A new native entity needs an explicit local value or source ownership.');
            }
        }
        return $rules;
    }

    public function applyLocal(ProductVariantPreValidateEvent $event, array $snapshot, array $objects, array $rules): void
    {
        foreach ($rules as $rule) {
            if ($rule['owner'] !== 'local') { continue; }
            $field = $snapshot['fields'][$rule['field_id']];
            $selector = $field['selector'];
            $value = array_key_exists('value', $rule) ? $rule['value'] : $field['value'];
            $entity = $selector['entity'] === 'product' ? $event->getProduct() : $event->getProductVariant();
            $object = $objects[$field['id']] ?? null;
            $this->validateValue($selector, $value);
            switch ($selector['kind']) {
                case 'enabled':
                    $entity->setEnabled($value);
                    break;
                case 'translation':
                    $translation = null;
                    foreach ($entity->getTranslations() as $candidate) {
                        if ($candidate->getLocale() === $selector['locale']) { $translation = $candidate; break; }
                    }
                    if ($translation === null) {
                        $translation = $object ?? $this->factories->get($selector['entity'] . '_translation')->createNew();
                        $translation->setLocale($selector['locale']);
                        $entity->addTranslation($translation);
                    }
                    $setter = 'set' . ucfirst($selector['property']);
                    $translation->$setter($value);
                    break;
                case 'scalar':
                    $setter = 'set' . ucfirst($selector['property']);
                    $entity->$setter($value);
                    break;
                case 'attribute':
                    $existing = null;
                    foreach ($entity->getAttributes() as $candidate) {
                        if ($candidate->getAttribute()->getCode() === $selector['code'] && $candidate->getLocaleCode() === $selector['locale']) {
                            $existing = $candidate; break;
                        }
                    }
                    $attributeValue = $existing ?? $object ?? $this->factories->get('attribute_value')->createNew();
                    if ($attributeValue->getAttribute() === null) {
                        $attribute = $this->repositories->get('attribute')->findOneBy(['code' => $selector['code']]);
                        if ($attribute === null) { throw new \RuntimeException('The selected original Sylius attribute disappeared.'); }
                        $attributeValue->setAttribute($attribute);
                    }
                    $attributeValue->setLocaleCode($selector['locale']);
                    $attributeValue->setValue($value);
                    $entity->addAttribute($attributeValue);
                    break;
                case 'pricing':
                    $price = null;
                    foreach ($entity->getChannelPricings() as $candidate) {
                        if ($candidate->getChannelCode() === $selector['channel']) { $price = $candidate; break; }
                    }
                    $price ??= $object ?? $this->factories->get('channel_pricing')->createNew();
                    $price->setChannelCode($selector['channel']);
                    foreach ($value as $key => $amount) {
                        $setter = 'set' . ucfirst($key);
                        $price->$setter($amount);
                    }
                    $entity->addChannelPricing($price);
                    break;
                case 'channels':
                    foreach ($entity->getChannels()->toArray() as $channel) { $entity->removeChannel($channel); }
                    foreach ($value as $code) {
                        $channel = $this->repositories->get('channel')->findOneBy(['code' => $code]);
                        if ($channel === null) { throw new \RuntimeException('An approved original channel disappeared.'); }
                        $entity->addChannel($channel);
                    }
                    break;
                case 'taxons':
                    $old = [];
                    foreach (is_array($object) ? $object : [] as $taxon) { $old[$taxon->getTaxon()->getCode()] = $taxon; }
                    foreach ($entity->getProductTaxons()->toArray() as $taxon) { $entity->removeProductTaxon($taxon); }
                    foreach ($value as $row) {
                        $taxon = $this->repositories->get('taxon')->findOneBy(['code' => $row['code']]);
                        if ($taxon === null) { throw new \RuntimeException('An approved original taxon disappeared.'); }
                        $relation = $old[$row['code']] ?? $this->factories->get('product_taxon')->createNew();
                        $relation->setTaxon($taxon);
                        $relation->setPosition($row['position']);
                        $entity->addProductTaxon($relation);
                    }
                    break;
                default: throw new \LogicException('Unknown native field selector.');
            }
        }
    }

    /** Preserve every locale/channel outside the explicitly selected cohort scope. */
    public function protectBoundary(ProductVariantPreValidateEvent $event, array $snapshot, array $objects, array $scope): void
    {
        $locales = $scope['locales'];
        $channels = $scope['channels'];
        $automatic = [];
        foreach ($snapshot['fields'] as $field) {
            $selector = $field['selector'];
            $outside = (isset($selector['locale']) && $selector['locale'] !== null && !in_array($selector['locale'], $locales, true))
                || ($selector['kind'] === 'pricing' && !in_array($selector['channel'], $channels, true))
                || ($selector['kind'] === 'scalar' && in_array($selector['property'], ['onHand', 'onHold', 'tracked'], true));
            if ($outside && $snapshot[$selector['entity']] !== null) {
                $automatic[] = ['field_id' => $field['id'], 'owner' => 'local', 'before_sha256' => $field['value_sha256']];
            }
        }
        foreach (['product' => $event->getProduct(), 'variant' => $event->getProductVariant()] as $name => $entity) {
            $oldLocales = [];
            foreach ($snapshot['fields'] as $field) {
                if ($field['selector']['entity'] === $name && $field['selector']['kind'] === 'translation' && isset($objects[$field['id']])) {
                    $oldLocales[$field['selector']['locale']] = true;
                }
            }
            foreach ($entity->getTranslations()->toArray() as $translation) {
                if (!in_array($translation->getLocale(), $locales, true) && !isset($oldLocales[$translation->getLocale()])) {
                    $entity->removeTranslation($translation);
                }
            }
        }
        $oldAttributes = [];
        $oldPrices = [];
        foreach ($snapshot['fields'] as $field) {
            if ($field['selector']['kind'] === 'attribute') { $oldAttributes[Support::hash($field['selector'])] = true; }
            if ($field['selector']['kind'] === 'pricing') { $oldPrices[$field['selector']['channel']] = true; }
        }
        foreach ($event->getProduct()->getAttributes()->toArray() as $attribute) {
            $locale = $attribute->getLocaleCode();
            $selector = ['entity' => 'product', 'kind' => 'attribute', 'code' => $attribute->getAttribute()->getCode(), 'locale' => $locale];
            if ($locale !== null && !in_array($locale, $locales, true) && !isset($oldAttributes[Support::hash($selector)])) {
                $event->getProduct()->removeAttribute($attribute);
            }
        }
        foreach ($event->getProductVariant()->getChannelPricings()->toArray() as $price) {
            if (!in_array($price->getChannelCode(), $channels, true) && !isset($oldPrices[$price->getChannelCode()])) {
                $event->getProductVariant()->removeChannelPricing($price);
            }
        }
        $this->applyLocal($event, $snapshot, $objects, $automatic);
        $channelSelector = Support::hash(['entity' => 'product', 'kind' => 'channels']);
        $before = $snapshot['fields'][$channelSelector]['value'];
        $desired = array_values(array_filter($before, static fn ($code) => !in_array($code, $channels, true)));
        foreach ($event->getProduct()->getChannels() as $channel) {
            if (in_array($channel->getCode(), $channels, true)) { $desired[] = $channel->getCode(); }
        }
        $desired = array_values(array_unique($desired));
        sort($desired, SORT_STRING);
        $this->applyLocal($event, $snapshot, $objects, [[
            'field_id' => $channelSelector, 'owner' => 'local',
            'before_sha256' => $snapshot['fields'][$channelSelector]['value_sha256'], 'value' => $desired,
        ]]);
    }

    public function disableSelected(string $identifier, array $expected, bool $disableProduct): array
    {
        $variant = $this->repositories->get('variant')->findOneBy(['code' => $identifier]);
        if (!$variant instanceof ProductVariantInterface) { throw new \RuntimeException('The selected original variant disappeared.'); }
        $variant->setEnabled(false);
        $product = $variant->getProduct();
        if ($disableProduct) {
            if ($product === null || count($product->getEnabledVariants()) > 0) {
                throw new \RuntimeException('The original parent still has enabled variants; its disable selection must be reviewed again.');
            }
            $product->setEnabled(false);
        }
        $changed = [['product_variant', $variant]];
        if ($disableProduct && $product !== null) { $changed[] = ['product', $product]; }
        foreach ($changed as [$name, $entity]) {
            $event = new \Sylius\Bundle\ResourceBundle\Event\ResourceControllerEvent($entity);
            $event->setArgument('catalogue_workspace_selected_missing', true);
            $this->events->dispatch($event, 'sylius.' . $name . '.pre_update');
            if ($event->isStopped()) { throw new \RuntimeException('The native resource workflow stopped the selected missing-record change.'); }
        }
        $this->em->flush();
        foreach ($changed as [$name, $entity]) {
            $event = new \Sylius\Bundle\ResourceBundle\Event\ResourceControllerEvent($entity);
            $event->setArgument('catalogue_workspace_selected_missing', true);
            $this->events->dispatch($event, 'sylius.' . $name . '.post_update');
        }
        return ['identifier' => $identifier, 'variant_enabled' => $variant->isEnabled(), 'product_enabled' => $product?->isEnabled()];
    }

    private function entityIdentity(?object $entity): ?array
    {
        if ($entity === null) { return null; }
        $result = ['class' => $this->em->getClassMetadata($entity::class)->getName(), 'id' => (string) $entity->getId(), 'code' => $entity->getCode(), 'enabled' => $entity->isEnabled()];
        if (method_exists($entity, 'getVersion')) { $result['version'] = $entity->getVersion(); }
        if (method_exists($entity, 'getVariants')) {
            $result['variants'] = $this->codes($entity->getVariants());
        }
        return $result;
    }

    private function codes(iterable $entities): array
    {
        $values = [];
        foreach ($entities as $entity) { $values[] = $entity->getCode(); }
        sort($values, SORT_STRING);
        return $values;
    }

    private function images(?ProductInterface $product): array
    {
        $values = [];
        foreach ($product?->getImages() ?? [] as $image) {
            $values[] = ['id' => (string) $image->getId(), 'type' => $image->getType(), 'path' => $image->getPath(),
                'variants' => method_exists($image, 'getProductVariants') ? $this->codes($image->getProductVariants()) : []];
        }
        usort($values, static fn ($a, $b) => strcmp($a['id'], $b['id']));
        return $values;
    }

    private function validateValue(array $selector, mixed $value): void
    {
        switch ($selector['kind']) {
            case 'enabled':
                if (!is_bool($value)) { throw new \InvalidArgumentException('Enabled is a native boolean.'); }
                break;
            case 'translation':
                if ($value !== null && (!is_string($value) || strlen($value) > 1000000)) {
                    throw new \InvalidArgumentException('Native editorial text must be text or null.');
                }
                break;
            case 'pricing':
                $keys = is_array($value) ? array_keys($value) : [];
                sort($keys, SORT_STRING);
                if (!is_array($value) || $keys !== ['minimumPrice', 'originalPrice', 'price']) {
                    throw new \InvalidArgumentException('Retain all three native channel pricing fields in their original minor units.');
                }
                foreach ($value as $amount) {
                    if ($amount !== null && (!is_int($amount) || $amount < 0)) { throw new \InvalidArgumentException('Native prices are nonnegative integer minor units or null.'); }
                }
                break;
            case 'channels': Support::strings($value, 'channels'); break;
            case 'taxons':
                if (!is_array($value) || !array_is_list($value)) { throw new \InvalidArgumentException('Select explicit native taxon positions.'); }
                $codes = [];
                foreach ($value as $row) {
                    $codes[] = Support::requiredString($row, 'code');
                    if (!is_int($row['position'] ?? null) || $row['position'] < 0) { throw new \InvalidArgumentException('Taxon positions must be nonnegative integers.'); }
                }
                Support::strings($codes, 'taxons');
                break;
            case 'scalar':
                if (in_array($selector['property'], ['tracked', 'shippingRequired'], true)) {
                    if (!is_bool($value)) { throw new \InvalidArgumentException('The native selected property is boolean.'); }
                } elseif (in_array($selector['property'], ['onHand', 'onHold'], true)) {
                    if (!is_int($value) || $value < 0) { throw new \InvalidArgumentException('The native inventory value is a nonnegative integer.'); }
                } elseif ($value !== null && !is_int($value) && !is_float($value)) {
                    throw new \InvalidArgumentException('The selected native dimension must be numeric or null.');
                }
                break;
            case 'attribute': Support::json($value); break;
            default: throw new \InvalidArgumentException('Unknown native field.');
        }
    }
}

<?php
declare(strict_types=1);
namespace Tjl\CatalogueWorkspace;

use Tjl\CatalogueWorkspace\Source\SourceGateway;

/** Portable catalogue state and exact source bytes. Full Sylius SQL/files use the native project tool. */
final class ProjectArchive
{
    public function __construct(private Store $store, private SourceGateway $source, private int $maximumBytes) {}

    public function export(string $projectId, string $operationId, string $actor): array
    {
        $existing = $this->store->object('export', $operationId);
        if ($existing !== null) {
            if ($existing['_record']['project_id'] !== $projectId) { throw new \RuntimeException('The original export belongs to another project.'); }
            $this->store->blobPath($existing['archive']);
            return $existing;
        }
        $this->store->require('project', $projectId, $projectId);
        $request = $this->store->require('command', $operationId, $projectId);
        $journalId = 'export-' . substr(Support::hash([$projectId, $operationId]), 0, 48);
        $journalPath = $this->store->root() . '/journals/' . $journalId . '.json';
        if (is_file($journalPath)) {
            $pointer = json_decode((string) file_get_contents($journalPath), true, 512, JSON_THROW_ON_ERROR);
            $retained = json_decode($this->store->readBlob($pointer), true, 512, JSON_THROW_ON_ERROR);
            if ($retained['project_id'] !== $projectId || $retained['operation_id'] !== $operationId) {
                throw new \RuntimeException('The original export journal binding differs.');
            }
            $this->store->blobPath($retained['archive']);
            return $this->store->original('export', $operationId, $projectId, $retained);
        }
        $frozenId = 'freeze-' . substr(Support::hash([$projectId, $operationId]), 0, 48);
        $frozenPath = $this->store->root() . '/journals/' . $frozenId . '.json';
        if (is_file($frozenPath)) {
            $pointer = json_decode((string) file_get_contents($frozenPath), true, 512, JSON_THROW_ON_ERROR);
            $frozen = json_decode($this->store->readBlob($pointer), true, 512, JSON_THROW_ON_ERROR);
            $manifest = $frozen['manifest'];
            $members = $frozen['members'];
            if ($manifest['project_id'] !== $projectId || $manifest['operation_id'] !== $operationId || $manifest['actor'] !== $actor) {
                throw new \RuntimeException('Continue the original frozen project export.');
            }
        } else {
            $manifest = ['schema' => 'tjl.catalogue.project-archive.v1', 'project_id' => $projectId,
                'operation_id' => $operationId, 'created_at' => $request['created_at'], 'actor' => $actor,
                'native_requirement' => 'Native catalogue references require the original separately received Sylius database, connector configuration and file graph before further mutation.',
                'records' => [], 'sources' => [], 'journals' => [], 'blobs' => []];
            $blobs = [];
            $members = [];
            $total = 0;
            foreach ($this->store->allProject($projectId) as $record) {
                if ($record['_record']['kind'] === 'export') { continue; }
                $body = Support::json($record) . "\n";
                $blob = $this->store->blob($body);
                $path = 'records/' . $record['_record']['kind'] . '/' . $record['_record']['id'] . '.json';
                $members[$path] = $blob;
                $manifest['records'][] = ['path' => $path, 'kind' => $record['_record']['kind'], 'id' => $record['_record']['id'],
                    'revision' => $record['_record']['revision'], 'sha256' => $blob['sha256'], 'bytes' => $blob['bytes']];
                $this->findBlobs($record, $blobs);
            }
            $sourceFiles = $this->source->exportProject($projectId);
            foreach ($sourceFiles as $file) {
                $path = $this->relative($file['path']);
                $this->store->blobPath($file['blob']);
                $manifest['sources'][] = ['path' => $path, 'blob' => $file['blob']];
                $blobs[$file['blob']['sha256']] = $file['blob'];
            }
            foreach ($this->store->importJournals($projectId) as $journal) {
                $manifest['journals'][] = $journal;
                $blobs[$journal['blob']['sha256']] = $journal['blob'];
                $this->findBlobs(json_decode($this->store->readBlob($journal['blob']), true, 512, JSON_THROW_ON_ERROR), $blobs);
            }
            foreach ($blobs as $blob) {
                $this->store->blobPath($blob);
                $members['blobs/' . $blob['sha256']] = $blob;
                $manifest['blobs'][] = $blob;
            }
            foreach ($members as $blob) { $total += $blob['bytes']; }
            if ($total > $this->maximumBytes) { throw new \RuntimeException('The complete original project exceeds the explicitly configured export bound.'); }
            $manifest['content_sha256'] = Support::hash($manifest);
            $this->store->journal($frozenId, ['manifest' => $manifest, 'members' => $members]);
        }
        foreach ($members as $blob) { $this->store->blobPath($blob); }
        $path = $this->store->temporaryPath('.zip');
        try {
            $zip = new \ZipArchive();
            if ($zip->open($path, \ZipArchive::CREATE | \ZipArchive::OVERWRITE) !== true) { throw new \RuntimeException('Cannot create the private native project archive.'); }
            try {
                foreach ($members as $name => $blob) {
                    if (!$zip->addFile($this->store->blobPath($blob), $name)) { throw new \RuntimeException('Cannot retain original archive member ' . $name); }
                    $zip->setMtimeName($name, 315532800);
                }
                if (!$zip->addFromString('manifest.json', Support::json($manifest) . "\n")) { throw new \RuntimeException('Cannot retain complete native manifest.'); }
                $zip->setMtimeName('manifest.json', 315532800);
            } catch (\Throwable $error) { $zip->close(); throw $error; }
            if (!$zip->close()) { throw new \RuntimeException('The native archive did not finish writing.'); }
            if (filesize($path) > $this->maximumBytes) { throw new \RuntimeException('The completed archive exceeds its declared byte bound.'); }
            $checked = $this->inspect($path);
            if ($checked['content_sha256'] !== $manifest['content_sha256']) { throw new \RuntimeException('The native archive reopened with a different original manifest.'); }
            $archive = $this->store->blobFile($path);
        } finally { @unlink($path); }
        $receipt = ['state' => 'COMPLETE', 'project_id' => $projectId, 'operation_id' => $operationId,
            'archive' => $archive, 'manifest_sha256' => $manifest['content_sha256'],
            'records' => count($manifest['records']), 'source_files' => count($manifest['sources']), 'blobs' => count($manifest['blobs']),
            'created_at' => $request['created_at'], 'actor' => $actor];
        $this->store->journal($journalId, $receipt);
        return $this->store->original('export', $operationId, $projectId, $receipt);
    }

    public function inspect(string $path): array
    {
        if (is_link($path) || !is_file($path) || filesize($path) > $this->maximumBytes) { throw new \RuntimeException('Select a bounded complete original archive file.'); }
        $zip = new \ZipArchive();
        if ($zip->open($path, \ZipArchive::RDONLY) !== true) { throw new \RuntimeException('Cannot reopen the original native archive.'); }
        try {
            $names = [];
            $total = 0;
            for ($i = 0; $i < $zip->numFiles; ++$i) {
                $stat = $zip->statIndex($i);
                if ($stat === false) { throw new \RuntimeException('Cannot read the original archive directory.'); }
                $name = $this->relative($stat['name']);
                if (isset($names[$name])) { throw new \RuntimeException('The original archive repeats a member name.'); }
                $names[$name] = true;
                $total += $stat['size'];
                if ($total > $this->maximumBytes) { throw new \RuntimeException('The complete expanded archive exceeds its selected bound.'); }
            }
            $raw = $zip->getFromName('manifest.json');
            if (!is_string($raw) || strlen($raw) > 67108864) { throw new \RuntimeException('A complete bounded manifest is required.'); }
            $manifest = json_decode($raw, true, 512, JSON_THROW_ON_ERROR);
            if (($manifest['schema'] ?? null) !== 'tjl.catalogue.project-archive.v1') { throw new \RuntimeException('Select an original catalogue project archive.'); }
            $claimed = $manifest['content_sha256'] ?? '';
            unset($manifest['content_sha256']);
            if (!is_string($claimed) || !hash_equals($claimed, Support::hash($manifest))) { throw new \RuntimeException('Original manifest content identity differs.'); }
            $manifest['content_sha256'] = $claimed;
            Support::id($manifest['project_id']);
            $expected = ['manifest.json' => true];
            foreach ($manifest['records'] as $record) {
                $name = 'records/' . Support::id($record['kind']) . '/' . Support::id($record['id']) . '.json';
                if ($record['path'] !== $name || isset($expected[$name])) { throw new \RuntimeException('Original record member binding differs.'); }
                $expected[$name] = true;
                $this->checkMember($zip, $name, $record['bytes'], $record['sha256']);
            }
            foreach ($manifest['blobs'] as $blob) {
                $name = 'blobs/' . $blob['sha256'];
                if (($blob['path'] ?? null) !== $name || isset($expected[$name])) { throw new \RuntimeException('Original source blob identity differs or repeats.'); }
                $expected[$name] = true;
                $this->checkMember($zip, $name, $blob['bytes'], $blob['sha256']);
            }
            foreach ($manifest['sources'] as $file) {
                $this->relative($file['path']);
                if (!isset($expected['blobs/' . ($file['blob']['sha256'] ?? '')])) { throw new \RuntimeException('A complete source journal member is missing.'); }
            }
            foreach ($manifest['journals'] ?? [] as $journal) {
                if (!preg_match('/\Aimport-[a-f0-9]{32}-(?:start|returned|error)\z/D', $journal['name'] ?? '') ||
                    !isset($expected['blobs/' . ($journal['blob']['sha256'] ?? '')])) {
                    throw new \RuntimeException('A complete original import journal is missing or unbound.');
                }
            }
            ksort($names); ksort($expected);
            if ($names !== $expected) { throw new \RuntimeException('The archive contains unbound or missing original members.'); }
            return $manifest;
        } finally { $zip->close(); }
    }

    public function receive(string $projectId, string $path, string $operationId, string $actor): array
    {
        $manifest = $this->inspect($path);
        if ($manifest['project_id'] !== $projectId) { throw new \RuntimeException('Receive the original project identity without renaming it.'); }
        $archive = $this->store->blobFile($path);
        $receiptId = Support::hash(['project_id' => $projectId, 'archive' => $archive['sha256']]);
        $received = $this->store->object('received', $receiptId);
        if ($received !== null) {
            if ($received['manifest_sha256'] !== $manifest['content_sha256']) { throw new \RuntimeException('The accepted original receipt differs.'); }
            $this->store->require('project', $projectId, $projectId);
            return $received; // Later local work is preserved.
        }
        if ($this->store->object('project', $projectId) !== null) {
            throw new \RuntimeException('This target already has the named project without this original acceptance; select its original receiving operation.');
        }
        $zip = new \ZipArchive();
        if ($zip->open($this->store->blobPath($archive), \ZipArchive::RDONLY) !== true) { throw new \RuntimeException('Cannot reopen retained original archive bytes.'); }
        try {
            foreach ($manifest['blobs'] as $blob) {
                $stream = $zip->getStream('blobs/' . $blob['sha256']);
                if ($stream === false) { throw new \RuntimeException('Cannot receive a complete original source blob.'); }
                $temporary = $this->store->temporaryPath();
                try {
                    $out = fopen($temporary, 'w+b');
                    if ($out === false) { throw new \RuntimeException('Cannot receive original private bytes.'); }
                    try { stream_copy_to_stream($stream, $out); fflush($out); fsync($out); } finally { fclose($out); }
                    $actual = $this->store->blobFile($temporary);
                    if ($actual !== $blob) { throw new \RuntimeException('The received complete source blob differs.'); }
                } finally { fclose($stream); @unlink($temporary); }
            }
            $this->source->importProject($projectId, $manifest['sources']);
            foreach ($manifest['journals'] ?? [] as $journal) {
                $value = json_decode($this->store->readBlob($journal['blob']), true, 512, JSON_THROW_ON_ERROR);
                if (($value['project_id'] ?? $projectId) !== $projectId) { throw new \RuntimeException('Original import journal belongs to another project.'); }
                $this->store->journal($journal['name'], $value);
            }
            return $this->store->atomic(function () use ($zip, $manifest, $projectId, $operationId, $actor, $archive, $receiptId): array {
                foreach ($manifest['records'] as $entry) {
                    $body = $zip->getFromName($entry['path']);
                    if (!is_string($body)) { throw new \RuntimeException('Missing complete original record.'); }
                    $record = json_decode($body, true, 512, JSON_THROW_ON_ERROR);
                    $binding = $record['_record'] ?? null;
                    if (!is_array($binding) || $binding['project_id'] !== $projectId || $binding['kind'] !== $entry['kind'] ||
                        $binding['id'] !== $entry['id'] || $binding['revision'] !== $entry['revision']) {
                        throw new \RuntimeException('An original received native record binding differs.');
                    }
                    // The target's live receiving command is its own retained actor/input.
                    if ($binding['kind'] === 'command' && $binding['id'] === $operationId) { continue; }
                    $this->store->receiveOriginal($record);
                }
                $receipt = ['state' => 'COMPLETE', 'project_id' => $projectId, 'operation_id' => $operationId,
                    'archive' => $archive, 'manifest_sha256' => $manifest['content_sha256'], 'received_by' => $actor,
                    'received_at' => Support::now(), 'native_requirement' => $manifest['native_requirement']];
                return $this->store->original('received', $receiptId, $projectId, $receipt);
            });
        } finally { $zip->close(); }
    }

    public function files(string $projectId): array
    {
        $this->store->require('project', $projectId, $projectId);
        $blobs = []; $metadata = [];
        foreach ($this->store->allProject($projectId) as $record) {
            $this->findBlobs($record, $blobs);
            if (in_array($record['_record']['kind'], ['export', 'received'], true) && isset($record['archive']['sha256'])) {
                $metadata[$record['archive']['sha256']] = ['name' => 'catalogue-' . $projectId . '-' . $record['archive']['sha256'] . '.zip',
                    'content_type' => 'application/zip'];
            }
        }
        foreach ($this->store->importJournals($projectId) as $row) { $blobs[$row['blob']['sha256']] = $row['blob']; }
        foreach ($this->source->exportProject($projectId) as $row) { $blobs[$row['blob']['sha256']] = $row['blob']; }
        ksort($blobs, SORT_STRING);
        return ['state' => 'COMPLETE', 'project_id' => $projectId, 'files' => array_values(array_map(static fn (array $blob): array => $blob + ($metadata[$blob['sha256']] ?? []), $blobs))];
    }

    public function selectedFile(string $projectId, string $sha): array
    {
        foreach ($this->files($projectId)['files'] as $file) {
            if ($file['sha256'] === $sha) { $this->store->blobPath($file); return $file; }
        }
        throw new \RuntimeException('This original file is not an asset of the selected project.');
    }

    private function findBlobs(mixed $value, array &$found): void
    {
        if (!is_array($value)) { return; }
        if (isset($value['sha256'], $value['bytes'], $value['path']) && is_string($value['sha256']) &&
            ($value['path'] === 'blobs/' . $value['sha256']) && is_int($value['bytes'])) {
            $this->store->blobPath($value);
            $found[$value['sha256']] = ['sha256' => $value['sha256'], 'bytes' => $value['bytes'], 'path' => $value['path']];
        }
        foreach ($value as $child) { $this->findBlobs($child, $found); }
    }

    private function relative(string $path): string
    {
        if ($path === '' || strlen($path) > 2048 || str_contains($path, "\0") || str_contains($path, '\\') ||
            str_starts_with($path, '/') || preg_match('/(?:^|\/)\.\.?(?:\/|$)/', $path) || str_contains($path, ':')) {
            throw new \RuntimeException('Use ordinary bounded package-relative native member paths.');
        }
        return $path;
    }

    private function checkMember(\ZipArchive $zip, string $path, int $bytes, string $sha): void
    {
        if ($bytes < 0 || !preg_match('/\A[a-f0-9]{64}\z/D', $sha)) { throw new \RuntimeException('The source member has an invalid original identity.'); }
        $stream = $zip->getStream($path);
        if ($stream === false) { throw new \RuntimeException('Missing original source member ' . $path); }
        $context = hash_init('sha256');
        $count = 0;
        try {
            while (!feof($stream)) {
                $part = fread($stream, 1048576);
                if ($part === false) { throw new \RuntimeException('Original source member ended unexpectedly.'); }
                $count += strlen($part);
                if ($count > $bytes) { throw new \RuntimeException('Original member exceeds its declared size.'); }
                hash_update($context, $part);
            }
        } finally { fclose($stream); }
        if ($count !== $bytes || hash_final($context) !== $sha) { throw new \RuntimeException('Original source member bytes differ.'); }
    }
}

<?php
declare(strict_types=1);
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
namespace Tjl\CatalogueWorkspace\Source;

use Symfony\Component\Filesystem\Filesystem;

/** Inject only into the original configured FileAttributeValueHandler services. */
final class JournaledFilesystem extends Filesystem
{
    public function __construct(private MediaJournal $journal) {}
    public function rename(string $origin, string $target, bool $overwrite = false): void
    {
        if ($this->journal->active()) { $this->journal->stageLocal($origin, $target, $overwrite); return; }
        parent::rename($origin, $target, $overwrite);
    }
    public function exists(string|iterable $files): bool
    {
        if (!$this->journal->active()) { return parent::exists($files); }
        foreach (is_string($files) ? [$files] : $files as $path) {
            if (!$this->journal->localExists((string) $path)) { return false; }
        }
        return true;
    }
    public function mkdir(string|iterable $dirs, int $mode = 0777): void
    {
        if (!$this->journal->active()) { parent::mkdir($dirs, $mode); return; }
        foreach (is_string($dirs) ? [$dirs] : $dirs as $path) { $this->journal->localDirectory((string) $path); }
    }
    public function chmod(string|iterable $files, int $mode, int $umask = 0000, bool $recursive = false): void
    {
        if (!$this->journal->active()) { parent::chmod($files, $mode, $umask, $recursive); return; }
        if ($recursive) { throw new \RuntimeException('Recursive media chmod is outside the native selected file contract.'); }
        foreach (is_string($files) ? [$files] : $files as $path) { $this->journal->localMode((string) $path, $mode & ~$umask); }
    }
}

<?php
declare(strict_types=1);
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
namespace Tjl\CatalogueWorkspace\Source;

use Sylius\Component\Core\Filesystem\Adapter\FilesystemAdapterInterface;

/** Preserves the native Sylius uploader and its actual generated image paths. */
final class JournaledImageStorage implements FilesystemAdapterInterface
{
    public function __construct(private FilesystemAdapterInterface $inner, private MediaJournal $journal) {}
    public function has(string $location): bool
    {
        return $this->journal->active() ? $this->journal->imageHas($location) : $this->inner->has($location);
    }
    public function write(string $location, string $content): void
    {
        if ($this->journal->active()) { $this->journal->imageWrite($location, $content); return; }
        $this->inner->write($location, $content);
    }
    public function delete(string $location): void
    {
        if ($this->journal->active()) { $this->journal->imageDelete($location); return; }
        $this->inner->delete($location);
    }
}

<?php
declare(strict_types=1);
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
namespace Tjl\CatalogueWorkspace\Source;

use League\Flysystem\FilesystemOperator;
use Sylius\Component\Core\Filesystem\Adapter\FilesystemAdapterInterface;
use Tjl\CatalogueWorkspace\Store;

/** Stages native uploader effects until the original Doctrine commit survives. */
final class MediaJournal
{
    private ?array $state = null;

    public function __construct(
        private Store $store,
        private PrivateJournal $journal,
        private FilesystemAdapterInterface $imageAdapter,
        private FilesystemOperator $imageStorage,
        private array $localRoots,
        private string $imageStorageId = 'sylius.storage',
    ) {
        foreach ($localRoots as $key => $root) {
            if (!is_string($key) || $key === '' || !is_string($root) || !str_starts_with($root, '/')
                || str_contains($root, "\0") || preg_match('~/(?:[.]|[.][.])(?:/|$)~', $root) || is_link($root)) {
                throw new \InvalidArgumentException('Configure each existing ordinary file-handler destination root by stable name.');
            }
            $parent = rtrim($root, '/');
            while ($parent !== '/' && $parent !== '.') {
                if (is_link($parent) || (file_exists($parent) && !is_dir($parent))) {
                    throw new \InvalidArgumentException('Native file root contains a linked or non-directory parent.');
                }
                $parent = dirname($parent);
            }
        }
    }

    public function active(): bool { return $this->state !== null; }
    public function inspect(string $id): ?array { return $this->journal->read('media', $id); }
    public function end(): void { $this->state = null; }

    public function begin(string $projectId, string $operationId, string $sourceHash, bool $committed): void
    {
        if ($this->state !== null) { throw new \LogicException('Media operation is already active.'); }
        $state = $this->inspect($operationId);
        $binding = ['project_id' => $projectId, 'operation_id' => $operationId, 'source_sha256' => $sourceHash,
                    'local_root_ids' => array_keys($this->localRoots), 'image_storage_id' => $this->imageStorageId];
        if ($state && $state['binding'] !== $binding) { throw new \RuntimeException('Original media operation binding changed.'); }
        if ($committed && !$state) { throw new \RuntimeException('Committed import has no retained original media journal.'); }
        $state ??= ['schema' => 'tjl.catalogue.media-operation.v1', 'binding' => $binding,
                    'state' => 'PREPARED', 'entries' => [], 'attempts' => [], 'created_at' => PrivateJournal::now()];
        if (!$committed && $state['entries']) {
            // No APPLIED row survived the native transaction. Staging never touched the destination.
            foreach ($state['entries'] as $entry) {
                if (($entry['published'] ?? false) === true) {
                    throw new \RuntimeException('Published media without the original committed DB marker needs explicit recovery.');
                }
            }
            $state['attempts'][] = ['ended_at' => PrivateJournal::now(), 'entries' => $state['entries'], 'state' => 'NOT_COMMITTED'];
            $state['entries'] = [];
        }
        if (!$committed) { $state['state'] = 'STAGING'; }
        $this->state = $state;
        $this->save();
    }

    private function save(): void
    {
        if ($this->state === null) { throw new \LogicException('No active media operation.'); }
        $this->state['updated_at'] = PrivateJournal::now();
        $this->journal->write('media', $this->state['binding']['operation_id'], $this->state);
    }

    private function relative(string $path): string
    {
        if ($path === '' || str_starts_with($path, '/') || str_contains($path, '\\') || str_contains($path, "\0")) {
            throw new \RuntimeException('A native image must have an ordinary relative path.');
        }
        foreach (explode('/', $path) as $part) {
            if ($part === '' || $part === '.' || $part === '..') { throw new \RuntimeException('Unsafe native media member.'); }
        }
        return $path;
    }

    private function local(string $path): array
    {
        foreach ($this->localRoots as $key => $root) {
            $prefix = rtrim($root, '/') . '/';
            if (str_starts_with($path, $prefix)) {
                $relative = $this->relative(substr($path, strlen($prefix)));
                $current = rtrim($root, '/');
                foreach (explode('/', $relative) as $part) {
                    $current .= '/' . $part;
                    if (is_link($current)) { throw new \RuntimeException('Native media destination contains a filesystem link.'); }
                }
                return ['backend' => 'local', 'root' => $key, 'path' => $relative];
            }
        }
        throw new \RuntimeException('Native file-handler destination is outside its installed selected roots.');
    }

    private function absolute(array $target): string
    {
        $root = $this->localRoots[$target['root']] ?? null;
        if ($root === null) { throw new \RuntimeException('Original native file root is not configured.'); }
        $path = rtrim($root, '/') . '/' . $this->relative($target['path']);
        $this->local($path);
        return $path;
    }

    private function observed(array $target): array
    {
        if ($target['backend'] === 'local') {
            $path = $this->absolute($target);
            if (!file_exists($path)) { return ['state' => 'MISSING']; }
            if (!is_file($path)) { throw new \RuntimeException('Selected native destination is not a regular file.'); }
            $before = stat($path);
            $body = $this->store->blobFile($path);
            clearstatcache(true, $path);
            $after = stat($path);
            foreach (['dev', 'ino', 'size', 'mtime', 'ctime'] as $field) {
                if ($before[$field] !== $after[$field]) { throw new \RuntimeException('Native file changed during preimage capture.'); }
            }
            return ['state' => 'FILE', 'body' => $body, 'mode' => $after['mode'] & 0777];
        }
        if ($target['storage'] !== $this->imageStorageId) { throw new \RuntimeException('Original image storage changed.'); }
        $path = $this->relative($target['path']);
        if (!$this->imageStorage->fileExists($path)) { return ['state' => 'MISSING']; }
        $stream = $this->imageStorage->readStream($path);
        if (!is_resource($stream)) { throw new \RuntimeException('Cannot read original native image preimage.'); }
        $temp = $this->store->temporaryPath('.image');
        $out = fopen($temp, 'wb');
        if ($out === false) { fclose($stream); throw new \RuntimeException('Cannot retain native image.'); }
        try {
            chmod($temp, 0600);
            if (stream_copy_to_stream($stream, $out) === false || !fflush($out) || !fsync($out)) {
                throw new \RuntimeException('Incomplete native image preimage.');
            }
        } finally { fclose($stream); fclose($out); }
        try { $body = $this->store->blobFile($temp); } finally { if (is_file($temp)) { unlink($temp); } }
        return ['state' => 'FILE', 'body' => $body, 'visibility' => $this->imageStorage->visibility($path)];
    }

    private function same(array $a, array $b, bool $mode = true): bool
    {
        if ($a['state'] !== $b['state']) { return false; }
        if ($a['state'] === 'MISSING') { return true; }
        if ($a['body']['sha256'] !== $b['body']['sha256'] || $a['body']['bytes'] !== $b['body']['bytes']) { return false; }
        if (isset($b['visibility']) && ($a['visibility'] ?? null) !== $b['visibility']) { return false; }
        return !$mode || !isset($b['mode']) || ($a['mode'] ?? null) === $b['mode'];
    }

    private function stage(array $target, array $after): void
    {
        if ($this->state === null || $this->state['state'] !== 'STAGING') {
            throw new \RuntimeException('Only the active uncommitted import may stage media.');
        }
        $key = PrivateJournal::hash($target);
        if (!isset($this->state['entries'][$key])) {
            $this->state['entries'][$key] = ['target' => $target, 'before' => $this->observed($target), 'published' => false];
        }
        $this->state['entries'][$key]['after'] = $after;
        $this->save();
    }

    public function stageLocal(string $source, string $destination, bool $overwrite): void
    {
        $target = $this->local($destination);
        if (!$overwrite && $this->localExists($destination)) { throw new \RuntimeException('Native file destination already exists.'); }
        if (!is_file($source) || is_link($source)) { throw new \RuntimeException('Original temporary media file is unavailable.'); }
        $this->stage($target, ['state' => 'FILE', 'body' => $this->store->blobFile($source), 'mode' => fileperms($source) & 0777]);
    }

    public function localMode(string $path, int $mode): void
    {
        $target = $this->local($path);
        $key = PrivateJournal::hash($target);
        if (!isset($this->state['entries'][$key]) || $this->state['entries'][$key]['after']['state'] !== 'FILE') {
            throw new \RuntimeException('Native chmod has no retained staged file.');
        }
        $this->state['entries'][$key]['after']['mode'] = $mode & 0777;
        $this->save();
    }

    public function localExists(string $path): bool
    {
        try { $target = $this->local($path); } catch (\RuntimeException) { return file_exists($path); }
        $entry = $this->state['entries'][PrivateJournal::hash($target)] ?? null;
        if ($entry) { return $entry['after']['state'] === 'FILE'; }
        foreach ($this->state['entries'] ?? [] as $row) {
            if ($row['target']['backend'] === 'local' && $row['target']['root'] === $target['root']
                && str_starts_with($row['target']['path'], $target['path'] . '/') && $row['after']['state'] === 'FILE') { return true; }
        }
        return file_exists($path);
    }

    public function localDirectory(string $path): void
    {
        if (in_array(rtrim($path, '/'), $this->localRoots, true)) { return; }
        $this->local(rtrim($path, '/') . '/.directory-validation');
        // Publication creates exactly the required parent directories after commit.
    }

    public function imageHas(string $path): bool
    {
        $target = ['backend' => 'image', 'storage' => $this->imageStorageId, 'path' => $this->relative($path)];
        $entry = $this->state['entries'][PrivateJournal::hash($target)] ?? null;
        return $entry ? $entry['after']['state'] === 'FILE' : $this->imageAdapter->has($path);
    }

    public function imageWrite(string $path, string $bytes): void
    {
        $this->stage(['backend' => 'image', 'storage' => $this->imageStorageId, 'path' => $this->relative($path)],
            ['state' => 'FILE', 'body' => $this->store->blob($bytes)]);
    }

    public function imageDelete(string $path): void
    {
        $this->stage(['backend' => 'image', 'storage' => $this->imageStorageId, 'path' => $this->relative($path)],
            ['state' => 'MISSING']);
    }

    public function hasWrites(): bool { return (bool) ($this->state['entries'] ?? []); }

    public function abort(): array
    {
        if ($this->state === null) { throw new \LogicException('No media scope.'); }
        foreach ($this->state['entries'] as $entry) {
            if ($entry['published']) { throw new \RuntimeException('Cannot discard already committed native media.'); }
        }
        $this->state['state'] = 'NOT_COMMITTED';
        $this->save();
        return $this->state;
    }

    public function commit(): array
    {
        if ($this->state === null) { throw new \LogicException('No media scope.'); }
        $this->state['state'] = 'MEDIA_PENDING';
        $this->save();
        foreach (array_keys($this->state['entries']) as $key) {
            $entry = $this->state['entries'][$key];
            if ($entry['published']) { continue; } // Preserve later legitimate native edits.
            $target = $entry['target'];
            $current = $this->observed($target);
            if (!$this->same($current, $entry['after'])) {
                $matchesBefore = $this->same($current, $entry['before']);
                $ownDataBeforeMode = $target['backend'] === 'local' && $this->same($current, $entry['after'], false);
                if (!$matchesBefore && !$ownDataBeforeMode) {
                    $this->state['entries'][$key]['conflict'] = $current;
                    $this->save();
                    throw new \RuntimeException('Native media changed after review; retain the original operation and resolve its file conflict.');
                }
                if ($target['backend'] === 'local') {
                    $path = $this->absolute($target);
                    if ($entry['after']['state'] === 'MISSING') {
                        if (is_file($path) && !unlink($path)) { throw new \RuntimeException('Native file deletion failed.'); }
                    } else {
                        $dir = dirname($path);
                        if (!is_dir($dir) && !mkdir($dir, 0755, true) && !is_dir($dir)) { throw new \RuntimeException('Cannot create native file directory.'); }
                        $this->absolute($target);
                        $temp = tempnam($dir, '.catalogue-');
                        if ($temp === false) { throw new \RuntimeException('Cannot stage committed native file.'); }
                        try {
                            if (!copy($this->store->blobPath($entry['after']['body']), $temp)
                                || !chmod($temp, $entry['after']['mode'])
                                || !rename($temp, $path)) { throw new \RuntimeException('Native file publication failed.'); }
                        } finally { if (is_file($temp)) { unlink($temp); } }
                    }
                } elseif ($entry['after']['state'] === 'MISSING') {
                    if ($this->imageAdapter->has($target['path'])) { $this->imageAdapter->delete($target['path']); }
                } else {
                    $this->imageAdapter->write($target['path'], $this->store->readBlob($entry['after']['body']));
                }
            }
            $after = $this->observed($target);
            if (!$this->same($after, $entry['after'])) { throw new \RuntimeException('Native published media readback differs.'); }
            $this->state['entries'][$key]['published'] = true;
            $this->state['entries'][$key]['published_at'] = PrivateJournal::now();
            $this->state['entries'][$key]['observed_after'] = $after;
            $this->save();
        }
        $this->state['state'] = 'COMPLETE';
        $this->save();
        return $this->state;
    }
}

<?php
declare(strict_types=1);
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
namespace Tjl\CatalogueWorkspace\Source;

/** Durable original operation bytes, independent of Doctrine rollback. */
final class PrivateJournal
{
    private string $root;
    private array $locks = [];

    public function __construct(string $directory)
    {
        if (!str_starts_with($directory, '/') || str_contains($directory, "\0")) {
            throw new \InvalidArgumentException('Use the existing absolute private workspace directory.');
        }
        if (!is_dir($directory) && !mkdir($directory, 0700, true) && !is_dir($directory)) {
            throw new \RuntimeException('Cannot create private source journal.');
        }
        $real = realpath($directory);
        if ($real === false || is_link($directory)) {
            throw new \RuntimeException('Private source directory must be an ordinary directory.');
        }
        $this->root = $real . '/source';
        if (!is_dir($this->root) && !mkdir($this->root, 0700) && !is_dir($this->root)) {
            throw new \RuntimeException('Cannot create source journal.');
        }
        if (is_link($this->root)) {
            throw new \RuntimeException('Source journal must not be linked.');
        }
    }

    public static function encode(mixed $value): string
    {
        return json_encode($value, JSON_UNESCAPED_SLASHES | JSON_UNESCAPED_UNICODE | JSON_PRESERVE_ZERO_FRACTION | JSON_THROW_ON_ERROR);
    }

    public static function hash(mixed $value): string { return hash('sha256', self::encode($value)); }
    public static function now(): string { return gmdate('Y-m-d\TH:i:s\Z'); }

    public function path(string $kind, string $id): string
    {
        if (!preg_match('/^[a-z][a-z0-9_-]*$/D', $kind) || $id === '') {
            throw new \InvalidArgumentException('Retain an original journal kind and identity.');
        }
        return $this->root . '/' . $kind . '-' . hash('sha256', $id) . '.json';
    }

    public function read(string $kind, string $id): ?array
    {
        $path = $this->path($kind, $id);
        if (!file_exists($path)) { return null; }
        if (is_link($path) || !is_file($path)) { throw new \RuntimeException('Invalid private journal member.'); }
        $value = json_decode((string) file_get_contents($path), true, 512, JSON_THROW_ON_ERROR);
        if (!is_array($value)) { throw new \RuntimeException('Invalid private journal body.'); }
        return $value;
    }

    public function write(string $kind, string $id, array $value): void
    {
        $path = $this->path($kind, $id);
        if (is_link($path)) { throw new \RuntimeException('Refuse a linked journal.'); }
        $temporary = tempnam($this->root, '.write-');
        if ($temporary === false) { throw new \RuntimeException('Cannot allocate private journal.'); }
        try {
            chmod($temporary, 0600);
            $f = fopen($temporary, 'wb');
            if ($f === false) { throw new \RuntimeException('Cannot open private journal.'); }
            try {
                $bytes = self::encode($value) . "\n";
                for ($offset = 0; $offset < strlen($bytes);) {
                    $written = fwrite($f, substr($bytes, $offset));
                    if ($written === false || $written === 0) { throw new \RuntimeException('Incomplete journal write.'); }
                    $offset += $written;
                }
                if (!fflush($f) || !fsync($f)) { throw new \RuntimeException('Cannot flush private journal.'); }
            } finally { fclose($f); }
            if (!rename($temporary, $path)) { throw new \RuntimeException('Cannot publish private journal.'); }
            $d = fopen($this->root, 'r');
            if ($d !== false) { try { fsync($d); } finally { fclose($d); } }
        } finally { if (is_file($temporary)) { unlink($temporary); } }
    }

    public function exportProject(string $projectId): array
    {
        $result = [];
        foreach (glob($this->root . '/*.json') ?: [] as $path) {
            if (is_link($path) || !is_file($path)) { throw new \RuntimeException('Invalid source journal member.'); }
            $raw = file_get_contents($path);
            if ($raw === false) { throw new \RuntimeException('Cannot retain complete source journal.'); }
            $value = json_decode($raw, true, 512, JSON_THROW_ON_ERROR);
            $owner = $value['project_id'] ?? $value['binding']['project_id'] ?? null;
            if ($owner === $projectId) { $result['source/' . basename($path)] = ['bytes' => $raw, 'value' => $value]; }
        }
        ksort($result);
        return $result;
    }

    public function importMember(string $projectId, string $relative, string $raw): void
    {
        if (!preg_match('~^source/([a-z][a-z0-9_-]*)-([a-f0-9]{64})[.]json$~D', $relative, $match)) {
            throw new \RuntimeException('Invalid original source journal path.');
        }
        $incoming = json_decode($raw, true, 512, JSON_THROW_ON_ERROR);
        if (($incoming['project_id'] ?? $incoming['binding']['project_id'] ?? null) !== $projectId) {
            throw new \RuntimeException('Source journal belongs to another project.');
        }
        $path = $this->root . '/' . basename($relative);
        if (is_link($path)) { throw new \RuntimeException('Source journal destination is linked.'); }
        if (is_file($path)) {
            $current = json_decode((string) file_get_contents($path), true, 512, JSON_THROW_ON_ERROR);
            if (self::encode($current) === self::encode($incoming)) { return; }
            $currentBinding = $current['binding'] ?? array_intersect_key($current, array_flip(['id', 'project_id', 'authority', 'request', 'operation_id']));
            $incomingBinding = $incoming['binding'] ?? array_intersect_key($incoming, array_flip(['id', 'project_id', 'authority', 'request', 'operation_id']));
            if ($currentBinding !== $incomingBinding
                || (isset($current['snapshot']['sha256'], $incoming['snapshot']['sha256'])
                    && $current['snapshot']['sha256'] !== $incoming['snapshot']['sha256'])) {
                throw new \RuntimeException('Receiving source identity conflicts with the original retained project.');
            }
            // Never overwrite the receiving project's later original attempts/publication state.
            return;
        }
        $temporary = tempnam($this->root, '.receive-');
        if ($temporary === false) { throw new \RuntimeException('Cannot receive original source journal.'); }
        try {
            chmod($temporary, 0600);
            if (file_put_contents($temporary, $raw, LOCK_EX) !== strlen($raw)) { throw new \RuntimeException('Incomplete source journal receiving.'); }
            $f = fopen($temporary, 'r+b');
            if ($f === false) { throw new \RuntimeException('Cannot sync source journal.'); }
            try { if (!fsync($f)) { throw new \RuntimeException('Cannot sync original source journal.'); } } finally { fclose($f); }
            if (!link($temporary, $path)) { throw new \RuntimeException('Original source journal was received concurrently.'); }
        } finally { if (is_file($temporary)) { unlink($temporary); } }
    }

    public function lock(string $key, callable $call): mixed
    {
        if (isset($this->locks[$key])) { return $call(); }
        $path = $this->root . '/lock-' . hash('sha256', $key);
        if (is_link($path)) { throw new \RuntimeException('Refuse a linked source lock.'); }
        $f = fopen($path, 'c+b');
        if ($f === false || !flock($f, LOCK_EX)) { throw new \RuntimeException('Cannot acquire original source lock.'); }
        chmod($path, 0600);
        $this->locks[$key] = $f;
        try { return $call(); }
        finally { unset($this->locks[$key]); flock($f, LOCK_UN); fclose($f); }
    }
}
