namespace Tjl\CatalogueWorkspace\Source;

use Psr\Http\Client\ClientInterface;
use Psr\Http\Message\RequestInterface;
use Psr\Http\Message\ResponseInterface;

final class RetainedHttpClient implements ClientInterface
{
    public function __construct(private ClientInterface $inner, private SourceContext $context) {}
    public function sendRequest(RequestInterface $request): ResponseInterface
    {
        return $this->context->request($request, fn (RequestInterface $actual) => $this->inner->sendRequest($actual));
    }
}

<?php
declare(strict_types=1);
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
namespace Tjl\CatalogueWorkspace\Source;

use Http\Discovery\Psr17FactoryDiscovery;
use Psr\Http\Message\RequestInterface;
use Psr\Http\Message\ResponseInterface;
use Tjl\CatalogueWorkspace\Store;

/** Owns complete response streams and the exact approved native request map. */
final class SourceContext
{
    private ?array $scope = null;

    public function __construct(
        private Store $store,
        private PrivateJournal $journal,
        private string $baseUrl,
        private int $maxResponseBytes = 1073741824,
        private int $maxRequests = 100000,
    ) {
        $this->baseUrl = rtrim($baseUrl, '/');
        $u = parse_url($this->baseUrl);
        if (!$u || !in_array($u['scheme'] ?? '', ['https', 'http'], true) || empty($u['host'])
            || isset($u['user']) || isset($u['pass']) || isset($u['query']) || isset($u['fragment'])) {
            throw new \InvalidArgumentException('Select the original Akeneo base URL without credentials.');
        }
    }

    public function baseUrl(): string { return $this->baseUrl; }
    public function active(): bool { return $this->scope !== null; }

    public function run(string $mode, string $projectId, string $id, array $approved, callable $call): mixed
    {
        if ($this->scope !== null || !in_array($mode, ['capture', 'check', 'replay'], true)) {
            throw new \LogicException('Source scopes must be explicit and non-overlapping.');
        }
        $this->scope = compact('mode', 'projectId', 'id', 'approved');
        try { return $call(); } finally { $this->scope = null; }
    }

    public function sources(string $captureId): array
    {
        return array_values(($this->journal->read('http', $captureId) ?? [])['requests'] ?? []);
    }

    private function binding(RequestInterface $request): array
    {
        $url = (string) $request->getUri();
        if ($request->getMethod() !== 'GET' || !str_starts_with($url, $this->baseUrl . '/api/rest/')
            || $request->getUri()->getUserInfo() !== '' || $request->getUri()->getFragment() !== ''
            || $request->getBody()->getSize() > 0) {
            throw new \RuntimeException('Only the selected Akeneo read-only REST authority is captured.');
        }
        parse_str($request->getUri()->getQuery(), $query);
        foreach (array_keys($query) as $name) {
            if (preg_match('/token|secret|password|authorization|api.?key/i', (string) $name)) {
                throw new \RuntimeException('Credential parameters do not belong in source requests.');
            }
        }
        $headers = [];
        foreach ($request->getHeaders() as $name => $values) {
            $lower = strtolower($name);
            if (!in_array($lower, ['authorization', 'proxy-authorization', 'cookie', 'host', 'user-agent', 'content-length'], true)) {
                $headers[$lower] = array_values($values);
            }
        }
        ksort($headers);
        return ['method' => 'GET', 'url' => $url, 'headers' => $headers];
    }

    private function response(array $record): ResponseInterface
    {
        $body = $record['body'] ?? null;
        if (!is_array($body) || ($record['state'] ?? '') !== 'COMPLETE') {
            throw new \RuntimeException('The complete original response is unavailable.');
        }
        $path = $this->store->blobPath($body);
        $response = Psr17FactoryDiscovery::findResponseFactory()->createResponse($record['status'], $record['reason'] ?? '');
        foreach ($record['headers'] as $name => $values) { $response = $response->withHeader($name, $values); }
        return $response->withProtocolVersion($record['protocol'] ?? '1.1')
            ->withBody(Psr17FactoryDiscovery::findStreamFactory()->createStreamFromFile($path, 'rb'));
    }

    public function request(RequestInterface $request, callable $native): ResponseInterface
    {
        if ($this->scope === null) { return $native($request); }
        // Authentication remains owned by the original client. Never retain its requests or responses.
        if ($request->getMethod() === 'POST' && (string) $request->getUri() === $this->baseUrl . '/api/oauth/v1/token') {
            return $native($request);
        }
        $request = $request->withHeader('Accept-Encoding', 'identity');
        $binding = $this->binding($request);
        $key = PrivateJournal::hash($binding);
        $scope = $this->scope;
        if ($scope['mode'] === 'replay') {
            $saved = $scope['approved'][$key] ?? null;
            if ($saved === null || $saved['request'] !== $binding) {
                $this->journal->write('missing-dependency', $scope['id'] . ':' . $key,
                    ['schema' => 'tjl.catalogue.missing-source.v1', 'operation_id' => $scope['id'],
                     'project_id' => $scope['projectId'], 'request' => $binding, 'at' => PrivateJournal::now()]);
                throw new \RuntimeException('Unknown source dependency: capture and review this exact GET before importing. Request ' . $key);
            }
            return $this->response($saved);
        }
        $id = $scope['id'];
        $state = $this->journal->read('http', $id) ?? [
            'schema' => 'tjl.catalogue.http-journal.v1', 'id' => $id, 'project_id' => $scope['projectId'],
            'authority' => $this->baseUrl, 'requests' => [], 'attempts' => [],
        ];
        if ($state['project_id'] !== $scope['projectId'] || $state['authority'] !== $this->baseUrl) {
            throw new \RuntimeException('The original source identity/authority changed.');
        }
        $saved = $state['requests'][$key] ?? null;
        if ($scope['mode'] === 'capture' && $saved && $saved['state'] === 'COMPLETE'
            && (($saved['status'] >= 200 && $saved['status'] < 300) || $saved['status'] === 404)) {
            return $this->response($saved);
        }
        if (count($state['requests']) >= $this->maxRequests && !isset($state['requests'][$key])) {
            throw new \RuntimeException('Original capture request limit reached; retain this operation for review.');
        }
        $floor = $this->journal->read('provider-delay', $this->baseUrl);
        if (($floor['not_before'] ?? 0) > time()) {
            throw new \RuntimeException('Native provider Retry-After remains active until ' . gmdate('c', $floor['not_before']));
        }
        $attempt = count($state['attempts']);
        $record = ['id' => $key, 'request' => $binding, 'state' => 'REQUESTING', 'started_at' => PrivateJournal::now()];
        $state['attempts'][] = $record;
        $this->journal->write('http', $id, $state);
        $temporary = $this->store->temporaryPath('.source');
        try {
            $response = $native($request);
            $record['status'] = $response->getStatusCode();
            $record['reason'] = $response->getReasonPhrase();
            $record['protocol'] = $response->getProtocolVersion();
            $record['headers'] = [];
            foreach ($response->getHeaders() as $name => $values) {
                if (!in_array(strtolower($name), ['set-cookie', 'authorization', 'proxy-authorization'], true)) {
                    $record['headers'][$name] = $values;
                }
            }
            $f = fopen($temporary, 'w+b');
            if ($f === false) { throw new \RuntimeException('Cannot retain source response.'); }
            chmod($temporary, 0600);
            $bytes = 0;
            try {
                $stream = $response->getBody();
                if ($stream->isSeekable()) { $stream->rewind(); }
                while (!$stream->eof()) {
                    $chunk = $stream->read(1048576);
                    if ($chunk === '' && !$stream->eof()) { throw new \RuntimeException('Native response stream stopped before EOF.'); }
                    $bytes += strlen($chunk);
                    if ($bytes > $this->maxResponseBytes) { throw new \RuntimeException('Complete source exceeds configured response bound.'); }
                    for ($at = 0; $at < strlen($chunk);) {
                        $n = fwrite($f, substr($chunk, $at));
                        if ($n === false || $n === 0) { throw new \RuntimeException('Incomplete private response write.'); }
                        $at += $n;
                    }
                }
                if (!fflush($f) || !fsync($f)) { throw new \RuntimeException('Cannot flush native source.'); }
            } finally { fclose($f); }
            $record['body'] = $this->store->blobFile($temporary);
            $length = $response->getHeaderLine('Content-Length');
            $encoding = strtolower($response->getHeaderLine('Content-Encoding'));
            if (($encoding !== '' && $encoding !== 'identity')
                || ($length !== '' && (!ctype_digit($length) || (int) $length !== $bytes))) {
                throw new \RuntimeException('Native identity response is encoded or incomplete; original bytes are retained.');
            }
            $record['state'] = 'COMPLETE';
            $record['received_at'] = PrivateJournal::now();
            if (in_array($record['status'], [429, 503], true)) {
                $delay = $response->getHeaderLine('Retry-After');
                $deadline = ctype_digit($delay) ? time() + (int) $delay : (strtotime($delay) ?: 0);
                if ($deadline > time()) {
                    $this->journal->write('provider-delay', $this->baseUrl,
                        ['authority' => $this->baseUrl, 'not_before' => max($deadline, $floor['not_before'] ?? 0), 'source_id' => $key]);
                }
            }
            $state['requests'][$key] = $record;
            $state['attempts'][$attempt] = $record;
            $this->journal->write('http', $id, $state);
            return $this->response($record);
        } catch (\Throwable $error) {
            if (!isset($record['body']) && is_file($temporary)) { $record['body'] = $this->store->blobFile($temporary); }
            $record['state'] = 'ATTENTION';
            // Exception text from an HTTP implementation can include credentials. Keep only its class.
            $record['error_type'] = get_class($error);
            $record['ended_at'] = PrivateJournal::now();
            $state['attempts'][$attempt] = $record;
            $this->journal->write('http', $id, $state);
            throw $error;
        } finally { if (is_file($temporary)) { unlink($temporary); } }
    }
}

<?php
declare(strict_types=1);
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
namespace Tjl\CatalogueWorkspace\Source;

use Akeneo\Pim\ApiClient\AkeneoPimClientInterface;
use Akeneo\Pim\ApiClient\Exception\HttpException;
use Tjl\CatalogueWorkspace\Store;

/** Full selected Akeneo graph and native importer source/media boundary. */
final class SourceGateway
{
    private ?array $active = null;
    private const APIS = [
        'product' => 'getProductApi', 'product_model' => 'getProductModelApi',
        'family' => 'getFamilyApi', 'family_variant' => 'getFamilyVariantApi',
        'attribute' => 'getAttributeApi', 'attribute_option' => 'getAttributeOptionApi',
        'category' => 'getCategoryApi', 'channel' => 'getChannelApi', 'locale' => 'getLocaleApi',
        'media' => 'getProductMediaFileApi', 'measurement_family' => 'getMeasurementFamilyApi',
        'association_type' => 'getAssociationTypeApi',
    ];

    public function __construct(
        private Store $store,
        private PrivateJournal $journal,
        private SourceContext $context,
        private MediaJournal $media,
        private AkeneoPimClientInterface $client,
    ) {}

    public function inspect(string $captureId): array
    {
        $state = $this->journal->read('capture', $captureId);
        if (!$state) { throw new \RuntimeException('Original source capture does not exist.'); }
        return $state['snapshot'] ?? [
            'schema' => 'tjl.catalogue.source-snapshot.v1', 'id' => $captureId,
            'project_id' => $state['project_id'], 'state' => $state['state'],
            'selection' => $state['selection'], 'sources' => $this->context->sources($captureId),
        ];
    }

    public function operation(string $operationId): ?array
    {
        $operation = $this->journal->read('apply', $operationId);
        if ($operation) { $operation['media'] = $this->media->inspect($operationId); }
        return $operation;
    }

    /** Every complete original journal and its raw/media/preimage objects, using the Store blob ABI. */
    public function exportProject(string $projectId): array
    {
        return $this->journal->lock('native-source-media', function () use ($projectId): array {
            $result = [];
            $visit = function (mixed $value) use (&$visit, &$result): void {
                if (!is_array($value)) { return; }
                if (isset($value['sha256'], $value['bytes'], $value['path']) && $value['path'] === 'blobs/' . $value['sha256']) {
                    $this->store->blobPath($value);
                    $result[$value['path']] = ['path' => $value['path'], 'blob' => $value];
                }
                foreach ($value as $child) { if (is_array($child)) { $visit($child); } }
            };
            foreach ($this->journal->exportProject($projectId) as $path => $row) {
                $visit($row['value']);
                $result[$path] = ['path' => $path, 'blob' => $this->store->blob($row['bytes'])];
            }
            ksort($result);
            return array_values($result);
        });
    }

    public function importProject(string $projectId, array $files): void
    {
        $this->journal->lock('native-source-media', function () use ($projectId, $files): void {
            $seen = [];
            foreach ($files as $file) {
                if (!is_array($file) || !is_string($file['path'] ?? null) || isset($seen[$file['path']])) {
                    throw new \RuntimeException('Source project packet repeats or omits a native member.');
                }
                $seen[$file['path']] = true;
                $this->store->blobPath($file['blob']);
                if (str_starts_with($file['path'], 'blobs/')) {
                    if ($file['path'] !== $file['blob']['path']) { throw new \RuntimeException('Original blob path differs.'); }
                } elseif (!preg_match('~^source/[a-z][a-z0-9_-]*-[a-f0-9]{64}[.]json$~D', $file['path'])) {
                    throw new \RuntimeException('Source packet has an invalid private journal path.');
                }
            }
            // All original object bytes were verified before any journal is received.
            foreach ($files as $file) {
                if (str_starts_with($file['path'], 'source/')) {
                    $this->journal->importMember($projectId, $file['path'], $this->store->readBlob($file['blob']));
                }
            }
        });
    }

    private function apiCall(array $call): array
    {
        $api = $call['api'] ?? null;
        $method = $call['method'] ?? 'get';
        $args = $call['arguments'] ?? [];
        if (!isset(self::APIS[$api]) || !in_array($method, ['get', 'all', 'download'], true)
            || !is_array($args) || !array_is_list($args)
            || ($method === 'download' && $api !== 'media')) {
            throw new \InvalidArgumentException('Use an explicit original read-only Akeneo API descriptor.');
        }
        $getter = self::APIS[$api];
        $native = $this->client->$getter();
        if (!method_exists($native, $method)) { throw new \InvalidArgumentException('This installed native API has no selected read method.'); }
        try {
            $value = $native->$method(...$args);
            if ($method === 'download') {
                // SourceContext already retained the complete original stream before returning it.
                $value = ['status' => $value->getStatusCode()];
            } elseif ($value instanceof \Traversable) {
                $rows = [];
                foreach ($value as $row) { $rows[] = $row; }
                $value = $rows;
            }
            if (!is_array($value)) { throw new \RuntimeException('Unexpected original Akeneo response shape.'); }
            return ['state' => 'PRESENT', 'data' => $value];
        } catch (HttpException $e) {
            if ($e->getResponse()->getStatusCode() !== 404) { throw $e; }
            return ['state' => 'MISSING', 'data' => null];
        }
    }

    public function capture(string $projectId, string $captureId, array $selection): array
    {
        $ids = $selection['identifiers'] ?? null;
        if ($projectId === '' || $captureId === '' || !is_array($ids) || !array_is_list($ids)
            || !$ids || count($ids) > 10000 || count(array_unique($ids, SORT_STRING)) !== count($ids)) {
            throw new \InvalidArgumentException('Select an explicit unique original product identifier cohort.');
        }
        foreach ($ids as $id) {
            if (!is_string($id) || $id === '' || str_contains($id, "\0")) { throw new \InvalidArgumentException('Invalid native product identifier.'); }
        }
        return $this->journal->lock('source-capture:' . $captureId, function () use ($projectId, $captureId, $selection, $ids): array {
            $state = $this->journal->read('capture', $captureId);
            $binding = ['project_id' => $projectId, 'selection' => $selection, 'authority' => $this->context->baseUrl()];
            if ($state && $state['binding'] !== $binding) { throw new \RuntimeException('Capture ID already belongs to another original selection.'); }
            if (($state['state'] ?? null) === 'COMPLETE') { return $state['snapshot']; }
            $state ??= ['schema' => 'tjl.catalogue.capture-journal.v1', 'id' => $captureId,
                'project_id' => $projectId, 'selection' => $selection, 'binding' => $binding,
                'state' => 'PREPARED', 'created_at' => PrivateJournal::now(), 'calls' => []];
            $state['state'] = 'CAPTURING';
            $this->journal->write('capture', $captureId, $state);
            try {
                $result = $this->context->run('capture', $projectId, $captureId, [], function () use (&$state, $captureId, $ids, $selection): array {
                    $calls = []; $values = []; $graph = ['models' => [], 'families' => [], 'family_variants' => [], 'attributes' => [], 'options' => [], 'media' => [], 'categories' => [], 'channels' => [], 'locales' => []];
                    $read = function (string $api, array $arguments, string $method = 'get') use (&$calls, &$values, &$state, $captureId): array {
                        $call = compact('api', 'method', 'arguments');
                        $id = PrivateJournal::hash($call);
                        if (isset($values[$id])) { return $values[$id]; }
                        $calls[$id] = $call;
                        $state['calls'] = array_values($calls);
                        $this->journal->write('capture', $captureId, $state);
                        return $values[$id] = $this->apiCall($call);
                    };
                    $attributes = []; $valueSets = []; $modelSeen = []; $familySeen = []; $categorySeen = [];
                    $family = function (?string $code) use (&$familySeen, &$attributes, &$graph, $read): void {
                        if (!$code || isset($familySeen[$code])) { return; }
                        $familySeen[$code] = true;
                        $row = $read('family', [$code]); $graph['families'][$code] = $row;
                        foreach ($row['data']['attributes'] ?? [] as $a) { $attributes[(string) $a] = true; }
                    };
                    $model = function (string $code) use (&$model, &$modelSeen, &$attributes, &$valueSets, &$graph, $read, $family): void {
                        if (isset($modelSeen[$code])) { return; }
                        $modelSeen[$code] = true;
                        $row = $read('product_model', [$code]); $graph['models'][$code] = $row;
                        if ($row['state'] !== 'PRESENT') { return; }
                        $data = $row['data'];
                        $family($data['family'] ?? null);
                        if (!empty($data['family']) && !empty($data['family_variant'])) {
                            $variant = $read('family_variant', [$data['family'], $data['family_variant']]);
                            $graph['family_variants'][$data['family'] . '/' . $data['family_variant']] = $variant;
                            foreach ($variant['data']['variant_attribute_sets'] ?? [] as $set) {
                                foreach (array_merge($set['attributes'] ?? [], $set['axes'] ?? []) as $a) { $attributes[(string) $a] = true; }
                            }
                        }
                        foreach ($data['values'] ?? [] as $a => $rows) {
                            $attributes[$a] = true; $valueSets[$a] = array_merge($valueSets[$a] ?? [], $rows);
                        }
                        if (!empty($data['parent'])) { $model($data['parent']); }
                    };
                    $category = function (string $code) use (&$category, &$categorySeen, &$graph, $read): void {
                        if (isset($categorySeen[$code])) { return; }
                        $categorySeen[$code] = true;
                        $row = $read('category', [$code]); $graph['categories'][$code] = $row;
                        if (!empty($row['data']['parent'])) { $category($row['data']['parent']); }
                    };
                    $products = [];
                    foreach ($ids as $identifier) {
                        $row = $read('product', [$identifier]);
                        $products[$identifier] = $row;
                        if ($row['state'] !== 'PRESENT') { continue; }
                        $data = $row['data'];
                        $family($data['family'] ?? null);
                        if (!empty($data['parent'])) { $model($data['parent']); }
                        foreach ($data['categories'] ?? [] as $code) { $category((string) $code); }
                        foreach ($data['values'] ?? [] as $a => $rows) {
                            $attributes[$a] = true; $valueSets[$a] = array_merge($valueSets[$a] ?? [], $rows);
                        }
                    }
                    foreach (array_keys($attributes) as $attribute) {
                        $row = $read('attribute', [$attribute]); $graph['attributes'][$attribute] = $row;
                        $type = $row['data']['type'] ?? '';
                        if (in_array($type, ['pim_catalog_simpleselect', 'pim_catalog_multiselect'], true)) {
                            // Original plugin ProductAttributeHelperTrait uses all(attribute) with native default page size 10.
                            $graph['options'][$attribute] = $read('attribute_option', [$attribute], 'all');
                        }
                        foreach ($valueSets[$attribute] ?? [] as $value) {
                            if (!empty($value['locale'])) { $graph['locales'][$value['locale']] = $read('locale', [$value['locale']]); }
                            if (!empty($value['scope'])) { $graph['channels'][$value['scope']] = $read('channel', [$value['scope']]); }
                            $data = $value['data'] ?? null;
                            if (in_array($type, ['pim_catalog_image', 'pim_catalog_file'], true) && is_string($data) && $data !== '') {
                                $graph['media'][$data] = ['metadata' => $read('media', [$data]), 'download' => $read('media', [$data], 'download')];
                            } elseif (in_array($type, ['pim_catalog_simpleselect', 'pim_catalog_multiselect'], true)) {
                                foreach (is_array($data) ? $data : [$data] as $option) {
                                    if (is_string($option) && $option !== '') { $read('attribute_option', [$attribute, $option]); }
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                    foreach ($selection['additional_requests'] ?? [] as $call) {
                        if (!is_array($call)) { throw new \InvalidArgumentException('Invalid additional native request descriptor.'); }
                        $read($call['api'] ?? '', $call['arguments'] ?? [], $call['method'] ?? 'get');
                    }
                    return ['products' => $products, 'graph' => $graph, 'calls' => array_values($calls)];
                });
                $sources = $this->context->sources($captureId);
                foreach ($sources as $source) {
                    if ($source['state'] !== 'COMPLETE' || !(($source['status'] >= 200 && $source['status'] < 300) || $source['status'] === 404)) {
                        throw new \RuntimeException('Original source graph contains an incomplete or failed native response.');
                    }
                }
                if (!$sources) { throw new \RuntimeException('Native client is not connected to the retained HTTP transport.'); }
                $sourceIds = array_column($sources, 'id');
                foreach ($result['products'] as &$product) { $product['source_ids'] = $sourceIds; }
                unset($product);
                $snapshot = ['schema' => 'tjl.catalogue.source-snapshot.v1', 'state' => 'COMPLETE',
                    'id' => $captureId, 'project_id' => $projectId, 'selection' => $selection,
                    'authority' => $this->context->baseUrl(), 'products' => $result['products'], 'graph' => $result['graph'],
                    'calls' => $result['calls'], 'requests' => array_column($sources, 'request'), 'sources' => $sources,
                    'created_at' => $state['created_at'], 'completed_at' => PrivateJournal::now()];
                $snapshot['sha256'] = PrivateJournal::hash($snapshot);
                $state['state'] = 'COMPLETE'; $state['snapshot'] = $snapshot;
                $this->journal->write('capture', $captureId, $state);
                return $snapshot;
            } catch (\Throwable $e) {
                $state['state'] = 'ATTENTION'; $state['error_type'] = get_class($e);
                $state['failed_at'] = PrivateJournal::now();
                $this->journal->write('capture', $captureId, $state);
                throw $e;
            }
        });
    }

    private function committed(string $projectId, string $operationId): bool
    {
        $record = $this->store->object('import', $operationId);
        if ($record && ($record['_record']['project_id'] ?? $record['project_id'] ?? null) !== $projectId) {
            throw new \RuntimeException('Native import operation belongs to another project.');
        }
        return $record && in_array($record['state'] ?? '', ['APPLIED', 'COMPLETE'], true);
    }

    public function withApproved(string $projectId, string $operationId, array $snapshot, callable $call): mixed
    {
        $unsigned = $snapshot; unset($unsigned['sha256']);
        if (($snapshot['schema'] ?? '') !== 'tjl.catalogue.source-snapshot.v1' || ($snapshot['state'] ?? '') !== 'COMPLETE'
            || ($snapshot['project_id'] ?? null) !== $projectId || ($snapshot['authority'] ?? null) !== $this->context->baseUrl()
            || !hash_equals((string) ($snapshot['sha256'] ?? ''), PrivateJournal::hash($unsigned))) {
            throw new \RuntimeException('Use the complete original approved source snapshot.');
        }
        if ($this->active !== null) {
            if ($this->active !== [$projectId, $operationId, $snapshot['sha256']]) {
                throw new \RuntimeException('A different import cannot enter this native source transaction.');
            }
            return $call();
        }
        if ($this->store->connection()->isTransactionActive()) {
            throw new \RuntimeException('Place the approved source gateway outside the outermost native Doctrine transaction.');
        }
        return $this->journal->lock('native-source-media', function () use ($projectId, $operationId, $snapshot, $call): mixed {
            $binding = ['project_id' => $projectId, 'operation_id' => $operationId, 'snapshot_id' => $snapshot['id'], 'source_sha256' => $snapshot['sha256']];
            $operation = $this->journal->read('apply', $operationId);
            if ($operation && $operation['binding'] !== $binding) { throw new \RuntimeException('Native operation source selection changed.'); }
            $operation ??= ['schema' => 'tjl.catalogue.source-operation.v1', 'binding' => $binding,
                            'state' => 'PREPARED', 'checks' => [], 'created_at' => PrivateJournal::now()];
            $approved = [];
            foreach ($snapshot['sources'] as $source) {
                if (isset($approved[$source['id']]) || $source['id'] !== PrivateJournal::hash($source['request'])) {
                    throw new \RuntimeException('Approved native source request identities are invalid.');
                }
                $this->store->blobPath($source['body']);
                $approved[$source['id']] = $source;
            }
            $committed = $this->committed($projectId, $operationId);
            if (!$committed) {
                $checkId = $operationId . ':check:' . count($operation['checks']);
                $operation['state'] = 'CHECKING';
                $operation['checks'][] = ['id' => $checkId, 'state' => 'REQUESTING', 'at' => PrivateJournal::now()];
                $this->journal->write('apply', $operationId, $operation);
                try {
                    $this->context->run('check', $projectId, $checkId, [], function () use ($snapshot): void {
                        foreach ($snapshot['calls'] as $request) { $this->apiCall($request); }
                    });
                    $current = [];
                    foreach ($this->context->sources($checkId) as $source) { $current[$source['id']] = $source; }
                    if (array_diff_key($approved, $current) || array_diff_key($current, $approved)) {
                        throw new \RuntimeException('Native source dependency set changed; capture and review a following edition.');
                    }
                    foreach ($approved as $id => $old) {
                        $now = $current[$id];
                        if ($now['state'] !== 'COMPLETE' || $old['request'] !== $now['request'] || $old['status'] !== $now['status']
                            || $old['body']['sha256'] !== $now['body']['sha256'] || $old['body']['bytes'] !== $now['body']['bytes']) {
                            throw new \RuntimeException('Native source changed before import; retain both editions and review the following capture.');
                        }
                    }
                    $operation['checks'][array_key_last($operation['checks'])]['state'] = 'MATCHED';
                } catch (\Throwable $e) {
                    $operation['state'] = 'SOURCE_ATTENTION'; $operation['error_type'] = get_class($e);
                    $this->journal->write('apply', $operationId, $operation);
                    throw $e;
                }
            }
            $this->media->begin($projectId, $operationId, $snapshot['sha256'], $committed);
            $this->active = [$projectId, $operationId, $snapshot['sha256']];
            try {
                if ($committed) { $this->media->commit(); }
                $operation['state'] = $committed ? 'RECEIPT_RECOVERY' : 'IMPORTING';
                $this->journal->write('apply', $operationId, $operation);
                // The caller wraps the ENTIRE original result/Doctrine middleware chain.
                $result = $this->context->run('replay', $projectId, $operationId, $approved, $call);
                if ($this->store->connection()->isTransactionActive()) {
                    throw new \RuntimeException('Original native transaction has not completed; media remains staged.');
                }
                if ($this->committed($projectId, $operationId)) {
                    $this->media->commit();
                    $operation['state'] = 'COMPLETE';
                } elseif (!$this->media->hasWrites()) {
                    // Native asynchronous dispatch has queued its original message but not imported it yet.
                    $operation['state'] = 'AWAITING_NATIVE_IMPORT';
                    $this->media->abort();
                } else {
                    $this->media->abort();
                    $operation['state'] = 'NOT_COMMITTED';
                    throw new \RuntimeException('Staged media has no surviving original Doctrine import marker.');
                }
                $operation['ended_at'] = PrivateJournal::now();
                $this->journal->write('apply', $operationId, $operation);
                return $result;
            } catch (\Throwable $e) {
                try {
                    if ($this->store->connection()->isTransactionActive()) { throw new \RuntimeException('Native commit remains pending.'); }
                    $committedNow = $this->committed($projectId, $operationId);
                } catch (\Throwable $commitError) {
                    $operation['state'] = 'COMMIT_UNCERTAIN';
                    $operation['error_type'] = get_class($e);
                    $operation['commit_error_type'] = get_class($commitError);
                    $this->journal->write('apply', $operationId, $operation);
                    throw $e;
                }
                if ($committedNow) {
                    $operation['state'] = 'MEDIA_PENDING';
                    // Preserve the committed source and staged files even if native result persistence failed.
                    try { $this->media->commit(); $operation['state'] = 'NATIVE_RECEIPT_PENDING'; }
                    catch (\Throwable $mediaError) { $operation['media_error_type'] = get_class($mediaError); }
                } else {
                    $this->media->abort();
                    $operation['state'] = 'NOT_COMMITTED';
                }
                $operation['error_type'] = get_class($e);
                $this->journal->write('apply', $operationId, $operation);
                throw $e;
            } finally { $this->active = null; $this->media->end(); }
        });
    }
}

declare(strict_types=1);
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
namespace Tjl\CatalogueWorkspace\Source;

use Http\Discovery\Psr18ClientDiscovery;
use Symfony\Component\DependencyInjection\ContainerBuilder;
use Symfony\Component\DependencyInjection\Reference;
use Tjl\CatalogueWorkspace\Store;
use Webgriffe\SyliusAkeneoPlugin\ValueHandler\FileAttributeValueHandler;

/** Called by the owning bundle extension, then its native compiler pass. */
final class SourceServices
{
    public static function register(ContainerBuilder $container): void
    {
        $container->register(PrivateJournal::class, PrivateJournal::class)->setArguments(['%tjl_catalogue_workspace.directory%']);
        $container->register(SourceContext::class, SourceContext::class)->setArguments([
            new Reference(Store::class), new Reference(PrivateJournal::class),
            '%webgriffe_sylius_akeneo.api_client.base_url%', '%tjl_catalogue_workspace.max_export_bytes%',
        ]);
        $container->register('tjl_catalogue_workspace.native_http_client', \Psr\Http\Client\ClientInterface::class)
            ->setFactory([Psr18ClientDiscovery::class, 'find']);
        $container->register(RetainedHttpClient::class, RetainedHttpClient::class)->setArguments([
            new Reference('tjl_catalogue_workspace.native_http_client'), new Reference(SourceContext::class),
        ]);
        $container->register(MediaJournal::class, MediaJournal::class)->setArguments([
            new Reference(Store::class), new Reference(PrivateJournal::class),
            new Reference('sylius.adapter.filesystem.default'), new Reference('sylius.storage'), [],
        ]);
        $container->register(JournaledFilesystem::class, JournaledFilesystem::class)->setArguments([new Reference(MediaJournal::class)]);
        $container->register(JournaledImageStorage::class, JournaledImageStorage::class)->setArguments([
            new Reference('sylius.adapter.filesystem.default'), new Reference(MediaJournal::class),
        ]);
        $container->register(SourceGateway::class, SourceGateway::class)->setArguments([
            new Reference(Store::class), new Reference(PrivateJournal::class), new Reference(SourceContext::class),
            new Reference(MediaJournal::class), new Reference('webgriffe_sylius_akeneo.api_client'),
        ]);
    }

    public static function compile(ContainerBuilder $container): void
    {
        foreach (['webgriffe_sylius_akeneo.api_client.factory', 'webgriffe_sylius_akeneo.api_client',
                  'sylius.uploader.image', 'sylius.adapter.filesystem.default', 'sylius.storage'] as $id) {
            if (!$container->has($id)) { throw new \RuntimeException('Install the selected native Sylius/Akeneo service before catalogue integration: ' . $id); }
        }
        $builder = $container->findDefinition('webgriffe_sylius_akeneo.api_client.factory');
        $calls = [];
        foreach ($builder->getMethodCalls() as $call) {
            if ($call[0] === 'setHttpClient') {
                $existing = $call[1][0] ?? null;
                if (!$existing instanceof Reference || (string) $existing !== RetainedHttpClient::class) {
                    $container->findDefinition(RetainedHttpClient::class)->setArgument(0, $existing);
                }
                continue;
            }
            if (in_array($call[0], ['enableCache', 'disableCache'], true)) { continue; }
            $calls[] = $call;
        }
        $builder->setMethodCalls($calls);
        $builder->addMethodCall('setHttpClient', [new Reference(RetainedHttpClient::class)]);
        $builder->addMethodCall('disableCache');

        $roots = [];
        foreach ($container->findTaggedServiceIds('webgriffe_sylius_akeneo.product.value_handler') as $id => $_) {
            $definition = $container->findDefinition($id);
            if ($definition->getClass() !== FileAttributeValueHandler::class) { continue; }
            $args = $definition->getArguments();
            $root = $args['$downloadPath'] ?? $args[4] ?? null;
            if (!is_string($root) || $root === '') { throw new \RuntimeException('Retain the explicit native file-handler destination for ' . $id); }
            $roots['handler-' . substr(hash('sha256', $id), 0, 24)] = $root;
            $definition->setArgument(array_key_exists('$filesystem', $args) ? '$filesystem' : 1, new Reference(JournaledFilesystem::class));
        }
        ksort($roots);
        $container->findDefinition(MediaJournal::class)->setArgument(4, $roots);
        $uploader = $container->findDefinition('sylius.uploader.image');
        $args = $uploader->getArguments();
        $original = $args['$filesystem'] ?? $args[0] ?? null;
        if (!$original instanceof Reference) { throw new \RuntimeException('Select the native Sylius image adapter explicitly.'); }
        if ((string) $original !== JournaledImageStorage::class) {
            $container->findDefinition(MediaJournal::class)->setArgument(2, $original);
            $container->findDefinition(JournaledImageStorage::class)->setArgument(0, $original);
        }
        $uploader->setArgument(array_key_exists('$filesystem', $args) ? '$filesystem' : 0, new Reference(JournaledImageStorage::class));
    }
}

<?php
declare(strict_types=1);

namespace Tjl\CatalogueWorkspace;

use Doctrine\DBAL\Connection;
use Doctrine\DBAL\Schema\Schema;

/**
 * Review records share the original Sylius database connection. Immutable source
 * blobs and command journals use the selected shared private filesystem.
 */
final class Store
{
    private array $locks = [];

    public function __construct(private Connection $connection, private string $directory)
    {
        if ($directory === '' || $directory[0] !== '/' || str_contains($directory, "\0")) {
            throw new \InvalidArgumentException('Select an absolute private catalogue workspace directory.');
        }
        if (is_link($directory)) {
            throw new \RuntimeException('The private workspace root cannot be a symbolic link.');
        }
        if (!is_dir($directory) && !mkdir($directory, 0700, true) && !is_dir($directory)) {
            throw new \RuntimeException('Cannot create the private workspace directory.');
        }
        $this->directory = realpath($directory) ?: throw new \RuntimeException('Cannot resolve workspace directory.');
        foreach (['blobs', 'locks', 'temporary', 'journals'] as $child) {
            $path = $this->directory . '/' . $child;
            if (is_link($path) || (!is_dir($path) && !mkdir($path, 0700, true) && !is_dir($path))) {
                throw new \RuntimeException('Cannot use the private workspace ' . $child . '.');
            }
        }
    }

    public function root(): string { return $this->directory; }
    public function connection(): Connection { return $this->connection; }

    /** Explicit native installation action; this never alters existing tables. */
    public function install(): array
    {
        $manager = $this->connection->createSchemaManager();
        if ($manager->tablesExist(['tjl_catalogue_record'])) {
            $columns = $manager->listTableColumns('tjl_catalogue_record');
            foreach (['kind', 'id', 'project_id', 'revision', 'payload', 'updated_at'] as $name) {
                if (!isset($columns[$name])) {
                    throw new \RuntimeException('The existing catalogue table has an incompatible original schema.');
                }
            }
            return ['state' => 'COMPLETE', 'existing' => true];
        }
        $schema = new Schema();
        $table = $schema->createTable('tjl_catalogue_record');
        $table->addColumn('kind', 'string', ['length' => 64]);
        $table->addColumn('id', 'string', ['length' => 128]);
        $table->addColumn('project_id', 'string', ['length' => 128]);
        $table->addColumn('revision', 'integer');
        $table->addColumn('payload', 'text');
        $table->addColumn('updated_at', 'string', ['length' => 40]);
        $table->setPrimaryKey(['kind', 'id']);
        $table->addIndex(['project_id', 'kind', 'id'], 'tjl_catalogue_project');
        foreach ($schema->toSql($this->connection->getDatabasePlatform()) as $sql) {
            $this->connection->executeStatement($sql);
        }
        return ['state' => 'COMPLETE', 'existing' => false];
    }

    public function object(string $kind, string $id): ?array
    {
        $row = $this->connection->fetchAssociative(
            'SELECT kind, id, project_id, revision, payload FROM tjl_catalogue_record WHERE kind = ? AND id = ?',
            [Support::id($kind), Support::id($id)],
        );
        return $row === false ? null : $this->decode($row);
    }

    public function require(string $kind, string $id, ?string $projectId = null): array
    {
        $row = $this->object($kind, $id) ?? throw new \RuntimeException('The original ' . $kind . ' record is missing: ' . $id);
        if ($projectId !== null && $row['_record']['project_id'] !== $projectId) {
            throw new \RuntimeException('This record belongs to another original project.');
        }
        return $row;
    }

    public function put(string $kind, string $id, string $projectId, array $value, ?int $expectedRevision): array
    {
        Support::id($kind); Support::id($id); Support::id($projectId);
        $value = Support::withoutRecord($value);
        $payload = Support::json($value);
        $now = Support::now();
        $revision = $expectedRevision === null ? 1 : $expectedRevision + 1;
        if ($expectedRevision === null) {
            $this->connection->insert('tjl_catalogue_record', [
                'kind' => $kind, 'id' => $id, 'project_id' => $projectId,
                'revision' => $revision, 'payload' => $payload, 'updated_at' => $now,
            ]);
        } else {
            $count = $this->connection->executeStatement(
                'UPDATE tjl_catalogue_record SET payload = ?, revision = ?, updated_at = ? WHERE kind = ? AND id = ? AND project_id = ? AND revision = ?',
                [$payload, $revision, $now, $kind, $id, $projectId, $expectedRevision],
            );
            if ($count !== 1) {
                throw new \RuntimeException('The original record changed; read its current revision before continuing.');
            }
        }
        return $value + ['_record' => ['kind' => $kind, 'id' => $id, 'project_id' => $projectId, 'revision' => $revision]];
    }

    public function save(array $record): array
    {
        $binding = $record['_record'] ?? throw new \InvalidArgumentException('Save requires the original record binding.');
        return $this->put($binding['kind'], $binding['id'], $binding['project_id'], $record, $binding['revision']);
    }

    public function original(string $kind, string $id, string $projectId, array $value): array
    {
        $existing = $this->object($kind, $id);
        if ($existing !== null) {
            if ($existing['_record']['project_id'] !== $projectId || Support::hash(Support::withoutRecord($existing)) !== Support::hash($value)) {
                throw new \RuntimeException('The immutable original ' . $kind . ' identity already names different bytes.');
            }
            return $existing;
        }
        return $this->put($kind, $id, $projectId, $value, null);
    }

    public function records(string $kind, string $projectId, int $limit = 100, int $offset = 0): array
    {
        if ($limit < 1 || $limit > 1000 || $offset < 0) {
            throw new \InvalidArgumentException('Select a record page of 1–1000 rows.');
        }
        $query = $this->connection->createQueryBuilder();
        $query->select('kind', 'id', 'project_id', 'revision', 'payload')->from('tjl_catalogue_record')
            ->where('kind = :kind')->andWhere('project_id = :project')
            ->setParameter('kind', Support::id($kind))->setParameter('project', Support::id($projectId))
            ->orderBy('id', 'ASC')->setMaxResults($limit)->setFirstResult($offset);
        return array_map($this->decode(...), $query->executeQuery()->fetchAllAssociative());
    }

    public function projects(int $offset = 0, int $limit = 100): array
    {
        if ($offset < 0 || $limit < 1 || $limit > 500) { throw new \InvalidArgumentException('Select a bounded project page.'); }
        $query = $this->connection->createQueryBuilder();
        $query->select('kind', 'id', 'project_id', 'revision', 'payload')->from('tjl_catalogue_record')
            ->where('kind = :kind')->setParameter('kind', 'project')->orderBy('id', 'ASC')
            ->setMaxResults($limit)->setFirstResult($offset);
        return array_map($this->decode(...), $query->executeQuery()->fetchAllAssociative());
    }

    public function allProject(string $projectId): \Generator
    {
        $result = $this->connection->executeQuery(
            'SELECT kind, id, project_id, revision, payload FROM tjl_catalogue_record WHERE project_id = ? ORDER BY kind, id',
            [Support::id($projectId)],
        );
        while (($row = $result->fetchAssociative()) !== false) {
            yield $this->decode($row);
        }
    }

    /** The archive was fully authenticated before entering this native transaction. */
    public function receiveOriginal(array $record): void
    {
        $binding = $record['_record'] ?? throw new \InvalidArgumentException('Missing original record identity.');
        $kind = Support::id($binding['kind']); $id = Support::id($binding['id']); $project = Support::id($binding['project_id']);
        if (!is_int($binding['revision']) || $binding['revision'] < 1) { throw new \InvalidArgumentException('Invalid original revision.'); }
        $existing = $this->object($kind, $id);
        if ($existing !== null) {
            if (Support::hash($existing) !== Support::hash($record)) { throw new \RuntimeException('An existing native record differs from the received original; preserve its current project.'); }
            return;
        }
        $this->connection->insert('tjl_catalogue_record', [
            'kind' => $kind, 'id' => $id, 'project_id' => $project, 'revision' => $binding['revision'],
            'payload' => Support::json(Support::withoutRecord($record)), 'updated_at' => Support::now(),
        ]);
    }

    public function atomic(callable $callback): mixed
    {
        return $this->connection->transactional(fn () => $callback());
    }

    /** Same shared directory is required by the installed worker and operator. */
    public function lock(string $key, callable $callback): mixed
    {
        $key = hash('sha256', $key);
        if (isset($this->locks[$key])) {
            return $callback();
        }
        $path = $this->directory . '/locks/' . $key . '.lock';
        if (is_link($path)) {
            throw new \RuntimeException('The original operation lock is linked.');
        }
        $handle = fopen($path, 'c+b');
        if ($handle === false || !flock($handle, LOCK_EX | LOCK_NB)) {
            if (is_resource($handle)) { fclose($handle); }
            throw new \RuntimeException('The same original catalogue operation is already running.');
        }
        chmod($path, 0600);
        $this->locks[$key] = $handle;
        try {
            return $callback();
        } finally {
            unset($this->locks[$key]);
            flock($handle, LOCK_UN);
            fclose($handle);
        }
    }

    public function temporaryPath(string $suffix = '.part'): string
    {
        if (!preg_match('/\A[.A-Za-z0-9_-]{0,32}\z/D', $suffix)) {
            throw new \InvalidArgumentException('Invalid private temporary suffix.');
        }
        $path = tempnam($this->directory . '/temporary', 'catalogue-');
        if ($path === false) { throw new \RuntimeException('Cannot allocate original private bytes.'); }
        chmod($path, 0600);
        if ($suffix !== '') {
            $next = $path . $suffix;
            if (!rename($path, $next)) { throw new \RuntimeException('Cannot retain the private temporary path.'); }
            $path = $next;
        }
        return $path;
    }

    public function blob(string $bytes): array
    {
        $path = $this->temporaryPath();
        try {
            $written = file_put_contents($path, $bytes, LOCK_EX);
            if ($written !== strlen($bytes)) { throw new \RuntimeException('The original bytes were not written completely.'); }
            return $this->blobFile($path);
        } finally { @unlink($path); }
    }

    /** Copies input; the original caller-owned source path is never removed. */
    public function blobFile(string $source): array
    {
        if (!is_file($source) || is_link($source)) { throw new \RuntimeException('Select a complete ordinary original file.'); }
        $sha = hash_file('sha256', $source);
        $size = filesize($source);
        if (!is_string($sha) || !is_int($size)) { throw new \RuntimeException('Cannot read original source identity.'); }
        $relative = 'blobs/' . $sha;
        $destination = $this->directory . '/' . $relative;
        if (!file_exists($destination)) {
            $stage = $this->temporaryPath();
            try {
                if (!copy($source, $stage) || filesize($stage) !== $size || hash_file('sha256', $stage) !== $sha) {
                    throw new \RuntimeException('The complete original file changed during receiving.');
                }
                chmod($stage, 0600);
                $handle = fopen($stage, 'r+b');
                if ($handle === false) { throw new \RuntimeException('Cannot sync the retained original bytes.'); }
                try { if (!fsync($handle)) { throw new \RuntimeException('Cannot sync retained bytes.'); } } finally { fclose($handle); }
                if (!@link($stage, $destination) && !is_file($destination)) {
                    throw new \RuntimeException('Cannot publish the complete private source file.');
                }
            } finally { @unlink($stage); }
        }
        $result = ['sha256' => $sha, 'bytes' => $size, 'path' => $relative];
        $this->blobPath($result);
        return $result;
    }

    public function blobPath(array $blob): string
    {
        $sha = $blob['sha256'] ?? '';
        if (!is_string($sha) || !preg_match('/\A[a-f0-9]{64}\z/D', $sha) ||
            ($blob['path'] ?? '') !== 'blobs/' . $sha || !is_int($blob['bytes'] ?? null)) {
            throw new \InvalidArgumentException('Select the complete original source descriptor.');
        }
        $path = $this->directory . '/' . $blob['path'];
        if (is_link($path) || !is_file($path) || filesize($path) !== $blob['bytes'] || hash_file('sha256', $path) !== $sha) {
            throw new \RuntimeException('Original private source bytes are missing or different.');
        }
        return $path;
    }

    public function readBlob(array $blob): string
    {
        $bytes = file_get_contents($this->blobPath($blob));
        if ($bytes === false) { throw new \RuntimeException('Cannot read complete original bytes.'); }
        return $bytes;
    }

    public function journal(string $name, array $value): array
    {
        Support::id($name);
        $blob = $this->blob(Support::json($value) . "\n");
        $path = $this->directory . '/journals/' . $name . '.json';
        $existing = is_file($path) ? file_get_contents($path) : false;
        $encoded = Support::json($blob) . "\n";
        if ($existing !== false && $existing !== $encoded) {
            throw new \RuntimeException('Retain the original journal edition; use a distinct attempt identity.');
        }
        if (is_link($path)) { throw new \RuntimeException('The original journal pointer is linked.'); }
        if ($existing === false) {
            $temporary = $this->temporaryPath('.journal');
            try {
                $handle = fopen($temporary, 'w+b');
                if ($handle === false) { throw new \RuntimeException('Cannot allocate the original journal pointer.'); }
                try {
                    if (fwrite($handle, $encoded) !== strlen($encoded) || !fflush($handle) || !fsync($handle)) {
                        throw new \RuntimeException('Original journal publication is incomplete.');
                    }
                } finally { fclose($handle); }
                if (!@link($temporary, $path) && (!is_file($path) || file_get_contents($path) !== $encoded)) {
                    throw new \RuntimeException('The original journal was created with different bytes.');
                }
                $directory = fopen(dirname($path), 'r');
                if ($directory !== false) { try { fsync($directory); } finally { fclose($directory); } }
            } finally { @unlink($temporary); }
        }
        return $blob;
    }

    /** Original import attempts live outside SQL rollback and travel with the selected project. */
    public function importJournals(string $projectId): array
    {
        $result = [];
        foreach (glob($this->directory . '/journals/import-*.json') ?: [] as $path) {
            if (is_link($path) || !is_file($path)) { throw new \RuntimeException('Invalid original import journal.'); }
            $pointer = json_decode((string) file_get_contents($path), true, 512, JSON_THROW_ON_ERROR);
            $value = json_decode($this->readBlob($pointer), true, 512, JSON_THROW_ON_ERROR);
            $owner = $value['project_id'] ?? null;
            if ($owner === null && isset($value['operation_id'])) {
                $owner = ($this->object('import', $value['operation_id']))['_record']['project_id'] ?? null;
            }
            if ($owner === $projectId) { $result[] = ['name' => basename($path, '.json'), 'blob' => $pointer]; }
        }
        return $result;
    }

    private function decode(array $row): array
    {
        $value = json_decode($row['payload'], true, 512, JSON_THROW_ON_ERROR);
        if (!is_array($value) || array_is_list($value) && $value !== []) {
            throw new \RuntimeException('The native catalogue record is not an object.');
        }
        $value['_record'] = ['kind' => $row['kind'], 'id' => $row['id'], 'project_id' => $row['project_id'], 'revision' => (int) $row['revision']];
        return $value;
    }
}

<?php
declare(strict_types=1);

namespace Tjl\CatalogueWorkspace;

/** Lossless JSON storage for native PHP values; source response bytes remain separate. */
final class Support
{
    public static function json(mixed $value): string
    {
        return json_encode($value, JSON_THROW_ON_ERROR | JSON_UNESCAPED_SLASHES | JSON_UNESCAPED_UNICODE | JSON_PRESERVE_ZERO_FRACTION);
    }

    public static function canonical(mixed $value): string
    {
        if (is_object($value)) {
            $value = get_object_vars($value);
            ksort($value, SORT_STRING);
            $parts = [];
            foreach ($value as $key => $item) {
                $parts[] = self::json((string) $key) . ':' . self::canonical($item);
            }
            return '{' . implode(',', $parts) . '}';
        }
        if (!is_array($value)) {
            return self::json($value);
        }
        if (array_is_list($value)) {
            return '[' . implode(',', array_map(self::canonical(...), $value)) . ']';
        }
        ksort($value, SORT_STRING);
        $parts = [];
        foreach ($value as $key => $item) {
            $parts[] = self::json((string) $key) . ':' . self::canonical($item);
        }
        return '{' . implode(',', $parts) . '}';
    }

    public static function hash(mixed $value): string
    {
        return hash('sha256', self::canonical($value));
    }

    public static function now(): string
    {
        return (new \DateTimeImmutable('now', new \DateTimeZone('UTC')))->format('Y-m-d\TH:i:s.u\Z');
    }

    public static function id(string $value): string
    {
        if (!preg_match('/\A[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_.-]{0,127}\z/D', $value)) {
            throw new \InvalidArgumentException('Use an original identifier containing letters, digits, dot, underscore or hyphen, up to 128 characters.');
        }
        return $value;
    }

    public static function requiredString(array $input, string $key, int $maximum = 2000): string
    {
        $value = $input[$key] ?? null;
        if (!is_string($value) || $value === '' || strlen($value) > $maximum || str_contains($value, "\0")) {
            throw new \InvalidArgumentException('Supply the complete ' . $key . '.');
        }
        return $value;
    }

    public static function strings(mixed $value, string $name, int $limit = 5000): array
    {
        if (!is_array($value) || !array_is_list($value) || count($value) > $limit) {
            throw new \InvalidArgumentException($name . ' must be an explicit bounded list.');
        }
        $seen = [];
        foreach ($value as $item) {
            if (!is_string($item) || $item === '' || strlen($item) > 1000 || str_contains($item, "\0") || isset($seen[$item])) {
                throw new \InvalidArgumentException($name . ' contains an invalid or repeated original value.');
            }
            $seen[$item] = true;
        }
        return $value;
    }

    public static function withoutRecord(array $value): array
    {
        unset($value['_record']);
        return $value;
    }

    public static function error(\Throwable $error): array
    {
        return ['type' => $error::class, 'message' => $error->getMessage(), 'at' => self::now()];
    }
}
