<?php
declare(strict_types=1);
namespace Tjl\CatalogueWorkspace;

use Symfony\Component\Messenger\Envelope;
use Symfony\Component\Messenger\MessageBusInterface;
use Tjl\CatalogueWorkspace\Import\ImportStamp;
use Tjl\CatalogueWorkspace\Source\SourceGateway;
use Webgriffe\SyliusAkeneoPlugin\Message\ItemImport;

final class Workspace
{
    public function __construct(
        private Store $store,
        private Engine $engine,
        private NativeCatalogue $catalogue,
        private SourceGateway $source,
        private MessageBusInterface $bus,
        private ProjectArchive $archive,
    ) {}

    public function execute(string $action, array $input, string $operationId, string $actor): array
    {
        Support::id($operationId);
        if ($actor === '') { throw new \InvalidArgumentException('The original authenticated native actor is required.'); }
        if ($action === 'install') {
            return $this->envelope($action, $operationId, null, $this->store->install());
        }
        if ($action === 'engine') { return $this->envelope($action, $operationId, null, $this->engine->describe()); }
        if ($action === 'projects') {
            return $this->envelope($action, $operationId, null, ['projects' => $this->store->projects((int) ($input['offset'] ?? 0), (int) ($input['limit'] ?? 100))]);
        }
        $projectId = Support::id(Support::requiredString($input, 'project_id', 128));
        $read = match ($action) {
            'project' => fn () => $this->project($projectId),
            'cohort' => fn () => $this->cohort($projectId, Support::id(Support::requiredString($input, 'capture_id', 128)), (int) ($input['offset'] ?? 0), (int) ($input['limit'] ?? 50)),
            'operation' => fn () => $this->operation($projectId, Support::id(Support::requiredString($input, 'import_operation_id', 128))),
            'files' => fn () => $this->archive->files($projectId),
            'record' => fn () => $this->readRecord($projectId, $input),
            default => null,
        };
        if ($read !== null) { return $this->envelope($action, $operationId, $projectId, $read()); }
        return $this->store->lock('project:' . $projectId, function () use ($action, $input, $operationId, $actor, $projectId): array {
            $binding = ['action' => $action, 'input' => $input, 'actor' => $actor, 'project_id' => $projectId];
            $hash = Support::hash($binding);
            $request = $this->store->object('command', $operationId);
            if ($request !== null) {
                if ($request['binding_sha256'] !== $hash || $request['_record']['project_id'] !== $projectId) {
                    throw new \RuntimeException('Continue the exact original action, actor and input for this operation ID.');
                }
                if ($request['state'] === 'COMPLETE') { return $request['result']; }
            } else {
                $request = $this->store->put('command', $operationId, $projectId, [
                    'state' => 'RUNNING', 'binding' => $binding, 'binding_sha256' => $hash, 'created_at' => Support::now(),
                ], null);
            }
            try {
                $result = match ($action) {
                    'project-create' => $this->createProject($input, $request),
                    'capture' => $this->capture($projectId, $input, $request),
                    'review', 'missing-review' => $this->review($projectId, $input, $request, $action === 'missing-review'),
                    'approve' => $this->approve($projectId, $input, $request),
                    'dispatch' => $this->dispatch($projectId, $input, $request, false),
                    'retry' => $this->dispatch($projectId, $input, $request, true),
                    'missing-apply' => $this->disableMissing($projectId, $input, $request),
                    'release-claim' => $this->releaseClaim($projectId, $input),
                    'retain-unapplied' => $this->retainUnapplied($projectId, $input, $request),
                    'export' => $this->archive->export($projectId, $operationId, $actor),
                    'receive' => $this->archive->receive($projectId, Support::requiredString($input, 'archive_path'), $operationId, $actor),
                    default => throw new \InvalidArgumentException('Unknown catalogue workspace action.'),
                };
                $envelope = $this->envelope($action, $operationId, $projectId, $result);
                $request = $this->store->require('command', $operationId, $projectId);
                $request['state'] = ($action === 'capture' && $envelope['state'] !== 'COMPLETE') ? ($envelope['state'] === 'ATTENTION' ? 'ATTENTION' : 'RUNNING') : 'COMPLETE';
                $request['result'] = $envelope;
                $request['completed_at'] = Support::now();
                $this->store->save($request);
                return $envelope;
            } catch (\Throwable $error) {
                $request = $this->store->require('command', $operationId, $projectId);
                $request['state'] = 'ATTENTION';
                $request['error'] = Support::error($error);
                $this->store->save($request);
                throw $error;
            }
        });
    }

    private function readRecord(string $projectId, array $input): array
    {
        $kind = Support::requiredString($input, 'kind', 64);
        if (!in_array($kind, ['review', 'approval', 'command', 'missing-effect', 'export', 'received', 'live-pending', 'result'], true)) {
            throw new \InvalidArgumentException('Select a documented original record kind.');
        }
        return $this->store->require($kind, Support::id(Support::requiredString($input, 'id', 128)), $projectId);
    }

    public function project(string $projectId): array
    {
        $project = $this->store->require('project', $projectId, $projectId);
        $result = ['project' => $project, 'cohorts' => [], 'imports' => [], 'live_pending' => []];
        foreach (['cohort' => 'cohorts', 'import' => 'imports', 'live-pending' => 'live_pending'] as $kind => $key) {
            $offset = 0;
            do {
                $page = $this->store->records($kind, $projectId, 500, $offset);
                foreach ($page as $row) {
                    if ($kind === 'import') {
                        $observed = $this->operation($projectId, $row['_record']['id']);
                        $row = array_intersect_key($observed, array_flip(['id', 'identifier', 'approval_id', 'state', 'display_state', 'created_at', 'created_by', 'native_applied_at', 'native_result_ids', 'last_native_result', 'last_error', 'source_operation']));
                    }
                    if ($kind === 'import' && isset($row['source_operation'])) {
                        $source = $row['source_operation'];
                        $row['source_operation'] = ['state' => $source['state'] ?? null,
                            'media_state' => $source['media']['state'] ?? null, 'updated_at' => $source['updated_at'] ?? null];
                    }
                    $result[$key][] = $row;
                }
                $offset += count($page);
            } while (count($page) === 500);
        }
        return $result;
    }

    public function operation(string $projectId, string $operationId): array
    {
        $operation = $this->store->require('import', $operationId, $projectId);
        $operation['source_operation'] = $this->source->operation($operationId);
        $sourceState = $operation['source_operation']['state'] ?? null;
        if (in_array($sourceState, ['MEDIA_PENDING', 'COMMIT_UNCERTAIN', 'NATIVE_RECEIPT_PENDING'], true)) {
            $operation['display_state'] = $sourceState;
        } elseif ($operation['state'] === 'COMPLETE' && $sourceState !== 'COMPLETE') {
            $operation['display_state'] = 'WAITING_NATIVE';
        } else { $operation['display_state'] = $operation['state']; }
        return $operation;
    }

    private function createProject(array $input, array $request): array
    {
        $projectId = $request['_record']['project_id'];
        $identifiers = Support::strings($input['identifiers'] ?? null, 'identifiers');
        $locales = Support::strings($input['locales'] ?? null, 'locales', 100);
        $channels = Support::strings($input['channels'] ?? null, 'channels', 100);
        if ($identifiers === [] || $locales === [] || $channels === []) {
            throw new \InvalidArgumentException('Select original item identifiers, locales and channels explicitly.');
        }
        $this->catalogue->validateScope($locales, $channels);
        $engine = $this->engine->describe();
        $value = [
            'schema' => 'tjl.catalogue.project.v1', 'id' => $projectId,
            'label' => Support::requiredString($input, 'label', 1000),
            'selection' => ['identifiers' => $identifiers, 'locales' => $locales, 'channels' => $channels],
            'engine' => $engine, 'created_at' => $request['created_at'], 'created_by' => $request['binding']['actor'],
            'original_operation_id' => $request['_record']['id'],
            'live_import_policy' => 'Explicitly selected identifiers require a workspace approval stamp while their claim is active.',
        ];
        return $this->store->atomic(function () use ($value, $identifiers, $projectId): array {
            $project = $this->store->original('project', $projectId, $projectId, $value);
            foreach ($identifiers as $identifier) {
                $id = Support::hash($identifier);
                $claim = $this->store->object('claim', $id);
                if ($claim !== null && ($claim['active'] ?? false) && $claim['_record']['project_id'] !== $projectId) {
                    throw new \RuntimeException('An original project already owns review of identifier ' . $identifier);
                }
                if ($claim !== null && $claim['_record']['project_id'] !== $projectId) {
                    throw new \RuntimeException('This identifier has retained original project history; continue that project or explicitly transfer its custody.');
                }
                if ($claim === null) {
                    $this->store->put('claim', $id, $projectId, ['identifier' => $identifier, 'active' => true, 'approval_id' => null], null);
                }
            }
            return $project;
        });
    }

    private function capture(string $projectId, array $input, array $request): array
    {
        $project = $this->store->require('project', $projectId, $projectId);
        $this->engine->assertSame($project['engine']['sha256']);
        $id = Support::id((string) ($input['capture_id'] ?? $request['_record']['id']));
        $selection = ['identifiers' => $project['selection']['identifiers']];
        if (isset($input['additional_requests'])) { $selection['additional_requests'] = $input['additional_requests']; }
        $snapshot = $this->source->capture($projectId, $id, $selection);
        if (($snapshot['state'] ?? null) !== 'COMPLETE') { return $snapshot; }
        $value = [
            'id' => $id, 'project_id' => $projectId, 'source_sha256' => $snapshot['sha256'],
            'selection' => $selection, 'original_operation_id' => $request['_record']['id'],
            'created_at' => $request['created_at'], 'created_by' => $request['binding']['actor'],
            'engine_sha256' => $project['engine']['sha256'], 'state' => 'CAPTURED',
        ];
        $this->store->original('cohort', $id, $projectId, $value);
        return $this->cohort($projectId, $id, 0, 50);
    }

    private function cohort(string $projectId, string $id, int $offset, int $limit): array
    {
        if ($offset < 0 || $limit < 1 || $limit > 500) { throw new \InvalidArgumentException('Select an original cohort page of 1–500 items.'); }
        $project = $this->store->require('project', $projectId, $projectId);
        $cohort = $this->store->require('cohort', $id, $projectId);
        $snapshot = $this->source->inspect($id);
        if (($snapshot['project_id'] ?? null) !== $projectId || ($snapshot['sha256'] ?? null) !== $cohort['source_sha256']) {
            throw new \RuntimeException('The retained source capture differs from its original cohort.');
        }
        $identifiers = $project['selection']['identifiers'];
        $rows = [];
        foreach (array_slice($identifiers, $offset, $limit) as $identifier) {
            $product = $snapshot['products'][$identifier] ?? throw new \RuntimeException('The complete selected source item is absent from its capture.');
            $claim = $this->store->require('claim', Support::hash($identifier), $projectId);
            $rows[] = ['identifier' => $identifier, 'source' => $product, 'claim' => $claim];
        }
        return ['cohort' => $cohort, 'rows' => $rows, 'offset' => $offset, 'total' => count($identifiers),
            'next_offset' => $offset + count($rows) < count($identifiers) ? $offset + count($rows) : null,
            'source_summary' => ['sha256' => $snapshot['sha256'], 'sources' => $snapshot['sources'] ?? [], 'requests' => $snapshot['requests'] ?? []]];
    }

    private function review(string $projectId, array $input, array $request, bool $missing): array
    {
        $existing = $this->store->object('review', $request['_record']['id']);
        if ($existing !== null) { return $existing; }
        $project = $this->store->require('project', $projectId, $projectId);
        $identifier = Support::requiredString($input, 'identifier', 1000);
        if (!in_array($identifier, $project['selection']['identifiers'], true)) { throw new \InvalidArgumentException('Select an original cohort identifier.'); }
        $captureId = Support::id(Support::requiredString($input, 'capture_id', 128));
        $cohort = $this->store->require('cohort', $captureId, $projectId);
        $snapshot = $this->source->inspect($captureId);
        $product = $snapshot['products'][$identifier] ?? throw new \RuntimeException('Selected original source item missing.');
        if (($snapshot['sha256'] ?? null) !== $cohort['source_sha256']) { throw new \RuntimeException('The original source edition changed.'); }
        if ($missing !== (($product['state'] ?? null) === 'MISSING')) {
            throw new \RuntimeException($missing ? 'This selected source item is present.' : 'This selected source item requires bounded missing-record review.');
        }
        if (!in_array($product['state'] ?? null, ['PRESENT', 'MISSING'], true)) { throw new \RuntimeException('The native source result is not a complete present/missing observation.'); }
        $parent = $product['data']['parent'] ?? null;
        if ($parent !== null && !is_string($parent)) { throw new \RuntimeException('The original parent code is invalid.'); }
        $native = $this->catalogue->read($identifier, $parent, $project['selection']['locales']);
        $engine = $this->engine->describe();
        $value = [
            'schema' => 'tjl.catalogue.review.v1', 'id' => $request['_record']['id'], 'project_id' => $projectId,
            'capture_id' => $captureId, 'identifier' => $identifier, 'parent' => $parent,
            'kind' => $missing ? 'MISSING' : 'IMPORT', 'source' => $product, 'source_sha256' => $snapshot['sha256'],
            'native' => $native['snapshot'], 'native_sha256' => $native['sha256'],
            'engine' => $engine, 'engine_sha256' => $engine['sha256'],
            'selection' => $project['selection'], 'created_at' => $request['created_at'], 'created_by' => $request['binding']['actor'],
            'scope_notice' => 'Source-owned fields use the installed native mapping. Existing outside-scope locales/channel prices and stock stay local. A missing API item is an observed access result, not proof of deletion.',
        ];
        $value['sha256'] = Support::hash($value);
        return $this->store->original('review', $value['id'], $projectId, $value);
    }

    private function approve(string $projectId, array $input, array $request): array
    {
        $existing = $this->store->object('approval', $request['_record']['id']);
        if ($existing !== null) { return $existing; }
        $review = $this->store->require('review', Support::id(Support::requiredString($input, 'review_id', 128)), $projectId);
        if ($review['kind'] !== 'IMPORT' || ($input['review_sha256'] ?? null) !== $review['sha256']) {
            throw new \RuntimeException('Approve the exact original import review.');
        }
        if (($input['approve_native_mapping'] ?? false) !== true) { throw new \InvalidArgumentException('Explicitly approve the complete installed native mapping and selected source edition.'); }
        $rules = $this->catalogue->validateRules($review['native'], $input['rules'] ?? [], $review['selection']);
        $this->engine->assertSame($review['engine_sha256']);
        return $this->store->atomic(function () use ($review, $rules, $request, $projectId): array {
            $native = $this->catalogue->read($review['identifier'], $review['parent'], $review['selection']['locales'], true);
            if ($native['sha256'] !== $review['native_sha256']) { throw new \RuntimeException('Native values changed; create and inspect a following review.'); }
            $value = [
                'id' => $request['_record']['id'], 'project_id' => $projectId, 'review_id' => $review['id'], 'review_sha256' => $review['sha256'],
                'capture_id' => $review['capture_id'], 'identifier' => $review['identifier'], 'parent' => $review['parent'],
                'source_sha256' => $review['source_sha256'], 'native_sha256' => $review['native_sha256'],
                'engine_sha256' => $review['engine_sha256'], 'rules' => $rules,
                'approved_by' => $request['binding']['actor'], 'approved_at' => $request['created_at'],
            ];
            $value['sha256'] = Support::hash($value);
            $approval = $this->store->original('approval', $value['id'], $projectId, $value);
            $claim = $this->store->require('claim', Support::hash($review['identifier']), $projectId);
            if (!$claim['active']) { throw new \RuntimeException('The original claim has been released.'); }
            $claim['approval_id'] = $value['id'];
            $this->store->save($claim);
            return $approval;
        });
    }

    private function dispatch(string $projectId, array $input, array $request, bool $retry): array
    {
        if ($retry) {
            $id = Support::id(Support::requiredString($input, 'import_operation_id', 128));
            $operation = $this->store->require('import', $id, $projectId);
            $approvalId = $operation['approval_id'];
            if (($input['preserve_original_approval'] ?? false) !== true) {
                throw new \InvalidArgumentException('Explicitly continue the same original approval and native operation.');
            }
        } else {
            $approvalId = Support::id(Support::requiredString($input, 'approval_id', 128));
            $id = Support::id((string) ($input['import_operation_id'] ?? $request['_record']['id']));
            $operation = $this->store->object('import', $id);
        }
        if (($operation['state'] ?? null) === 'RETAINED_UNAPPLIED') { throw new \RuntimeException('This original operation was explicitly retained unapplied. Create a following review and approval; do not reactivate it.'); }
        $approval = $this->store->require('approval', $approvalId, $projectId);
        if ($operation === null) {
            $operation = $this->store->put('import', $id, $projectId, [
                'id' => $id, 'project_id' => $projectId, 'identifier' => $approval['identifier'], 'approval_id' => $approvalId,
                'approval_sha256' => $approval['sha256'], 'state' => 'PREPARED',
                'original_operation_id' => $request['_record']['id'], 'created_at' => $request['created_at'],
                'created_by' => $request['binding']['actor'], 'dispatch_attempts' => [], 'native_result_ids' => [],
            ], null);
        } elseif ($operation['_record']['project_id'] !== $projectId || $operation['approval_id'] !== $approvalId) {
            throw new \RuntimeException('This original import operation already names another project or approval.');
        }
        // A lost send response is safe to repeat only with this same stamped native operation.
        // The handler's original transaction marker suppresses every duplicate mutation.
        $attemptKey = $request['_record']['id'];
        foreach ($operation['dispatch_attempts'] as $attempt) {
            if ($attempt['id'] === $attemptKey && $attempt['state'] === 'RETURNED') { return $this->operation($projectId, $id); }
        }
        $attemptIndex = null;
        foreach ($operation['dispatch_attempts'] as $index => $attempt) {
            if ($attempt['id'] === $attemptKey) { $attemptIndex = $index; }
        }
        if ($attemptIndex === null) {
            $attemptIndex = count($operation['dispatch_attempts']);
            $operation['dispatch_attempts'][] = ['id' => $attemptKey, 'state' => 'DISPATCHING', 'started_at' => Support::now()];
        }
        if (!in_array($operation['state'], ['APPLIED', 'COMPLETE'], true)) { $operation['state'] = 'DISPATCHING'; }
        $this->store->save($operation);
        try {
            $this->bus->dispatch(new Envelope(new ItemImport('Product', $approval['identifier']),
                [new ImportStamp($projectId, $id, $approvalId)]));
            $operation = $this->store->require('import', $id, $projectId);
            $operation['dispatch_attempts'][$attemptIndex]['state'] = 'RETURNED';
            $operation['dispatch_attempts'][$attemptIndex]['returned_at'] = Support::now();
            if (!in_array($operation['state'], ['APPLIED', 'COMPLETE'], true)) { $operation['state'] = 'QUEUED'; }
            $this->store->save($operation);
            return $this->operation($projectId, $id);
        } catch (\Throwable $error) {
            $operation = $this->store->require('import', $id, $projectId);
            $operation['dispatch_attempts'][$attemptIndex]['state'] = 'UNCERTAIN';
            $operation['dispatch_attempts'][$attemptIndex]['error'] = Support::error($error);
            if (!in_array($operation['state'], ['APPLIED', 'COMPLETE'], true)) { $operation['state'] = 'ATTENTION'; }
            $this->store->save($operation);
            throw $error;
        }
    }

    private function disableMissing(string $projectId, array $input, array $request): array
    {
        $review = $this->store->require('review', Support::id(Support::requiredString($input, 'review_id', 128)), $projectId);
        if ($review['kind'] !== 'MISSING' || ($input['review_sha256'] ?? null) !== $review['sha256'] ||
            ($input['confirm_selected_disable'] ?? false) !== true || ($input['acknowledge_access_boundary'] ?? false) !== true) {
            throw new \InvalidArgumentException('Explicitly approve this exact bounded missing-record disable and its source-access limitation.');
        }
        $id = $request['_record']['id'];
        $operation = $this->store->object('missing-effect', $id);
        if ($operation !== null) { return $operation; }
        $current = $this->source->capture($projectId, 'missing-' . substr(Support::hash($id), 0, 48), ['identifiers' => [$review['identifier']]]);
        if (($current['state'] ?? null) !== 'COMPLETE' || ($current['products'][$review['identifier']]['state'] ?? null) !== 'MISSING') {
            throw new \RuntimeException('The selected native item is no longer observed missing; retain and review its current source.');
        }
        $this->engine->assertSame($review['engine_sha256']);
        return $this->store->atomic(function () use ($review, $projectId, $id, $request, $input, $current): array {
            $before = $this->catalogue->read($review['identifier'], $review['parent'], $review['selection']['locales'], true);
            if ($before['sha256'] !== $review['native_sha256']) { throw new \RuntimeException('The selected native item changed after missing-record review.'); }
            $effect = $this->catalogue->disableSelected($review['identifier'], $before['snapshot'], (bool) ($input['disable_parent_if_no_enabled_variants'] ?? false));
            return $this->store->original('missing-effect', $id, $projectId, [
                'state' => 'COMPLETE', 'id' => $id, 'identifier' => $review['identifier'], 'review_id' => $review['id'],
                'review_sha256' => $review['sha256'], 'current_source_sha256' => $current['sha256'],
                'before' => $before['snapshot'], 'effect' => $effect, 'actor' => $request['binding']['actor'],
                'applied_at' => $request['created_at'],
                'scope' => 'Only this explicitly selected original variant and the separately selected empty enabled parent.',
            ]);
        });
    }

    private function retainUnapplied(string $projectId, array $input, array $request): array
    {
        if (($input['confirm_no_native_commit'] ?? false) !== true) { throw new \InvalidArgumentException('Explicitly retain this unapplied original operation.'); }
        $id = Support::id(Support::requiredString($input, 'import_operation_id', 128));
        $reason = Support::requiredString($input, 'reason', 10000);
        $operation = $this->store->require('import', $id, $projectId);
        if ($operation['state'] === 'RETAINED_UNAPPLIED') {
            if (($operation['disposition']['operation_id'] ?? null) !== $request['_record']['id']) {
                throw new \RuntimeException('This original operation already has its retained disposition.');
            }
            return $operation;
        }
        if (!in_array($operation['state'], ['PREPARED', 'DISPATCHING', 'QUEUED', 'ATTENTION'], true) ||
            isset($operation['native_applied_at']) || ($operation['last_native_result']['successful'] ?? false) === true) {
            throw new \RuntimeException('The original native commit cannot be abandoned. Reconcile its media/result instead.');
        }
        $source = $this->source->operation($id);
        if (in_array($source['state'] ?? null, ['COMMIT_UNCERTAIN', 'MEDIA_PENDING', 'NATIVE_RECEIPT_PENDING', 'COMPLETE'], true)) {
            throw new \RuntimeException('The retained source/native publication state requires reconciliation before an unapplied disposition.');
        }
        $operation['state'] = 'RETAINED_UNAPPLIED';
        $operation['disposition'] = ['operation_id' => $request['_record']['id'], 'reason' => $reason,
            'actor' => $request['binding']['actor'], 'at' => $request['created_at'], 'applied' => false,
            'native_queue' => 'Original transport messages/results remain retained; this stamp can no longer mutate the catalogue.'];
        return $this->store->save($operation);
    }

    private function releaseClaim(string $projectId, array $input): array
    {
        if (($input['resume_original_live_imports'] ?? false) !== true) {
            throw new \InvalidArgumentException('Explicitly resume the original live import behavior for this selected item.');
        }
        $identifier = Support::requiredString($input, 'identifier');
        $claim = $this->store->require('claim', Support::hash($identifier), $projectId);
        $claim['active'] = false;
        $claim['released_at'] = Support::now();
        return $this->store->save($claim);
    }

    private function envelope(string $action, string $operationId, ?string $projectId, array $result): array
    {
        $state = $result['display_state'] ?? $result['state'] ?? 'COMPLETE';
        $waiting = in_array($state, ['PREPARED', 'DISPATCHING', 'QUEUED', 'APPLIED', 'MEDIA_PENDING', 'COMMIT_UNCERTAIN', 'NATIVE_RECEIPT_PENDING', 'WAITING_NATIVE'], true);
        return ['schema' => 'tjl.catalogue.workspace-result.v1',
            'state' => $waiting ? 'WAITING_NATIVE' : ($state === 'ATTENTION' ? 'ATTENTION' : 'COMPLETE'),
            'action' => $action, 'operation_id' => $operationId, 'project_id' => $projectId, 'result' => $result];
    }
}

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace Tjl\CatalogueWorkspace\Handover;

// Maintained authenticated native-project Archive v1, namespace adaptation.
// Final publication uses a create-only link; encrypted framing remains unchanged.
// Original code and format retained from the shared native handover engine.

use RuntimeException;

final class HandoverFailure extends RuntimeException
{
    public function __construct(string $message, public readonly string $reason = 'HANDOVER_FAILED')
    {
        parent::__construct($message);
    }
}

final class Files
{
    public static function json(mixed $value): string
    {
        return json_encode($value, JSON_THROW_ON_ERROR | JSON_UNESCAPED_SLASHES | JSON_UNESCAPED_UNICODE);
    }

    public static function readJson(string $path): array
    {
        $text = file_get_contents($path);
        if ($text === false) {
            throw new HandoverFailure('Cannot read JSON file: ' . $path, 'FILE_READ');
        }
        $value = json_decode($text, true, 512, JSON_THROW_ON_ERROR);
        if (!is_array($value)) {
            throw new HandoverFailure('Expected a JSON object: ' . $path, 'INVALID_JSON');
        }
        return $value;
    }

    public static function writeJson(string $path, array $value): void
    {
        self::atomic($path, self::json($value) . "\n");
    }

    public static function atomic(string $path, string $bytes): void
    {
        self::assertParent($path);
        if (is_link($path)) {
            throw new HandoverFailure('Refusing to replace a symbolic link: ' . $path, 'SYMLINK_DESTINATION');
        }
        $temporary = $path . '.part-' . bin2hex(random_bytes(8));
        $handle = fopen($temporary, 'xb');
        if ($handle === false) {
            throw new HandoverFailure('Cannot create private output: ' . $temporary, 'FILE_CREATE');
        }
        chmod($temporary, 0600);
        try {
            self::write($handle, $bytes);
            fflush($handle);
            if (function_exists('fsync')) {
                fsync($handle);
            }
        } finally {
            fclose($handle);
        }
        if (!rename($temporary, $path)) {
            throw new HandoverFailure('Cannot commit output: ' . $path, 'FILE_RENAME');
        }
    }

    public static function write($handle, string $bytes): void
    {
        $offset = 0;
        $length = strlen($bytes);
        while ($offset < $length) {
            $written = fwrite($handle, substr($bytes, $offset));
            if ($written === false || $written === 0) {
                throw new HandoverFailure('Output stream stopped accepting bytes.', 'STREAM_WRITE');
            }
            $offset += $written;
        }
    }

    public static function read($handle, int $length): string
    {
        $bytes = '';
        while (strlen($bytes) < $length) {
            $chunk = fread($handle, $length - strlen($bytes));
            if ($chunk === false || $chunk === '') {
                throw new HandoverFailure('Archive or source stream ended early.', 'TRUNCATED_STREAM');
            }
            $bytes .= $chunk;
        }
        return $bytes;
    }

    public static function absolute(string $path): string
    {
        if ($path === '' || $path[0] !== '/' || str_contains($path, "\0")) {
            throw new HandoverFailure('Use an absolute local path: ' . $path, 'ABSOLUTE_PATH_REQUIRED');
        }
        $parts = [];
        foreach (explode('/', $path) as $part) {
            if ($part === '' || $part === '.') {
                continue;
            }
            if ($part === '..') {
                if ($parts === []) {
                    throw new HandoverFailure('Path escapes its root.', 'PATH_ESCAPE');
                }
                array_pop($parts);
            } else {
                $parts[] = $part;
            }
        }
        return '/' . implode('/', $parts);
    }

    public static function relative(string $path): string
    {
        if ($path === '' || str_contains($path, "\0") || str_contains($path, '\\') || $path[0] === '/') {
            throw new HandoverFailure('Invalid archive member path.', 'INVALID_MEMBER_PATH');
        }
        foreach (explode('/', $path) as $part) {
            if ($part === '' || $part === '.' || $part === '..') {
                throw new HandoverFailure('Invalid archive member path: ' . $path, 'INVALID_MEMBER_PATH');
            }
        }
        if (!preg_match('//u', $path)) {
            throw new HandoverFailure('Archive paths must be valid UTF-8.', 'NON_UTF8_PATH');
        }
        return $path;
    }

    public static function inside(string $path, string $root): bool
    {
        $path = self::absolute($path);
        $root = rtrim(self::absolute($root), '/');
        return $path === $root || str_starts_with($path, $root . '/');
    }

    public static function privateDirectory(string $path): string
    {
        $path = self::absolute($path);
        self::assertParent($path);
        if (is_link($path)) {
            throw new HandoverFailure('Private work directory cannot be a symbolic link.', 'SYMLINK_DESTINATION');
        }
        if (!is_dir($path) && !mkdir($path, 0700)) {
            throw new HandoverFailure('Cannot create private work directory.', 'DIRECTORY_CREATE');
        }
        $mode = fileperms($path);
        if ($mode === false || ($mode & 0077) !== 0) {
            throw new HandoverFailure('Work directory must be private (mode 0700): ' . $path, 'PRIVATE_DIRECTORY_REQUIRED');
        }
        return $path;
    }

    public static function assertParent(string $path): void
    {
        $path = self::absolute($path);
        $parent = dirname($path);
        $current = '';
        foreach (explode('/', trim($parent, '/')) as $part) {
            if ($part === '') {
                continue;
            }
            $current .= '/' . $part;
            if (is_link($current)) {
                throw new HandoverFailure('Destination has a symbolic-link parent: ' . $current, 'SYMLINK_DESTINATION');
            }
            if (!is_dir($current)) {
                throw new HandoverFailure('Destination parent does not exist: ' . $current, 'DIRECTORY_MISSING');
            }
        }
    }

    public static function makeParent(string $path, string $root): void
    {
        if (!self::inside($path, $root)) {
            throw new HandoverFailure('Destination escapes selected root.', 'PATH_ESCAPE');
        }
        $relative = ltrim(substr(dirname($path), strlen(rtrim($root, '/'))), '/');
        $current = rtrim($root, '/');
        foreach ($relative === '' ? [] : explode('/', $relative) as $part) {
            $current .= '/' . $part;
            if (is_link($current) || (file_exists($current) && !is_dir($current))) {
                throw new HandoverFailure('Unsafe destination parent: ' . $current, 'SYMLINK_DESTINATION');
            }
            if (!is_dir($current) && !mkdir($current, 0700)) {
                throw new HandoverFailure('Cannot create receiving directory.', 'DIRECTORY_CREATE');
            }
        }
    }

    public static function key(string $path): string
    {
        self::assertParent($path);
        if (!is_file($path) || is_link($path) || (fileperms($path) & 0077) !== 0) {
            throw new HandoverFailure('Archive key must be a private regular file (mode 0600).', 'PRIVATE_KEY_REQUIRED');
        }
        $key = file_get_contents($path);
        if ($key === false || strlen($key) !== 32) {
            throw new HandoverFailure('Archive key file must contain exactly 32 random bytes.', 'INVALID_ARCHIVE_KEY');
        }
        return $key;
    }
}

/**
 * Whole-project encrypted stream. Each record is an independent AES-256-GCM
 * ciphertext bound to the original authenticated header and monotonic index.
 * The authenticated final record is mandatory. No plaintext file is committed
 * until all its original declared bytes and digest have been checked.
 */
final class Archive
{
    public const FORMAT = 'ydw.native-project-encrypted.v1';
    public const MANIFEST = 'ydw.native-project-manifest.v1';
    private const MAGIC = "YDW-NATIVE-PROJECT\n";
    private const CHUNK = 1048576;

    public static function write(
        string $path,
        string $key,
        array $manifest,
        array $sources,
        ?callable $heartbeat = null
    ): array {
        if (strlen($key) !== 32) {
            throw new HandoverFailure('The original archive key must contain exactly 32 bytes.', 'INVALID_ARCHIVE_KEY');
        }
        if (!extension_loaded('openssl')) {
            throw new HandoverFailure('PHP OpenSSL is required for authenticated project encryption.', 'OPENSSL_REQUIRED');
        }
        Files::assertParent($path);
        if (file_exists($path) || is_link($path)) {
            throw new HandoverFailure('Archive output already exists: ' . $path, 'OUTPUT_EXISTS');
        }
        self::validateManifest($manifest);
        $manifestBytes = Files::json($manifest);
        $header = [
            'format' => self::FORMAT,
            'archive_id' => bin2hex(random_bytes(16)),
            'cipher' => 'aes-256-gcm',
            'kdf' => 'hkdf-sha256',
            'salt' => base64_encode(random_bytes(32)),
            'nonce_prefix' => base64_encode(random_bytes(8)),
            'chunk_bytes' => self::CHUNK,
        ];
        $headerBytes = Files::json($header);
        $salt = base64_decode($header['salt'], true);
        $prefix = base64_decode($header['nonce_prefix'], true);
        $derived = hash_hkdf('sha256', $key, 32, self::FORMAT . ':' . $header['archive_id'], $salt);
        $headerDigest = hash('sha256', $headerBytes, true);
        $temporary = $path . '.part-' . bin2hex(random_bytes(8));
        $out = fopen($temporary, 'xb');
        if ($out === false) {
            throw new HandoverFailure('Cannot create encrypted archive.', 'FILE_CREATE');
        }
        chmod($temporary, 0600);
        $index = 0;
        $emit = static function (string $plain) use ($out, $derived, $prefix, $headerDigest, &$index): void {
            if ($index >= 0xffffffff || strlen($plain) > self::CHUNK + 16384) {
                throw new HandoverFailure('Archive record limit exceeded.', 'ARCHIVE_LIMIT');
            }
            $sequence = pack('N', $index);
            $tag = '';
            $cipher = openssl_encrypt($plain, 'aes-256-gcm', $derived, OPENSSL_RAW_DATA, $prefix . $sequence, $tag, $headerDigest . $sequence, 16);
            if ($cipher === false || strlen($tag) !== 16) {
                throw new HandoverFailure('Project encryption failed.', 'ENCRYPTION_FAILED');
            }
            Files::write($out, pack('N', strlen($cipher)) . $tag . $cipher);
            $index++;
        };
        try {
            Files::write($out, self::MAGIC . pack('N', strlen($headerBytes)) . $headerBytes);
            $emit('B' . Files::json(['bytes' => strlen($manifestBytes), 'sha256' => hash('sha256', $manifestBytes)]));
            for ($offset = 0; $offset < strlen($manifestBytes); $offset += self::CHUNK) {
                $emit('M' . substr($manifestBytes, $offset, self::CHUNK));
                if ($heartbeat !== null) {
                    $heartbeat();
                }
            }
            $total = 0;
            foreach ($manifest['entries'] as $entry) {
                $emit('E' . Files::json($entry));
                if ($entry['type'] !== 'file') {
                    continue;
                }
                $source = $sources[$entry['path']] ?? null;
                if (!is_string($source) || !is_file($source) || is_link($source)) {
                    throw new HandoverFailure('Missing original file: ' . $entry['path'], 'SOURCE_CHANGED');
                }
                $input = fopen($source, 'rb');
                if ($input === false) {
                    throw new HandoverFailure('Cannot open original file: ' . $entry['path'], 'FILE_READ');
                }
                $digest = hash_init('sha256');
                $size = 0;
                try {
                    while (!feof($input)) {
                        $chunk = fread($input, self::CHUNK);
                        if ($chunk === false) {
                            throw new HandoverFailure('Original file read failed.', 'FILE_READ');
                        }
                        if ($chunk === '') {
                            if (!feof($input)) {
                                throw new HandoverFailure('Original file stream stalled.', 'FILE_READ');
                            }
                            break;
                        }
                        hash_update($digest, $chunk);
                        $size += strlen($chunk);
                        if ($size > $entry['bytes']) {
                            throw new HandoverFailure('Original file grew during capture: ' . $entry['path'], 'SOURCE_CHANGED');
                        }
                        $emit('D' . $chunk);
                        if ($heartbeat !== null) {
                            $heartbeat();
                        }
                    }
                } finally {
                    fclose($input);
                }
                $sha = hash_final($digest);
                if ($size !== $entry['bytes'] || !hash_equals($entry['sha256'], $sha)) {
                    throw new HandoverFailure('Original file changed during capture: ' . $entry['path'], 'SOURCE_CHANGED');
                }
                $emit('F' . Files::json(['path' => $entry['path'], 'bytes' => $size, 'sha256' => $sha]));
                $total += $size;
            }
            $emit('T' . Files::json([
                'manifest_sha256' => hash('sha256', $manifestBytes),
                'entries' => count($manifest['entries']),
                'file_bytes' => $total,
            ]));
            fflush($out);
            if (function_exists('fsync')) {
                fsync($out);
            }
        } finally {
            fclose($out);
        }
        if (!@link($temporary, $path)) {
            throw new HandoverFailure('Encrypted archive destination already exists or cannot be published create-only.', 'OUTPUT_EXISTS');
        }
        if (!unlink($temporary)) { throw new HandoverFailure('Complete archive published; its owned temporary link could not be retired.', 'FILE_UNLINK'); }
        return [
            'format' => self::FORMAT,
            'path' => $path,
            'archive_id' => $header['archive_id'],
            'bytes' => filesize($path),
            'sha256' => hash_file('sha256', $path),
            'manifest_sha256' => hash('sha256', $manifestBytes),
            'entries' => count($manifest['entries']),
            'file_bytes' => $total,
        ];
    }

    public static function receive(string $path, string $key, string $directory, ?callable $heartbeat = null): array
    {
        if (strlen($key) !== 32 || !extension_loaded('openssl')) {
            throw new HandoverFailure('The original 32-byte archive key and native OpenSSL are required.', 'INVALID_ARCHIVE_KEY');
        }
        Files::privateDirectory($directory);
        if (iterator_count(new \FilesystemIterator($directory, \FilesystemIterator::SKIP_DOTS)) !== 0) {
            throw new HandoverFailure('Archive staging directory must be empty.', 'STAGING_NOT_EMPTY');
        }
        $input = fopen($path, 'rb');
        if ($input === false) {
            throw new HandoverFailure('Cannot open original archive.', 'FILE_READ');
        }
        $openFile = null;
        try {
            if (Files::read($input, strlen(self::MAGIC)) !== self::MAGIC) {
                throw new HandoverFailure('Unknown project archive format.', 'ARCHIVE_FORMAT');
            }
            $headerLength = unpack('Nvalue', Files::read($input, 4))['value'];
            if ($headerLength < 20 || $headerLength > 4096) {
                throw new HandoverFailure('Invalid archive header length.', 'ARCHIVE_FORMAT');
            }
            $headerBytes = Files::read($input, $headerLength);
            $header = json_decode($headerBytes, true, 64, JSON_THROW_ON_ERROR);
            $salt = base64_decode($header['salt'] ?? '', true);
            $prefix = base64_decode($header['nonce_prefix'] ?? '', true);
            if (($header['format'] ?? null) !== self::FORMAT || ($header['cipher'] ?? null) !== 'aes-256-gcm'
                || ($header['kdf'] ?? null) !== 'hkdf-sha256' || ($header['chunk_bytes'] ?? null) !== self::CHUNK
                || !is_string($salt) || strlen($salt) !== 32 || !is_string($prefix) || strlen($prefix) !== 8
                || !preg_match('/^[a-f0-9]{32}$/D', $header['archive_id'] ?? '')) {
                throw new HandoverFailure('Unsupported or invalid authenticated archive header.', 'ARCHIVE_FORMAT');
            }
            $derived = hash_hkdf('sha256', $key, 32, self::FORMAT . ':' . $header['archive_id'], $salt);
            $headerDigest = hash('sha256', $headerBytes, true);
            $index = 0;
            $next = static function () use ($input, $derived, $prefix, $headerDigest, &$index): string {
                if ($index >= 0xffffffff) {
                    throw new HandoverFailure('Archive sequence overflow.', 'ARCHIVE_LIMIT');
                }
                $length = unpack('Nvalue', Files::read($input, 4))['value'];
                if ($length < 1 || $length > self::CHUNK + 16384) {
                    throw new HandoverFailure('Invalid encrypted record length.', 'ARCHIVE_FORMAT');
                }
                $tag = Files::read($input, 16);
                $cipher = Files::read($input, $length);
                $sequence = pack('N', $index);
                $plain = openssl_decrypt($cipher, 'aes-256-gcm', $derived, OPENSSL_RAW_DATA, $prefix . $sequence, $tag, $headerDigest . $sequence);
                if ($plain === false || $plain === '') {
                    throw new HandoverFailure('Archive authentication failed at record ' . $index . '.', 'ARCHIVE_AUTHENTICATION');
                }
                $index++;
                return $plain;
            };
            $begin = $next();
            if ($begin[0] !== 'B') {
                throw new HandoverFailure('Archive manifest is missing.', 'ARCHIVE_FORMAT');
            }
            $declared = json_decode(substr($begin, 1), true, 32, JSON_THROW_ON_ERROR);
            if (!is_int($declared['bytes'] ?? null) || $declared['bytes'] < 2 || $declared['bytes'] > 134217728) {
                throw new HandoverFailure('Unsupported manifest size.', 'MANIFEST_LIMIT');
            }
            $manifestBytes = '';
            while (strlen($manifestBytes) < $declared['bytes']) {
                $record = $next();
                if ($record[0] !== 'M') {
                    throw new HandoverFailure('Manifest stream is incomplete.', 'ARCHIVE_FORMAT');
                }
                $manifestBytes .= substr($record, 1);
                if (strlen($manifestBytes) > $declared['bytes']) {
                    throw new HandoverFailure('Manifest length exceeds its original declaration.', 'ARCHIVE_FORMAT');
                }
            }
            if (!hash_equals($declared['sha256'] ?? '', hash('sha256', $manifestBytes))) {
                throw new HandoverFailure('Manifest digest does not match.', 'MANIFEST_DIGEST');
            }
            $manifest = json_decode($manifestBytes, true, 512, JSON_THROW_ON_ERROR);
            self::validateManifest($manifest);
            $total = 0;
            foreach ($manifest['entries'] as $entry) {
                $record = $next();
                if ($record[0] !== 'E' || !hash_equals(Files::json($entry), substr($record, 1))) {
                    throw new HandoverFailure('Archive member differs from the original manifest.', 'MEMBER_MANIFEST');
                }
                $destination = $directory . '/' . $entry['path'];
                Files::makeParent($destination, $directory);
                if ($entry['type'] === 'directory') {
                    if (!is_dir($destination) && !mkdir($destination, 0700)) {
                        throw new HandoverFailure('Cannot create staged directory.', 'DIRECTORY_CREATE');
                    }
                    continue;
                }
                if ($entry['type'] === 'symlink') {
                    // Materialize only after the whole archive has authenticated.
                    continue;
                }
                $part = $destination . '.part';
                $openFile = fopen($part, 'xb');
                if ($openFile === false) {
                    throw new HandoverFailure('Cannot create staged file.', 'FILE_CREATE');
                }
                chmod($part, 0600);
                $digest = hash_init('sha256');
                $bytes = 0;
                while (true) {
                    $record = $next();
                    if ($record[0] === 'F') {
                        $end = json_decode(substr($record, 1), true, 32, JSON_THROW_ON_ERROR);
                        break;
                    }
                    if ($record[0] !== 'D') {
                        throw new HandoverFailure('Original file stream is incomplete.', 'ARCHIVE_FORMAT');
                    }
                    $chunk = substr($record, 1);
                    $bytes += strlen($chunk);
                    if ($bytes > $entry['bytes']) {
                        throw new HandoverFailure('Received file exceeds its declared size.', 'MEMBER_SIZE');
                    }
                    Files::write($openFile, $chunk);
                    hash_update($digest, $chunk);
                    if ($heartbeat !== null) {
                        $heartbeat();
                    }
                }
                fflush($openFile);
                fclose($openFile);
                $openFile = null;
                $sha = hash_final($digest);
                if ($bytes !== $entry['bytes'] || !hash_equals($entry['sha256'], $sha)
                    || ($end['path'] ?? null) !== $entry['path'] || ($end['bytes'] ?? null) !== $bytes
                    || !hash_equals($sha, $end['sha256'] ?? '')) {
                    throw new HandoverFailure('Received file digest or length differs from its source.', 'MEMBER_DIGEST');
                }
                if (!rename($part, $destination)) {
                    throw new HandoverFailure('Cannot commit staged file.', 'FILE_RENAME');
                }
                $total += $bytes;
            }
            $record = $next();
            if ($record[0] !== 'T') {
                throw new HandoverFailure('Authenticated archive completion record is missing.', 'ARCHIVE_TRUNCATED');
            }
            $trailer = json_decode(substr($record, 1), true, 32, JSON_THROW_ON_ERROR);
            if (($trailer['entries'] ?? null) !== count($manifest['entries'])
                || ($trailer['file_bytes'] ?? null) !== $total
                || !hash_equals(hash('sha256', $manifestBytes), $trailer['manifest_sha256'] ?? '')) {
                throw new HandoverFailure('Archive completion differs from its manifest.', 'ARCHIVE_COMPLETION');
            }
            $extra = fread($input, 1);
            if ($extra === false || $extra !== '') {
                throw new HandoverFailure('Unexpected bytes follow the authenticated archive.', 'ARCHIVE_TRAILING_BYTES');
            }
            Files::atomic($directory . '/manifest.json', $manifestBytes . "\n");
            return [
                'format' => self::FORMAT,
                'archive_id' => $header['archive_id'],
                'archive_sha256' => hash_file('sha256', $path),
                'manifest_sha256' => hash('sha256', $manifestBytes),
                'manifest' => $manifest,
                'directory' => $directory,
                'entries' => count($manifest['entries']),
                'file_bytes' => $total,
            ];
        } finally {
            if (is_resource($openFile)) {
                fclose($openFile);
            }
            fclose($input);
        }
    }

    public static function validateManifest(array $manifest): void
    {
        if (($manifest['format'] ?? null) !== self::MANIFEST || !is_array($manifest['entries'] ?? null)
            || count($manifest['entries']) > 1000000 || !is_array($manifest['source'] ?? null)) {
            throw new HandoverFailure('Invalid whole-project manifest.', 'MANIFEST_FORMAT');
        }
        $seen = [];
        foreach ($manifest['entries'] as $entry) {
            if (!is_array($entry)) {
                throw new HandoverFailure('Invalid archive entry.', 'MANIFEST_FORMAT');
            }
            $path = Files::relative($entry['path'] ?? '');
            $group = explode('/', $path, 2)[0];
            if (!in_array($group, ['project', 'public', 'private', 'database', 'metadata'], true)
                || isset($seen[$path]) || !in_array($entry['type'] ?? '', ['file', 'directory', 'symlink'], true)) {
                throw new HandoverFailure('Invalid or duplicate archive member: ' . $path, 'MANIFEST_MEMBER');
            }
            for ($parent = dirname($path); $parent !== '.'; $parent = dirname($parent)) {
                if (isset($seen[$parent]) && $seen[$parent] !== 'directory') {
                    throw new HandoverFailure('Archive member has a non-directory parent.', 'MANIFEST_MEMBER');
                }
            }
            $seen[$path] = $entry['type'];
            if (!is_int($entry['mode'] ?? null) || $entry['mode'] < 0 || $entry['mode'] > 0777) {
                throw new HandoverFailure('Invalid archive permission mode.', 'MANIFEST_MEMBER');
            }
            if ($entry['type'] === 'file'
                && (!is_int($entry['bytes'] ?? null) || $entry['bytes'] < 0
                || !preg_match('/^[a-f0-9]{64}$/D', $entry['sha256'] ?? ''))) {
                throw new HandoverFailure('Invalid original file size or digest.', 'MANIFEST_MEMBER');
            }
            if ($entry['type'] === 'symlink') {
                $target = $entry['target'] ?? '';
                if (!is_string($target) || $target === '' || $target[0] === '/' || str_contains($target, "\0")
                    || str_contains($target, '\\')) {
                    throw new HandoverFailure('Only relative internal symbolic links are transferable.', 'MANIFEST_SYMLINK');
                }
                $resolved = Files::absolute('/' . dirname($path) . '/' . $target);
                if (!Files::inside($resolved, '/' . $group)) {
                    throw new HandoverFailure('Symbolic link escapes its selected source root.', 'MANIFEST_SYMLINK');
                }
            }
        }
        foreach ($seen as $path => $type) {
            for ($parent = dirname($path); $parent !== '.'; $parent = dirname($parent)) {
                if (isset($seen[$parent]) && $seen[$parent] !== 'directory') {
                    throw new HandoverFailure('Archive contains a child beneath a file or link.', 'MANIFEST_MEMBER');
                }
            }
        }
        if (($seen['database/database.sql'] ?? null) !== 'file'
            || ($seen['metadata/source.json'] ?? null) !== 'file'
            || ($seen['project/composer.lock'] ?? null) !== 'file'
            || ($seen['project/composer.json'] ?? null) !== 'file') {
            throw new HandoverFailure('Complete database, source identity and Composer closure are required.', 'INCOMPLETE_PROJECT');
        }
    }
}

<?php
declare(strict_types=1);
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
namespace Tjl\CatalogueWorkspace\Handover;

require_once __DIR__ . '/Archive.php';

/** Complete original installed project; every subprocess retains one admission. */
final class NativeProject
{
    private array $config;
    private array $state;
    private string $work;
    private string $configuration;
    private $lock;
    private array $roots;

    public function __construct(string $configuration, string $work, private readonly string $operationId)
    {
        if (!preg_match('/^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._:-]{7,159}$/D', $operationId)) {
            throw new HandoverFailure('Use the same original operation ID of 8–160 characters.');
        }
        Files::assertParent($configuration);
        if (is_link($configuration) || !is_file($configuration)) { throw new HandoverFailure('Native configuration is unavailable.'); }
        $this->config = $this->validate(Files::readJson($configuration));
        $this->work = Files::privateDirectory($work);
        $this->roots = ['project' => $this->config['project_root']];
        foreach (['public', 'private'] as $group) {
            foreach ($this->config['roots'][$group] as $name => $path) { $this->roots[$group . '/' . $name] = $path; }
        }
        foreach ($this->roots as $root) {
            if (Files::inside($this->work, $root) || Files::inside($root, $this->work)) {
                throw new HandoverFailure('Keep the original private control directory separate from every installed root.');
            }
        }
        $lockPath = $this->work . '/operation.lock';
        if (is_link($lockPath)) { throw new HandoverFailure('Operation lock is linked.'); }
        $this->lock = fopen($lockPath, 'c+b');
        if ($this->lock === false || !flock($this->lock, LOCK_EX | LOCK_NB)) {
            throw new HandoverFailure('The original operation or its native child still owns this admission.', 'ORIGINAL_PROCESS_ACTIVE');
        }
        chmod($lockPath, 0600);
        $binding = ['operation_id' => $operationId, 'configuration' => $this->config];
        $statePath = $this->work . '/state.json';
        if (is_file($statePath)) {
            $this->state = Files::readJson($statePath);
            if (($this->state['binding'] ?? null) !== $binding) { throw new HandoverFailure('Retain the same original configuration and operation.'); }
        } else {
            $this->state = ['schema' => 'tjl.catalogue.native-project-state.v1', 'binding' => $binding,
                'status' => 'PREPARED', 'commands' => [], 'created_at' => gmdate(DATE_ATOM)];
            $this->save();
        }
        $this->configuration = $this->work . '/configuration.json';
        if (!is_file($this->configuration)) { Files::writeJson($this->configuration, $this->config); }
        if (Files::readJson($this->configuration) !== $this->config) { throw new HandoverFailure('Retained configuration changed.'); }
    }

    public function __destruct()
    {
        // No LOCK_UN: an admitted native descendant may still hold this open-file description.
        if (is_resource($this->lock)) { fclose($this->lock); }
    }

    private function validate(array $config): array
    {
        if (($config['schema'] ?? null) !== 'tjl.catalogue.native-project-config.v1') { throw new HandoverFailure('Select the complete native project configuration.'); }
        foreach (['site_key', 'kernel_class', 'environment', 'php_executable', 'project_root', 'console', 'store_root'] as $field) {
            if (!is_string($config[$field] ?? null) || $config[$field] === '' || str_contains($config[$field], "\0")) { throw new HandoverFailure('Missing native binding: ' . $field); }
        }
        foreach (['project_root', 'store_root'] as $field) {
            $path = Files::absolute($config[$field]); Files::assertParent($path);
            if (is_link($path) || !is_dir($path)) { throw new HandoverFailure('Use the actual ordinary installed directory: ' . $field); }
            $config[$field] = realpath($path);
        }
        $php = Files::absolute($config['php_executable']); Files::assertParent($php);
        if (!is_file($php) || !is_executable($php)) { throw new HandoverFailure('Use the actual installed PHP executable or wrapper.'); }
        $config['php_executable'] = $php;
        $config['console'] = Files::relative($config['console']);
        foreach (['composer.json', 'composer.lock', 'vendor/autoload.php', $config['console']] as $path) {
            if (!is_file($config['project_root'] . '/' . $path)) { throw new HandoverFailure('Installed project closure is incomplete: ' . $path); }
        }
        if (!in_array($config['queue_mode'] ?? null, ['database', 'external'], true)) { throw new HandoverFailure('Select the actual database or external native queue.'); }
        if (($config['maintenance_authorized'] ?? false) !== true) { throw new HandoverFailure('Native maintenance and worker control must be explicitly authorized in the private configuration.'); }
        $config['roots'] ??= [];
        $seen = [];
        foreach (['public', 'private'] as $group) {
            $config['roots'][$group] ??= [];
            if (!is_array($config['roots'][$group])) { throw new HandoverFailure('Supply actual named storage roots.'); }
            ksort($config['roots'][$group]);
            foreach ($config['roots'][$group] as $name => &$path) {
                if (!is_string($name) || !preg_match('/^[a-zA-Z0-9][a-zA-Z0-9_-]*$/D', $name) || !is_string($path)) { throw new HandoverFailure('Invalid native storage root.'); }
                $path = Files::absolute($path); Files::assertParent($path);
                if (is_link($path) || !is_dir($path)) { throw new HandoverFailure('Selected storage root must exist as an ordinary directory.'); }
                $path = realpath($path);
                if (Files::inside($config['project_root'], $path)) { throw new HandoverFailure('Storage cannot contain the complete project root.'); }
                foreach ($seen as $other) { if (Files::inside($path, $other) || Files::inside($other, $path)) { throw new HandoverFailure('Select nonoverlapping storage roots.'); } }
                $seen[] = $path;
            }
            unset($path);
        }
        if (!in_array($config['store_root'], $config['roots']['private'], true)) { throw new HandoverFailure('Include the complete actual catalogue Store as a named private root.'); }
        $config['host_private_paths'] ??= [];
        $config['excluded_runtime_paths'] ??= ['var/cache', 'var/log'];
        foreach (['host_private_paths', 'excluded_runtime_paths'] as $field) {
            if (!is_array($config[$field]) || !array_is_list($config[$field])) { throw new HandoverFailure('Use a complete relative exclusion list.'); }
            foreach ($config[$field] as &$path) { $path = Files::relative($path); } unset($path);
        }
        $config['host_private_paths'] = array_values(array_unique(array_merge(
            ['.env.local', '.env.local.php', '.env.' . $config['environment'] . '.local', 'auth.json', 'config/packages/tjl_catalogue_workspace.yaml'],
            $config['host_private_paths']
        )));
        foreach (['drain', 'verify_drained', 'resume', 'database_dump', 'database_import'] as $command) { $this->validateCommand($config['commands'][$command] ?? null, $command); }
        if ($config['queue_mode'] === 'external') {
            foreach (['queue_export', 'queue_import', 'verify_reopen'] as $command) { $this->validateCommand($config['commands'][$command] ?? null, $command); }
        }
        foreach (['cache_rebuild', 'verify_reopen'] as $command) { if (isset($config['commands'][$command])) { $this->validateCommand($config['commands'][$command], $command); } }
        if (!in_array($config['commands']['database_dump']['output'] ?? null, ['stdout', 'file'], true)) { throw new HandoverFailure('Declare native database dump output as stdout or file.'); }
        $config['max_bytes'] ??= 1099511627776;
        if (!is_int($config['max_bytes']) || $config['max_bytes'] < 1) { throw new HandoverFailure('Use an explicit positive archive byte limit.'); }
        return $config;
    }

    private function validateCommand(mixed $command, string $name): void
    {
        if (!is_array($command) || !is_array($command['argv'] ?? null) || !$command['argv'] || !array_is_list($command['argv'])) { throw new HandoverFailure('Supply the actual native argv for ' . $name); }
        foreach ($command['argv'] as $arg) { if (!is_string($arg) || str_contains($arg, "\0")) { throw new HandoverFailure('Invalid native command argument.'); } }
    }

    private function save(): void
    {
        $this->state['updated_at'] = gmdate(DATE_ATOM);
        Files::writeJson($this->work . '/state.json', $this->state);
    }

    public function status(): array { return $this->state; }

    private function directory(string $relative): string
    {
        $path = $this->work . '/' . Files::relative($relative);
        Files::makeParent($path . '/member', $this->work);
        if (!is_dir($path)) { mkdir($path, 0700); }
        return Files::privateDirectory($path);
    }

    private function identity(string $path): array
    {
        Files::assertParent($path);
        if (is_link($path)) { return ['type' => 'symlink', 'mode' => 0777, 'target' => readlink($path)]; }
        if (!file_exists($path)) { return ['type' => 'absent']; }
        $before = lstat($path);
        if (is_dir($path)) { return ['type' => 'directory', 'mode' => $before['mode'] & 0777]; }
        if (!is_file($path)) { throw new HandoverFailure('Unsupported original filesystem member: ' . $path); }
        $sha = hash_file('sha256', $path); clearstatcache(true, $path); $after = lstat($path);
        foreach (['dev', 'ino', 'size', 'mtime', 'ctime'] as $key) { if ($before[$key] !== $after[$key]) { throw new HandoverFailure('Original member changed while hashing: ' . $path); } }
        return ['type' => 'file', 'mode' => $before['mode'] & 0777, 'bytes' => $before['size'], 'sha256' => $sha];
    }

    private function copy(string $from, string $to): void
    {
        $before = $this->identity($from);
        if ($before['type'] !== 'file') { throw new HandoverFailure('A complete ordinary source file is required.'); }
        Files::assertParent($to);
        $id = hash('sha256', $to);
        $journal = $this->directory('copy-journals') . '/' . $id . '.json';
        $intent = is_file($journal) ? Files::readJson($journal) : null;
        $expected = ['bytes' => $before['bytes'], 'sha256' => $before['sha256']];
        if (is_array($intent) && $intent['expected'] === $expected && $intent['state'] === 'COMPLETE') {
            $actual = $this->identity($to);
            if ($actual['type'] === 'file' && $actual['bytes'] === $before['bytes'] && $actual['sha256'] === $before['sha256']) { return; }
        }
        if (is_array($intent) && $intent['state'] === 'WRITING') {
            $temporary = $intent['temporary'];
            if ($temporary !== $to . '.catalogue-part-' . $intent['nonce']) { throw new HandoverFailure('Original private copy intent changed.'); }
            $partial = $this->identity($temporary);
            if ($partial['type'] !== 'absent') {
                if ($partial['type'] !== 'file') { throw new HandoverFailure('An owned original copy stage changed filesystem kind.'); }
                // This exact disposable stage was registered before creation. Retain its actual identity before cleanup.
                $intent['interrupted_stage'] = $partial; Files::writeJson($journal, $intent);
                if (!unlink($temporary)) { throw new HandoverFailure('Cannot retire this operation’s own interrupted copy stage.'); }
            }
        }
        $nonce = bin2hex(random_bytes(12)); $temporary = $to . '.catalogue-part-' . $nonce;
        if (is_array($intent)) { Files::writeJson($this->directory('copy-attempts') . '/' . $id . '-' . $intent['nonce'] . '.json', $intent); }
        $intent = ['destination' => $to, 'source' => $from, 'expected' => $expected,
            'temporary' => $temporary, 'nonce' => $nonce, 'state' => 'WRITING', 'started_at' => gmdate(DATE_ATOM)];
        Files::writeJson($journal, $intent);
        $input = fopen($from, 'rb'); $out = fopen($temporary, 'xb');
        if ($input === false || $out === false) { throw new HandoverFailure('Cannot retain complete original bytes.'); }
        chmod($temporary, 0600);
        try {
            while (!feof($input)) {
                $bytes = fread($input, 1048576);
                if ($bytes === false || ($bytes === '' && !feof($input))) { throw new HandoverFailure('Original file stream stopped.'); }
                Files::write($out, $bytes);
            }
            fflush($out); fsync($out);
        } finally { fclose($input); fclose($out); }
        $after = $this->identity($from); $received = $this->identity($temporary);
        if ($after !== $before || $received['bytes'] !== $before['bytes'] || $received['sha256'] !== $before['sha256']) { throw new HandoverFailure('Source changed during complete file retention.'); }
        if (!rename($temporary, $to)) { throw new HandoverFailure('Cannot publish original retained file.'); }
        $intent['state'] = 'COMPLETE';
        $intent['completed_at'] = gmdate(DATE_ATOM); Files::writeJson($journal, $intent);
    }

    private function command(string $stage, array $argv, ?string $stdin = null): array
    {
        $directory = $this->directory('commands/' . hash('sha256', $stage));
        $request = ['schema' => 'tjl.catalogue.native-command-request.v1', 'stage' => $stage,
            'operation_id' => $this->operationId, 'argv' => $argv, 'cwd' => $this->config['project_root'],
            'stdin' => $stdin ?? '/dev/null', 'stdin_identity' => $stdin === null ? null : $this->identity($stdin)];
        $path = $directory . '/request.json';
        if (is_file($path)) {
            if (Files::readJson($path) !== $request) { throw new HandoverFailure('Original native command binding changed.'); }
        } else { Files::writeJson($path, $request); }
        $sha = hash_file('sha256', $path);
        $this->state['commands'][$stage] = ['request' => $path, 'request_sha256' => $sha, 'directory' => $directory];
        $this->save();
        $resultPath = $directory . '/result.json';
        if (!is_file($resultPath)) {
            if (is_file($directory . '/worker.json')) {
                throw new HandoverFailure('Original command has no completed native receipt: ' . $directory, 'COMMAND_UNCERTAIN');
            }
            $out = fopen($directory . '/wrapper.stdout', 'ab'); $err = fopen($directory . '/wrapper.stderr', 'ab');
            chmod($directory . '/wrapper.stdout', 0600); chmod($directory . '/wrapper.stderr', 0600);
            $process = proc_open([$this->config['php_executable'], dirname(__DIR__) . '/native-command.php', $path],
                [0 => ['file', '/dev/null', 'rb'], 1 => $out, 2 => $err, 4 => $this->lock], $pipes,
                $this->config['project_root'], null, ['bypass_shell' => true]);
            if (!is_resource($process)) { throw new HandoverFailure('Original command wrapper could not start.'); }
            proc_close($process); fclose($out); fclose($err);
        }
        if (!is_file($resultPath)) { throw new HandoverFailure('Retain the original command; no actual native completion was returned.', 'COMMAND_UNCERTAIN'); }
        $result = Files::readJson($resultPath);
        if (($result['schema'] ?? null) !== 'tjl.catalogue.native-command-result.v1'
            || ($result['request_sha256'] ?? null) !== $sha || ($result['argv'] ?? null) !== $argv
            || ($result['cwd'] ?? null) !== $request['cwd'] || !is_int($result['returncode'] ?? null)
            || !is_int($result['child_pid'] ?? null)) { throw new HandoverFailure('Actual native receipt does not match the original command.'); }
        foreach (['stdout', 'stderr'] as $name) {
            $actual = $this->identity($result[$name]['path'] ?? '');
            if ($actual['type'] !== 'file' || $actual['bytes'] !== $result[$name]['bytes'] || $actual['sha256'] !== $result[$name]['sha256']) { throw new HandoverFailure('Original native output changed.'); }
        }
        $this->state['commands'][$stage]['result'] = $result;
        $this->save();
        if ($result['returncode'] !== 0) { throw new HandoverFailure('Native command failed with actual exit ' . $result['returncode'] . ': ' . $stage, 'NATIVE_COMMAND_FAILED'); }
        return $result;
    }

    private function selectedCommand(string $name, string $stage, array $variables = []): array
    {
        $spec = $this->config['commands'][$name];
        $variables += ['project' => $this->config['project_root'], 'work' => $this->work,
            'php' => $this->config['php_executable'], 'console' => $this->config['project_root'] . '/' . $this->config['console']];
        $replace = static function (string $value) use ($variables): string {
            return preg_replace_callback('/\{([a-z_]+)\}/', static function (array $match) use ($variables): string {
                if (!isset($variables[$match[1]])) { throw new HandoverFailure('Unbound native command placeholder: ' . $match[1]); }
                return $variables[$match[1]];
            }, $value);
        };
        $argv = array_map($replace, $spec['argv']);
        $stdin = isset($spec['stdin']) ? $replace($spec['stdin']) : null;
        return $this->command($stage, $argv, $stdin);
    }

    private function freshStage(string $name): string
    {
        $this->state['sequence'] = ($this->state['sequence'] ?? 0) + 1; $this->save();
        return $name . ':' . $this->state['sequence'];
    }

    private function probe(string $stage): array
    {
        $directory = $this->directory('probes/' . hash('sha256', $stage));
        $output = $directory . '/site.json';
        $hashes = $this->directory('probes/' . hash('sha256', $stage) . '/hashes');
        $receipt = $this->command($stage, [$this->config['php_executable'], dirname(__DIR__) . '/native-site.php',
            '--configuration=' . $this->configuration, '--output=' . $output, '--hash-directory=' . $hashes]);
        $announced = Files::readJson($receipt['stdout']['path']);
        if (($announced['output'] ?? null) !== $output || ($announced['sha256'] ?? null) !== hash_file('sha256', $output)) { throw new HandoverFailure('Native probe output differs from its original command receipt.'); }
        $probe = Files::readJson($output);
        if (($probe['schema'] ?? null) !== 'tjl.catalogue.native-site.v1' || ($probe['state'] ?? null) !== 'COMPLETE'
            || ($probe['site_key'] ?? null) !== $this->config['site_key']) { throw new HandoverFailure('Native site probe did not bind the selected original site.'); }
        return $probe;
    }

    public function inspect(): array { return $this->probe($this->freshStage('inspect')); }

    private function excluded(string $relative): bool
    {
        foreach (array_merge($this->config['host_private_paths'], $this->config['excluded_runtime_paths']) as $path) {
            if ($relative === $path || str_starts_with($relative, $path . '/')) { return true; }
        }
        $absolute = $this->config['project_root'] . '/' . $relative;
        foreach ($this->roots as $group => $root) {
            if ($group !== 'project' && Files::inside($absolute, $root)) { return true; }
        }
        return false;
    }

    private function retireCopyStages(): void
    {
        foreach (glob($this->work . '/copy-journals/*.json') ?: [] as $path) {
            $intent = Files::readJson($path);
            if (($intent['state'] ?? null) !== 'WRITING') { continue; }
            $temporary = $intent['temporary'];
            if ($temporary !== $intent['destination'] . '.catalogue-part-' . $intent['nonce']
                || basename($path) !== hash('sha256', $intent['destination']) . '.json') {
                throw new HandoverFailure('Original owned copy stage binding changed.');
            }
            $actual = $this->identity($temporary);
            if ($actual['type'] === 'absent') { continue; }
            if ($actual['type'] !== 'file') { throw new HandoverFailure('An original disposable copy stage changed filesystem kind.'); }
            $intent['interrupted_stage'] = $actual; $intent['stage_retired_at'] = gmdate(DATE_ATOM);
            Files::writeJson($path, $intent);
            if (!unlink($temporary)) { throw new HandoverFailure('Cannot retire this original operation’s own interrupted file stage.'); }
        }
    }

    private function inventory(): array
    {
        $this->retireCopyStages();
        $entries = []; $sources = []; $bytes = 0;
        foreach ($this->roots as $prefix => $root) {
            $entries[$prefix] = ['path' => $prefix] + $this->identity($root);
            $walk = function (string $directory, string $relative) use (&$walk, $root, $prefix, &$entries, &$sources, &$bytes): void {
                $names = scandir($directory);
                if ($names === false) { throw new HandoverFailure('Cannot enumerate complete original source.'); }
                foreach ($names as $name) {
                    if ($name === '.' || $name === '..') { continue; }
                    $local = $relative === '' ? $name : $relative . '/' . $name;
                    if ($prefix === 'project' && $this->excluded($local)) { continue; }
                    $path = $directory . '/' . $name; $member = $prefix . '/' . $local;
                    $identity = $this->identity($path);
                    $entries[$member] = ['path' => $member] + $identity;
                    if ($identity['type'] === 'directory') { $walk($path, $local); }
                    elseif ($identity['type'] === 'file') {
                        $bytes += $identity['bytes']; $sources[$member] = $path;
                        if ($bytes > $this->config['max_bytes']) { throw new HandoverFailure('Complete source exceeds the selected byte limit.'); }
                    }
                }
            };
            $walk($root, '');
        }
        ksort($entries); ksort($sources);
        return ['entries' => array_values($entries), 'sources' => $sources, 'bytes' => $bytes];
    }

    private function comparable(array $probe): array
    {
        return ['platform' => $probe['database']['platform'], 'tables' => $probe['database']['tables'],
            'composer' => $probe['composer'], 'console' => $probe['console'], 'queue_mode' => $probe['queue_mode']];
    }

    private function freeze(string $name): array
    {
        $directory = $this->directory('captures/' . $name);
        $manifestPath = $directory . '/manifest.json';
        if (is_file($manifestPath)) {
            $manifest = Files::readJson($manifestPath); Archive::validateManifest($manifest);
            $sources = [];
            foreach ($manifest['entries'] as $entry) {
                if ($entry['type'] !== 'file') { continue; }
                $path = $directory . '/files/' . $entry['path'];
                $actual = $this->identity($path);
                if ($actual['type'] !== 'file' || $actual['bytes'] !== $entry['bytes'] || $actual['sha256'] !== $entry['sha256']) { throw new HandoverFailure('Frozen native source member changed.'); }
                $sources[$entry['path']] = $path;
            }
            return ['manifest' => $manifest, 'sources' => $sources, 'directory' => $directory];
        }
        $this->selectedCommand('verify_drained', $this->freshStage($name . ':drained'));
        $probe = $this->probe($name . ':source-probe');
        $database = $directory . '/database.sql';
        $queues = $this->directory('captures/' . $name . '/queue');
        $variables = ['database_sql' => $database, 'queue_directory' => $queues];
        $dump = $this->selectedCommand('database_dump', $name . ':database-dump', $variables);
        if ($this->config['commands']['database_dump']['output'] === 'stdout') { $this->copy($dump['stdout']['path'], $database); }
